title: Postdoc in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows
description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Microbiome Bioinformatics Workflows

We seek a bioinformatician to develop computational workflows to analyze large-scale microbiome multi-omics data in multiple projects studying human and animal health, including the consortium project PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net) and EU Horizon 2020 project MICROB-PREDICT (https://microb-predict.eu/). We strive to implement efficient and scalable workflows to analyze and integrate these data derived from metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, and metaproteomics in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. We have developed the MIntO package (https://github.com/arumugamlab/MIntO) that integrates microbiome metagenomic and metatranscriptomic data. Our ambition is to develop new workflows that expand MIntO’s features (e.g., novel analysis types) as well as datatypes (e.g., metabolomic data).

In this position, you will be:

  • Responsible for improving and expanding workflows in our current MIntO pipeline, while also having a chance to create your own novel workflows.

  • Expected to participate in and lead existing projects within these consortia and other projects in the Arumugam group; and are highly encouraged to initiate new cutting-edge research projects.

  • Expected to interact and collaborate with other clinical researchers, veterinarians, biologists, and bioinformaticians in these consortia, to enhance and ensure proper interpretation of experimental results.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree and documented research experience in one or more of the areas/fields mentioned below:

  • Bioinformatics

  • Biology

The Postdoc fellowship is aimed at early-career researchers with a background in basic science. We are particularly interested in candidates with solid experience in analyzing large volumes of next-generation sequencing data, who are aware of challenges in scalability and efficiency

Required qualifications:

  • PhD in bioinformatics or biology with strong experience in software development.

  • Academic preparation as well as experience in biological statistics.

  • Strong programming skills in Python and/or R.

  • Experience with bioinformatics workflow environments such as snakemake, NextFlow or CWL.

  • Experience in analyzing next-generation sequencing datasets.

  • Experience in a high-performance computing environment using any flavor of UNIX.

  • Demonstrated capacity for effective teamwork.

  • Proven track record showing scientific productivity in peer-reviewed journals.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.

The following qualifications are highly preferred, but not required. Candidates who possess any of these qualifications are encouraged to highlight them in the application:

  • Basic understanding of disease biology and/or microbiology.

  • Experience in analyzing metagenomic datasets from host-associated microbiota.

  • Experience in handling multi-omics data, including metabolomics and proteomics.

  • Experience in distributed and cloud computing technologies.

  • Experience in supervising other researchers at different levels.

  • International mobility

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision – We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information, please contact Group Leader Mani Arumugam, Department of Clinical Research, e-mail: arumugam@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 23649552 or Head of Department at the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477 

Application deadline

September 09, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

title: Postdoc in Host-Microbiome Multi-omic Data Science
description:
A position as a postdoc (100% time) is vacant at the Arumugam Group, Research unit of Medical Gastroenterology, the Department of Clinical Research, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to 3 years with the possibility of extension. 

Research tasks 

The position as a postdoc consists of research, teaching, professional development, and guidance in Host-Microbiome Multi-omic Data Science.

We seek a data scientist to derive insights from host-microbiome multi-omics data in multiple consortium projects studying human and animal health, including GALAXY/MicrobLiver studying liver fibrosis (https://www.sdu.dk/en/forskning/galaxy), MICROB-PREDICT studying late-stage liver cirrhosis (https://microb-predict.eu/), and PIG-PARADIGM to combat antimicrobial resistance (AMR) in pig production (http://pig-paradigm.net). We strive to integrate and interpret these data derived from microbiome (e.g., metagenomics, metatranscriptomics, viral metagenomics, metabolomics, metaproteomics) and host (e.g., genetics, proteomics, circulating metabolomics) in collaboration with international data science partners (e.g., EMBL-Heidelberg; University of California, Davis) and other project partners. The current state-of-the-art for multi-omics integration and interpretation leaves much to be desired. Fortunately, our ongoing work leveraging a deep learning approach (autoencoders) integrates multi-omics data and generates biologically relevant insights using a biologically informed machine learning framework. Our ambition is to strengthen and expand this research direction into graph-based approaches such as graph neural networks.

In this position, you will be:

  • Responsible for improving and expanding our current deep learning approaches, while also having a chance to create your own novel approaches.

  • Expected to participate in and lead existing data science projects within these consortia and the Arumugam group; and are highly encouraged to initiate new cutting-edge research projects.

  • Expected to interact and collaborate with other clinical researchers, veterinarians, biologists, and bioinformaticians in these consortia to enhance and ensure proper interpretation of experimental results.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant who is hired must have a Ph.D. degree and documented research experience in one or more of the areas/fields mentioned below, with strong experience in software development.

  • Computer science (informatics)

  • Mathematics

  • Physics

  • Bioinformatics

  • Biology

The Postdoc fellowship is aimed at early-career researchers with a background in basic science. We are particularly interested in candidates with strong analytical skills and interdisciplinary experience. Candidates with a solid data science background but lacking biological training are strongly encouraged to apply and include a statement about their motivation for this position and how they anticipate addressing this.

Required qualifications:

  • PhD in computer science (informatics), mathematics, physics, bioinformatics, or biology with strong experience in software development.

  • Academic preparation as well as experience in machine learning and statistical analysis.

  • Strong programming skills and experience using deep learning frameworks (e.g., Python, NumPy, PyTorch, TensorFlow).

  • Experience with deep learning model architectures, including autoencoders, graph neural networks, and related neural network models.

  • Familiarity with explainable AI (xAI) methods for interpreting machine learning and deep learning models.

  • Experience in a high-performance computing environment using any flavor of UNIX.

  • Demonstrated capacity for effective teamwork.

  • Proven track record showing scientific productivity in peer-reviewed journals.

  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and oral.

The following qualifications are highly preferred but not required. Candidates who possess any of these qualifications are encouraged to highlight them in the application:

  • Experience in applying deep learning to biological problems.

  • Basic understanding of human disease biology and/or microbiology.

  • Experience in analyzing metagenomic datasets from host-associated microbiota.

  • Experience in handling multi-omics data, including metabolomics and proteomics.

  • Experience in distributed and cloud computing technologies.

  • Experience in supervising other researchers at different levels.

  • International mobility.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information, please contact Group Leader Mani Arumugam, Department of Clinical Research, e-mail: arumugam@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 23649552 or Head of Department at the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen, e-mail: rllarsen@health.sdu.dk, phone: +45 65503477

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

title: Critical Environment Technician
description:
Overview
Critical Environment Technician (CET) – Shift Role 
Location: 3 Sites Greater Copenhagen Area, Denmark  
Role Type: Shift-based, onsite technical operations role 

Role Summary Microsoft is seeking a Critical Environment Technician (CET) to support the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of Microsoft datacenter infrastructure in Denmark. 
This role is responsible for supporting the operation, monitoring, maintenance, and troubleshooting of electrical, mechanical, cooling, and control systems within a 24/7 mission-critical environment. 

We offer an excellent work-life balance 
•    Two-day shifts from 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM. •    Two-night shifts from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM. 
•    Seven days off following each rotation, in accordance with the DI agreement. 
Microsoft Culture and Expectations 
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. Within CO+I, this mission is supported through a culture focused on safety, reliability, sustainability, inclusion, learning, and continuous improvement. 
Employees are expected to model Microsoft values, follow approved procedures, apply STOP WORK authority when needed, and contribute to an inclusive environment where all team members can perform, grow, and succeed. 


Responsibilities
Key Responsibilities 
•    Monitor, operate, and control critical infrastructure systems, including electrical, mechanical, cooling, and control systems. 
•    Perform preventive and corrective maintenance in accordance with approved EOPs, MOPs, and SOPs. 
•    Respond to incidents, support troubleshooting and recovery activities, and lead response efforts when appropriate. •    Identify and escalate safety, compliance, and operational risks in line with Microsoft standards. 
•    Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure safe and high-quality execution. 
•    Contribute to continuous improvement by sharing knowledge, supporting peers, and developing technical capability over time. 


Qualifications
Required Qualifications 
 •    Upper secondary education (vocational or general upper secondary school) or equivalent practical work experience 
•    Some prior experience in technical work, such as: industrial maintenance, electrical or HVAC installations, energy, process or production facilities, datacentres, hospitals or other demanding technical environments 
•    You will be required to travel between sites as part of this role so a valid driver’s license will be required.
•    Ability to work rotating shift patterns in a 24/7 operational environment. 
•    Ability to communicate effectively in English. 
Preferred (but not essential) Qualifications 
•    Technical certification in electrical, mechanical, HVAC, or a related field, or equivalent training. 
•    Experience working with CMMS systems. •    Experience in high-availability, mission-critical, or safety-critical environments. 
•    Exposure to industrial, electrical, mechanical, cooling, or control systems.  

Direct datacenter experience is not required—we provide onboarding and support to build the necessary domain expertise. 
You do not need to meet every requirement to apply. 
If you have strong experience in similar technical environments, a passion for safety, and operations, we encourage you to apply. 

Candidate Profile 
•    The ideal candidate demonstrates a strong safety mindset, sound technical judgment, and the ability to operate effectively in a structured, procedure-driven environment. 
•    Microsoft encourages applications from candidates with diverse technical backgrounds who are motivated to learn and contribute to a high-performing datacenter operations team. 
Security Requirements 
Candidates must successfully complete the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire and maintain ongoing compliance throughout employment. 


Critical Environment Ops ATR-B - The typical base pay range for this role across Denmark is kr 315,400.00 - kr 411,500.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.

Work tasks: Company for Business OÜ is looking for an SEO specialist to develop and promote the company’s web projects. The specialist’s primary objective is to increase the organic visibility of the company’s websites in Google Search.
Key Responsibilities • Developing and implementing an SEO strategy for the company’s websites. • Promoting websites in Google for commercial and informational search queries. • Conducting technical SEO audits and monitoring the resolution of identified issues. • Analysing website structure, URLs, indexation, canonical tags, robots.txt, sitemaps and internal links. • Working with Google Search Console and Google Analytics. • Collecting and clustering the semantic core / keyword set. • Conducting keyword research and analysing search intent. • Analysing competitors and their SEO strategies. • Developing content plans together with editors and writers. • Preparing SEO briefs and technical specifications for new pages and articles. • Optimising existing content and landing pages. • Working with title tags, meta descriptions, H1–H3 headings, internal linking and page structure. • Monitoring the indexation and search visibility of newly published content. • Identifying opportunities to increase the websites’ topical authority. • Developing and implementing an off-page SEO and link-building strategy. • Analysing the backlink profiles of the company’s websites and competitors. • Monitoring rankings, organic traffic, CTR and conversions from organic search. • Preparing regular SEO reports.

We offer: • Flexible working arrangements (full-time or part-time).
• Remote work opportunities. • Long-term cooperation. • Competitive remuneration depending on experience and qualifications. • High salary.

Other requirements: Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a person who can work systematically with technical SEO, content, semantics, backlink profiles, analytics and search visibility. We are not looking for a specialist whose role is limited to placing keywords or purchasing links, but for a team member who wants to develop together with the company. The key result of the role is sustainable growth in high-quality organic traffic, rankings for commercially important queries and the company website’s overall search visibility. What We Expect from the Candidate • Practical SEO experience. • A strong understanding of how Google Search works. • Experience conducting technical SEO audits. • Experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics. • Ability to conduct keyword research and competitor research. • Understanding of on-page and off-page SEO. • Understanding of link-building principles. • Experience working with large content-driven websites will be an advantage. Tools Experience with some of the following tools is preferred: • Google Search Console; • Google Analytics; • Ahrefs / Semrush; • Screaming Frog; • Google Keyword Planner; • PageSpeed Insights.

title: Pitsameister
description:
Tööülesanded: Tööülesandeks on Adavere Tuuliku Toidutänava pitsa suuna iseseisev käivitamine, korraldamine ja arendamine. Pitsameister vastutab pitsa kvaliteedi ja valmistamise eest, alustades taigna ja tooraine ettevalmistamisest kuni valmis pitsa serveerimiseni. Töö hõlmab kvaliteetse tooraine valimist, retseptide ja valmistamisstandardite väljatöötamist ning pitsa menüü koostamist ja arendamist.
Oluline on tagada ühtlane kõrge kvaliteet, hea maitse, kiirus ja korrektne töökorraldus ka suurema klientide arvu korral. Samuti tuleb jälgida tooraine varusid ja kvaliteeti, vähendada toidukadu ning hoida köök ja töövahendid puhtad ja korras. Pitsameister osaleb uute toodete ja ideede väljatöötamisel ning aitab arendada pitsa suunda vastavalt klientide tagasisidele ja müügitulemustele. Vajadusel tuleb juhendada teisi töötajaid ning tagada, et kõik pitsa valmistamisega seotud tööprotsessid vastaksid kokkulepitud kvaliteedistandarditele. Ootame iseseisvat ja ettevõtliku mõtteviisiga professionaali, kes ei tegele ainult pitsa valmistamisega, vaid soovib võtta vastutuse kogu pitsa suuna kvaliteedi, arendamise ja tulemuste eest.

Omalt poolt pakume: Pakume alustuseks kokkulepitud põhitöötasu vastavalt pitsa meistri kogemustele, oskustele ja professionaalsele tasemele. Töö ja tulemuste paranedes on võimalik töötasu on kuni 15 eurot/tund ning lisaks põhitöötasule teenida tulemustasu vastavalt pitsa suuna käibele, klientide rahulolule, positiivsele tagasisidele, reitingule ja püsikliendibaasi kasvule.
Meie eesmärk on, et tugeva ja tulemusliku töötaja sissetulek ei jääks pikaajaliselt ainult põhitöötasu tasemele. Mida suurem on inimese panus, vastutus ja saavutatud tulemus, seda suuremaks võib kujuneda ka tema teenistus. Pakume võimalust olla Adavere Tuuliku Toidutänava pitsa suuna ülesehitamisel oluline võtmeisik. Vajadusel on võimalik pakkuda majutust Adavere Tuuliku juures, kuid majutuskoht vajab eelnevalt remonti ja korrastamist. Parimatele töötajatele on võimalik pakkuda ka võimalust töötada Tenerifel ettevõtte baaris, kohvikus ja teistes toitlustusprojektides. Tenerifel töötamise korral on samuti võimalik pakkuda majutust. Töötajaga sõlmitakse tööleping Property Deals OÜga ning lähetatakse. Väga heade ja pikaajaliste tulemuste korral võib tulevikus avaneda võimalus saada ettevõttes suurem vastutus, võtmeroll või osalus ning osaleda ettevõtte edus sarnaselt partneriga.

title: Toolmaker / Mold Maintenance Technician (Injection Molding)
description:
Aquaphor International OÜ is looking for an experienced Toolmaker / Mold Maintenance Technician (Injection Molding) to join our team.

Work tasks: Job description
Repair, service, and maintain injection molds. Perform preventive maintenance and keep molds production-ready. Diagnose mold and tooling issues and carry out necessary repairs. Disassemble, inspect, repair, and assemble molds and their components. Repair and manufacture tooling, mold components, and production fixtures. Support mold trials and troubleshoot mold-related issues in production. Preferred candidate profile Technical or vocational education in toolmaking, machining, mechanical engineering, industrial maintenance, or a related field. At least 3 years of hands-on experience in toolmaking, mold assembly, maintenance, or repair of injection molds. Good understanding of injection mold construction, components, mechanisms, and operating principles. Ability to repair and maintain injection molds of varying complexity, including cold runner and hot runner systems. Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings for molds and tooling. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Responsible, precise, and quality-focused approach to work. Good working knowledge of technical English.

We offer: Fixed-term contract for 12 months, with the possibility of extension
4-month probation period. Full-time position, 40 hours per week. Work location: Tallinn, Estonia. Employer-provided health insurance. 28 calendar days of annual leave. Company-provided workwear and personal protective equipment. A performance-based bonus system.

Option to work from home: No

description:
Pärnu

Tööülesanded: Meie eesmärk on tagada oma klientidele ja partneritele kõige turvalisemad ja eeskujulikumad töömaad Eestis. Selleks otstarbeks kasutame parimaid ja kvaliteetsemaid liikluskorraldus- ja ohutusvahendeid: ajutised liiklusmärgid, teepiirded, ehitusaiad, käigu- ja sõidusillad, teekünnised ja pinnasekaitsematid - need on vaid mõned tootegrupid millega igapäevaselt tegeleme.
Aga parimatest toodetest üksi ei piisa, vaja on ka professionaalseid paigaldajaid, kes tooteid eeskujulikult ning professionaalselt klientide töömaale kohale viiks ning paigaldaks. Töö iseloom ei ole kindlasti lihtsaimate killast - on pikki tööpäevi ja suuri raskuseid mida tõsta. Sinu ülesandeks on erinevatel objektidel liikluskorraldustööde teostamine. Sealhulgas: - ajutise liikluskorralduse üles seadmine vastavalt seaduses sätestatud punktidele; - liiklusmärkide ja muude liikluskorraldusvahendite transport ning paigaldamine; - objektide kontrollimine ja korrashoid (märkide ümbertõstmine, asendamine jms.); - lisaks muud liikluskorralduse ning töömaaohutusega seotud ülesanded.

Omalt poolt pakume: - konkurentsivõimeline palk;
- toetav ja tore meeskond; - head töötingimused ja -vahendid; - meeleolukad ühisüritused; - koolitus ja väljaõpe on kohapeal; - sporditoetused ja nii mõnigi muu hüve veel.

Muud nõuded: kiire õppimisvõime; kohusetundlikkus ja täpsus; hea füüsiline vorm; töötahe ning võime iseseisvalt tegutseda; eesti keele oskus; B-kategooria juhiloa olemasolu; valmisolek töötada ka õhtuti ja nädalavahetustel. Eelised: eelnev töökogemus liikluskorralduse või teedeehituse valdkonnas; BE-, C- või CE-kategooria juhiloa olemasolu.

poolhaagis / konteinerveok

Omalt poolt pakume: stabiilset ja õigeaegselt makstavat töötasu;
rahulikku tööd ilma pideva kiirustamise ja pikkade komandeeringuteta; tööd ainult Harjumaal (Eestis); igapäevast võimalust koju naasta; võimalust veeta õhtud ja nädalavahetused pere ringis; pikaajalist koostööd.

Muud nõuded: CE-kategooria juhiluba;
kehtiv kutsetunnistus (kood 95); digitaalse sõidumeeriku juhikaart; varasem töökogemus poolhaagise ja/või konteinerveokiga on kohustuslik; eesti keele algtasemel oskus; vastutustundlikkus, korrektsus ja hooliv suhtumine tehnikasse. Omalt poolt pakume: Võimalust päriselt midagi luua.

Saad: •⁠ ⁠luua uusi menüüsid; •⁠ ⁠arendada signatuurroogasid; •⁠ ⁠muuta ja täiustada olemasolevaid menüüsid; •⁠ ⁠arendada catering’i tootmist; •⁠ ⁠kujundada köögi töökorraldust; •⁠ ⁠arendada oma meeskonda; •⁠ ⁠osaleda uute teenuste ja kontseptsioonide loomisel. Professionaalne keskkond Royal Cateringi kulinaarse suuna taga on rahvusvaheliselt tunnustatud peakokk Lauri Ööpik ning ettevõtte à la carte pakkumises kasutatakse restoranitasemel lähenemist. Koka haridus on eelis, kuid kõige olulisemad on sinu päris oskused, kogemus ja suhtumine. Me ei otsi kõige ilusama CV-ga inimest. description:

Tööülesanded: Inimeseõpetuse õpetajana lood gümnaasiuminoortele õppimiseks keskkonna, kus on ruumi nii mõtlemiseks, küsimiseks kui ka eksimiseks.
Mentorina oled noorele kooliteel tark ja usaldusväärne täiskasvanu – aitad tal märgata oma tugevusi, teha valikuid ning tulla toime nende kohtadega, kus ta vajab rohkem tuge. Igapäevatöö juurde kuulub koostöö kolleegidega, oma aine ja õpetamise arendamine ning osalemine kooli ühistes tegemistes. Me ei eelda, et kõik õpetajad teevad kõike ühtemoodi – ootame professionaali, kes oskab oma tööd kujundada ja tahab samal ajal teistega koos õppida.

Omalt poolt pakume: Rae Gümnaasiumis saad töötada koolis, kus õpetaja ei ole ainult oma tunni andja, vaid oluline osa noore arengust ja kooli kujundavast meeskonnast.
Meie juures saad: * kaasaegse ja hästi varustatud õpikeskkonna; * võimaluse oma õpetamist ise kujundada ning uusi lahendusi proovida; * kolleegid, kellega saab arutada, katsetada ja koos õppida; * mentori rolli, mis võimaldab õppijat tundma õppida ka väljaspool oma ainetundi; * võimaluse panustada kasvava gümnaasiumi arengusse ja kujundada koos meiega seda, milline üks hea tänapäevane gümnaasium olla võiks; * professionaalse arengu võimalused ja toetuse oma töö arendamiseks. Meie jaoks on oluline, et inimene tunneks end meeskonnas vajalikuna, saaks kasutada oma professionaalsust ning tunneks, et tema tööl on päriselt mõju.

Muud nõuded: Ootame õpetajat, kes tahab ise areneda ja teisi arengus toetada, julgeb proovida ja üllatada, oskab olla järjepidev ning tunneb rõõmu õppimisest, koostööst ja õppijate saavutustest. Meie õpetaja on valmis olema õppijale ka individuaalne mentor – tark täiskasvanu, kes aitab noorel oma arengut märgata, valikuid läbi mõelda ja sihte seada.

Tööülesanded: Perenaine on meie maja üks olulistest inimestest. Ta serveerib külalistele hommikusöögi, koristab üldruumid ja toad (9 tuba). Ennelõunasel ajal tegeleb perenaine külaliste ning broneeringutega. Perenaine hoiab pilgu peal kõigel, et majas ja hoovis valitseks kord ja puhtus ning kõigil klientidel oleks meie juures hea olla. Töö sobib sulle kui oled hommikuinimene. Kui armastad päikesetõuse, siis unehõlmas Ööbikuorus on need eriti lummavad. Lahke naeratus käib sinuga alati kaasas.

Omalt poolt pakume: Omalt poolt pakume meeldivat ja üksteist toetavat töökollektiivi, üht ilusaimat töö tegemise kohta ja konkurentsivõimelist töötasu. Võimalik teenida lisatasu olenevalt lisatööülesannete tegemise võimekusest ja soovist. Tööaeg sõltub graafikust. Reeglina algab kell 6.00 ja lõppeb 14.00 - 16.00 vahel (sõltuvalt maja täituvusest). Tööaja hulka jäävad sõltuvalt graafikust ka nädalavahetused ja riiklikud pühad.

Muud nõuded: Töö sobib elutervele inimesele, kes hindab head ja meeldivat kollektiivi ning kes on ise heaks meeskonnatöötajaks. Meie kollektiivi sobib ka nn. teises nooruses olev perenaine. Perenaine on kohusetundlik, aus, kiire ja hoolas. Kasuks tuleb vene või inglise keele oskus

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

title: Hommikusöögiteenindaja
description:
Tööülesanded: Klientide teenindamine restoranis hommikusöögi ajal vastavalt teenindusstandardile ja ametijuhendile.
Hommikusöögi buffee-laua valmispanek, täitmine toitudega, laudade koristamine ja katmine, poleerimine.

Omalt poolt pakume: GOSPA restoran on üks parimatest pererestoranidest ja pakub oma töötajatele imelist töökabinetti imelise vaatega merele/jahisadamale/lossile. Töö on graafiku alusel ning vabu päevi on ka nädala sees. Lisaks konkurentsivõimelisele töötasule kehtivad oma maja töötajatele majasisesed soodustused, tervisekomensatsioon Stebby keskkonnas.

title: Isiklik abistaja
description:
Sobib nii lisa- kui põhitööks

Tööülesanded: Isiklik abistaja on töötaja, kes abistab füüsiliselt liikumis- ja/või nägemispuudega täiskasvanut lähtuvalt tema puudest tingitud erivajadustest ja tööjuhistest, näiteks: liikumisel, söömisel, riietumisel, suhtlemisel, hügieeniprotseduuride sooritamisel, kirjutamisel, lugemisel, igapäevaste majapidamistoimingute teostamisel jne. Väljaõpe kliendilt.

title: Solution Engineer, Wave
description:
Cadmatic is a leading global developer of digital and intelligent 3D-based design, engineering, and information management solutions for the marine, process, and construction industries. Our journey started in the 1980s. Over the past decade, we have grown by 20 percent annually, and it's all about talent. We truly value our people – many stay with us for years, with an average tenure of 10 years. Today we have over 330 proactive, engaged, and growth-minded people in 20 countries around the world. Over 6000 customers are using our software solutions in 60 countries. In the marine industry, our technology supports around 40 percent of the worlds shipyards. We continue strong growth.

We are looking for a Solution Engineer to help marine industry customers get more value from their PLM solutions. In this role, you will configure, customize, and develop Cadmatic Wave to support customer-specific requirements and business processes.

You are based in Finland, Germany, or the Netherlands and can work remotely or in a hybrid model. The role includes regular visits to customer sites across Central Europe, giving you the opportunity to work closely with customers and support them in their day-to-day use of Cadmatic solutions.

What you will work on:

- Support technical deployment of Cadmatic Wave in customer environments.
- Develop customer-specific enhancements that extend system capabilities beyond the core product.
- Configure and customize Cadmatic Wave to align with customer workflows and business goals.
- Collaborate with clients and solution consultants to gather requirements and deliver solutions.
- Act as the technical point of contact, ensuring clear communication and trusted partnerships.
- Oversee system rollouts and data migrations, ensuring minimal disruption and data integrity.
- Provide valuable feedback to R&D based on customer insights and project experiences.

We wish you to bring:

- Bachelors or masters degree in IT, engineering, or a related field.
- Solid experience in PLM implementation, consulting, or software configuration.
- Experience in software customization, aligning solutions to client-specific needs.
- Knowledge in requirements engineering, creating requirement specifications and writing user stories.
- Proficiency in Python, SQL, and database management.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail.
- A customer-focused approach and an interest in solving practical business and technical challenges.
- Willingness to travel to customer sites when needed.

We are especially glad if you have:

- Hands-on experience with PLM solutions, CONTACT PLM seen as advantage.
- Know-how of industry business processes related to product/project
- Experience with API integrations, cloud-based PLM solutions, and data migration methodologies.
- Exposure to software deployment, integration methodologies, and custom application development.

Cadmatic as an employer:

- A stable, global company with a long history, strong future, and advanced software solutions.
- A friendly, supportive, and truly multicultural work environment where we succeed together.
- Autonomy, ownership, and trust: youre encouraged to do your best work and develop professionally.
- Competitive benefits and flexible working practices that support worklife balance.
- An engineerminded, peoplefirst culture — we take our work seriously but also enjoy ourselves along the way.

Join our growth journey!

Delight us with your application by 13 September. If you have any questions, feel free to contact our hiring manager Ankit Talati via email ankit.talati@cadmatic.com. Please note that we only accept applications submitted to our Applicant Tracking System (ATS).

We will share the salary range in the interview invitation with candidates who progress to the interview stage.

We believe in diversity, equity, and inclusion. We are committed to building a company culture where we cherish diversity and promote equity, and where everyone feels valued and respected. We firmly believe that success comes from building an inclusive company culture and providing equal opportunities for our People.

title: Onsite Network Specialist
description:
Are you a proactive network professional who enjoys hands-on work and supporting reliable IT services in an onsite environment? We are looking for 3 people to become Onsite Network Specialists to ensure stable and efficient local network services at our site(s).

In this role, you will be responsible for the local network environment within your support area. You will work closely with business stakeholders, internal IT teams, and external service partners to maintain reliable network operations, support continuous improvement, and ensure that local business needs are met.

The purpose of the Onsite Network Specialist role is to deliver reliable service for the local network environment at the site(s) in the assigned country. The role works towards operational efficiency, supports continuous improvement of services, and cooperates closely with business counterparts as well as internal and external service partners.

Key responsibilities

Ensure that safety rules and regulations are followed in all daily activities.

Take responsibility for the Local Area Network, LAN, within the assigned support area.

Install, configure, monitor, troubleshoot, and maintain manageable network infrastructure.

Support fault correction and preventive actions to improve network reliability.

Assist with the design of local network solutions and requirements.

Coordinate and implement local network changes.

Maintain operational documentation, configuration records, and CMDB data to ensure accuracy.

Requirements

Bachelor's or Master's degree in relevant field

2–5 years of experience in key network technologies.

Good knowledge of LAN, WLAN, firewalls, and DHCP.

Experience in network installation, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting.

Good communication skills in English and Finnish, both spoken and written.

Proactive working style with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage own time and workload.

Ability to work independently as well as in cooperation with internal and external stakeholders.

Requirement to be onsite for the majority of the time.

Safety-focused mindset and willingness to follow local safety rules and regulations.

Drivers license

To apply, please submit your CV and a cover letter in English till the 20th of September 2026. The position might be filled before the final application date, thus, please do not hesitate to apply earlier!

The selected candidate will be required to pass a security clearance vetting and health check (including drug tests) before commencing employment

title: Project Engineer – Portuguese-speaking | Industrial Projects
description:
About the role

This is a hands-on project role where you will coordinate activities, follow up on purchases and deliveries, communicate with customers and suppliers, and make sure agreed actions progress according to schedule.

The assignment is initially six months, and we hope you can start as soon as possible.

Work tasks

You will work closely with an experienced international project organization and support a Project Manager responsible for several customer projects. The team has recently grown, creating a need for additional project engineering capacity.

A significant part of the role involves projects in Portuguese-speaking markets in South America, which makes fluent Portuguese essential. You will communicate directly with customers and help translate their needs into concrete actions within the project organization.

The projects are related primarily to large industrial engines, engine components and associated technical services. You do not need to be an engine specialist when you join, but you should be comfortable working with technical equipment and industrial projects.

The role combines project coordination, customer communication, procurement and technical understanding. Success requires an organised and proactive approach: when something needs to happen, you take ownership of following it through.

Your responsibilities may include:
- Coordinating international customer and delivery projects
- Communicating with Portuguese-speaking customers in South America
- Following project schedules, open actions and deliveries
- Ensuring agreed tasks progress and proactively following up with stakeholders
- Creating and following purchase orders and procurement activities
- Working with ERP systems, particularly SAP
- Coordinating suppliers and external service providers
- Supporting sourcing and procurement of services such as machining, lifting and specialist field services
- Investigating delivery issues and other project deviations
- Collaborating with Project Managers, procurement, logistics, technical experts, suppliers and customers
- Supporting customer meetings and project-related travel to South America

We are looking for

For this position, you must have:
- A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering
- Professional fluency in Portuguese
- Professional working proficiency in English
- Previous experience in project work where you have independently coordinated activities, followed schedules and ensured actions are completed
- Experience working with purchasing, purchase orders, deliveries or similar ERP-based processes
- Ability to understand technical equipment and communicate effectively in an industrial environment
- Willingness and ability to travel to South America when required
- Experience with SAP
- A valid driving licence

You do not need to speak Finnish.

We consider it a strong advantage if you have experience in one or more of the following areas:
- Marine, maritime or shipbuilding industry
- Engine technology or powertrain systems
- Industrial machinery or equipment
- Technical service or maintenance projects
- Procurement and supplier coordination
- Automation
- Customer-facing technical project roles

Your previous job title could for example be Project Engineer, Project Coordinator, Project Manager, Delivery Engineer, Service Engineer, Technical Project Engineer or Procurement Engineer. More important than the title is that you understand how technical projects work and are comfortable taking responsibility for keeping them on track.

As a person, we believe you are
- Proactive and comfortable taking ownership
- Organised and able to manage several ongoing topics simultaneously
- Confident communicating directly with customers
- Persistent in following up and getting things completed
- Comfortable working across different countries, cultures and functions
- Practical and solution-oriented when plans change

Practical information
- Salary: based on your background and experience about 3500 - 4500 € / month
- Start: As soon as possible
- Duration: 6 months
- Working hours: Full-time
- Location: Flexible within Finland. The role can be performed largely remotely, although occasional presence in Turku is required.
- Travel: The position includes occasional international business travel, primarly to South America.
- Languages: Portuguese and English
- Employment: Fixed-term employment through Academic Work, working as a consultant in our client organisation

About the client

Our client is a globally operating technology company providing advanced solutions and services for demanding marine and industrial environments. Its international project organisation works with customers around the world on large-scale technical equipment, lifecycle services and complex delivery projects.

You will join an experienced international organisation where you will work with technically interesting projects and gain exposure to global customers, suppliers and engineering professionals.

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Medarbetare till Haraldsbyfabrikens Logistikavdelning
description:

title: Koulupsykologi, Perhekeskus, Kaarina
description:
Työskentelet koulupsykologina Kaarinan opiskeluhuollossa S:t Karins svenska skolanissa ja Piispanlähteen koululla (1.-6. luokat) sekä näiden koulujen esiopetusyksiköissä. Tuot psykologista asiantuntijuutta esiopetuksen ja oppilaitoksen käyttöön ja olet mukana tukemassa lasten oppimista, kasvua, kehitystä ja hyvinvointia. Arjessasi yhdistyvät yksilötyö, yhteisöllinen työ ja monialainen yhteistyö koulun henkilöstön sekä opiskeluhuollon muiden ammattilaisten kanssa.

Työssäsi psykologin asiantuntemusta arvostetaan ja se nähdään kouluyhteisössä tärkeänä. Tukenasi ovat johtava koulupsykologi sekä alueen kokenut psykologitiimi, jotka ovat aina tarvittaessa saatavilla.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu:
-oppilaan yksilökohtainen tuki ja ohjaus asiakastyössä oppimiseen, kasvuun, kehitykseen ja hyvinvointiin liittyen
-osallistuminen monialaisen asiantuntijaryhmän työskentelyyn
-yhteisöllinen työ oppilaitoksella
-oppimisvaikeuksien kartoitus.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle

Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen ja merkityksellisen työn, jossa voit suunnitella työpäiväsi joustavasti liukuvaa työaikaa ja osittaista etätyötä hyödyntäen. Saat kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään, mahdollisuuden perustellusti yksilötyönohjaukseen sekä halutessasi kokeneen psykologin mentoriksi. Tuemme osaamisesi kehittymistä ja tarjoamme mahdollisuuden kouluttautua esimerkiksi Terapiat etulinjaan -koulutuksiin. Työhyvinvointisi ja ammatillinen kasvu ovat meille tärkeitä.

Mitä odotamme sinulta

Odotamme sinulta sujuvaa suomen ja ruotsin kielen taitoa, kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn sekä hyviä verkosto- ja tiimityötaitoja. Tehtävä edellyttää oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta. Eduksi katsotaan kokemus lasten, nuorten ja perheiden kanssa tehdystä työstä. Huomioimme myös opintojen loppuvaiheessa olevat hakijat.

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun lain 559/94 mukainen psykologin laillistus.

Hae mukaan tekemään vaikuttavaa työtä lasten ja nuorten hyvinvoinnin ja oppimisen tueksi Kaarinaan - odotamme hakemustasi!

title: Närvårdare 80 %
description:
Som närvårdare hos oss ger du stöd, service och vård i det dagliga livet till personer med psykisk, intellektuell, neuropsykiatrisk och/eller fysisk funktionsnedsättning. Genom rutiner och kontinuitet skapar du trygghet och ger förutsättningar för självständighet och delaktighet. Arbetet utgår från varje individs behov och önskemål och kräver därför lyhördhet, flexibilitet och ett respektfullt bemötande.

Vi söker dig som har lätt för att kommunicera och som har ett professionellt bemötande gentemot klienter, anhöriga och kollegor. Du är noggrann, tar ansvar och arbetar utifrån arbetsplatsens riktlinjer och metoder. Du värdesätter samarbete och bidrar aktivt till ett gott och positivt arbetsklimat. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.

Tidigare erfarenhet av liknande arbete samt kunskap inom autismspektrum, alternativ och kompletterande kommunikation samt olika funktionsvariationer är meriterande men inte ett krav.

Som anställd hos oss får du stöd i ditt arbete av ett metodteam som vägleder arbetsgruppen utifrån antagen metod (PBS). Du blir en del av en engagerad arbetsgrupp där vi regelbundet har personalmöten och tillsammans arbetar för att utveckla verksamheten.

Inom KST erbjuder vi friskvårdsförmåner via friskvård.ax och företagshälsovård på allmänläkarnivå.

För en tillsvidareanställning krävs en närvårdarexamen eller motsvarande, registrerad i Valvira. Vid brist på behöriga sökande kan visstidsanställning övervägas för sökande utan formell behörighet.

Ange gärna i din ansökan om du har ett särskilt intresse för någon av enheterna, Maskrosvägen eller Tistelgränd.

Anställningarna är tillsvidare i periodarbete och omfattar 80 % av heltid. Arbetet inleds den 1 oktober eller enligt överenskommelse. Den uppgiftsrelaterade lönen är 80 % av 2 948,07 € vid formell behörighet, samt eventuella erfarenhetstillägg. Prövotid tillämpas och intervjuer kan ske löpande under ansökningstiden.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

title: Mechanics Supervisor
description:
We are looking for a Mechanics Supervisor to join our beverage can factory in **Hämeenlinna**.

_Canpack Finland Oy is part of the Canpack Group, a leading global manufacturer of aluminum beverage cans, packaging solutions, and metal closures. Based in Hämeenlinna, we bring together a diverse team of 150 professionals, all working together to: Create That Feeling!_

**Mechanics Supervisor**

We are looking for a supervisor to join our Mechanical Maintenance department. In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing a team of mechanics and machinists, as well as maintenance processes and resources, to ensure continuous operation of machinery and equipment.

**Main responsibilities:**

· Supervise the work of the mechanical team by assigning tasks, managing absences, and monitoring task execution and team efficiency.

· Organize and oversee workshop activities, including planning and execution of inspections, repairs, and preventive maintenance.

· Identify and resolve technical issues, initiate and implement improvement actions and continuous improvement projects.

· Collaborate with other departments on downtime planning, implementation of new technical solutions, and process optimization.

· Develop and maintain a constant safety environment and provide necessary training updates while striving for zero incidents

**Our expectations:**

· Relevant technical education, preferably in mechanics or machine construction.

· Experience from industrial maintenance, mechanical systems, or equipment servicing within a manufacturing or production environment.

· Strong leadership, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

· Ability to communicate effectively in English

Even if you don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse experiences and perspectives!

**We offer:**

· challenging work in a fast-developing international company,

· opportunities for further professional development,

· competitive salary between 3800 - 4800€ (gross), based on education and professional experience, with a bonus according to the applicable bonus system.

If you find this position interesting - send your application by **6.9.2026.**

**Meet Tomasz**

Wondering who you'll be working with? Watch a short video where your future manager shares their background, and what it's like to work at CANPACK.

title: Japanese speaking Cabin Crew Member Helsinki Base, Finnair
description:
Finnair is a diverse community of professionals who work ambitiously with a big heart and commitment. A strong safety culture is our priority and at the core of our everyday work, never taking it for granted. We are committed to doing our share in solving the climate challenge by determinedly following our science-based pathway to decarbonize our operations. We find meaning in our purpose: With our heart in Finland, we make every journey better, today and tomorrow. Our values - Always Safe, Customer at Heart and Stronger Together - guide us in everything we do.

Finnair Cabin Crew recruitment for 2027 is now open! We are looking to strengthen our group of cabin crew employees with knowledge of Japanese language and culture to join our Helsinki base. This Japanese speaking group will be dedicated to serve our Japanese routes as well as European and domestic scheduled flights. Employment contracts will be full-time permanent. Are you ready to be part of the Finnair team where the sky isn't the limit? Join us as cabin crew member and discover a career that's always uplifting. Your journey to the skies starts here!

As a cabin crew member, you are responsible for ensuring cabin safety and delivering excellent customer service on Finnair flights. Being a part of Finnair cabin crew means that you provide the best possible experience and meaningful encounters for our customers.

What we are looking for and what we expect from you:

- Positive attitude and excellent customer service skills
- Excellent teamwork skills in a diverse environment
- Sales-oriented mindset and good communication skills
- Ability to work according to procedures and guidelines
- Resilience, persistence, and ability to adapt to changing situations

What is required to become a Cabin Crew Member at Finnair?

- Age of at least 18 years old
- Secondary education completed (upper secondary/vocational school)
- Fluency in Japanese and English, additional languages are an advantage
- Knowledge of Japanese culture
- Height minimum 160 cm and ability to reach 218 cm barefoot
- At least 1 year of experience in hospitality or customer service
- Good general health and the ability to work irregular hours and night shifts, including coping with stress related to circadian disruption. Minimum requirement EASA Part Med Cabin Crew and Finnair regulations.
- Normal colour vision and normal hearing, distant visual acuity using both eyes 0.7 or better (with or without corrective lenses)
- Ability to swim 40 meters
- When wearing a uniform, all visible tattoos must be fully covered, and all visible piercings must be removed (excl. earrings)
- Clean criminal record
- Valid Japanese or EU, EEA or Swiss passport allowing free worldwide travel
- Willing to live and work permanently in Finland and arrive to Helsinki Airport within one hour when on stand-by

Working at Finnair:

We offer you an exciting opportunity to work in the fast-changing aviation and international travel industry in a culture that drives and enables professional development and continuous improvement. You will be supported by internally highly rated supervisory work with modern leadership practices that we constantly develop.

We are happy to enable our employees to enrich their lives and fulfil their travel dreams by offering a wideleisuretravel benefit. We also support the health and wellbeing of our employees through our own Sickness Fund insurance benefit,Epassi(sport, culture, wellbeing or commuting benefit), gyms around the Finnair campus and activities organized by our hobby clubs.

Before employment, selected candidates will participate in a non-paid training course of 6-9 weeks. 100% on-site attendance at our training facilities in Vantaa is required. Successfully passed cabin crew training is a prerequisite for employment. Training is unpaid and begins gradually in the beginning of 2027.

Please note that the hiring process includes a pre-employment security clearance and a medical examination, including a drug test.

To make sure you have all the details you need about the recruitment process, training, health requirements and more, please take a moment to visit:https://www.barona.fi/tyopaikat/finnair-japan-avoimet-tyopaikat/

Fasten your seatbelt and apply now but no later than 6.9.2026 23:59 EET. title: Cabin Crew Member Helsinki Base, Finnair
description:
Finnair is a diverse community of professionals who work ambitiously with a big heart and commitment. A strong safety culture is our priority and at the core of our everyday work, never taking it for granted. We are committed to doing our share in solving the climate challenge by determinedly following our science-based pathway to decarbonize our operations. We find meaning in our purpose: With our heart in Finland, we make every journey better, today and tomorrow. Our values - Always Safe, Customer at Heart and Stronger Together - guide us in everything we do.

Finnair Cabin Crew recruitment for 2027 is now open! Are you ready to be part of the Finnair team where the sky isn't the limit? We offer both permanent and fixed-term full-time employment opportunities. Join us as cabin crew member and discover a career that's always uplifting. Your journey to the skies starts here!

As a cabin crew member, you are responsible for ensuring cabin safety and delivering excellent customer service on Finnair flights. Being a part of Finnair cabin crew means that you provide the best possible experience and meaningful encounters for our customers.

What we are looking for and what we expect from you:

- Positive attitude and excellent customer service skills
- Excellent teamwork skills in a diverse environment
- Sales-oriented mindset and good communication skills
- Ability to work according to procedures and guidelines
- Resilience, persistence, and ability to adapt to changing situations

What is required to become a Cabin Crew Member at Finnair?

- Age of at least 18 years old
- Secondary education completed (upper secondary/vocational school)
- Fluency in English
- Fluency in Finnish is highly valued (additional languages are an advantage)
- Height minimum 160 cm and ability to reach 218 cm barefoot
- At least 1 year of experience in hospitality or customer service
- Good general health and the ability to work irregular hours and night shifts, including coping with stress related to circadian disruption. Minimum requirement EASA Part Med Cabin Crew and Finnair regulations.
- Normal colour vision and normal hearing, distant visual acuity using both eyes 0.7 or better (with or without corrective lenses)
- Ability to swim 40 meters
- When wearing a uniform, all visible tattoos must be fully covered, and all visible piercings must be removed (excl. earrings)
- Clean criminal record
- Valid EU, EEA or Swiss passport allowing free worldwide travel
- Eligible to live and work permanently in Finland and arrive to Helsinki Airport within one hour when on stand-by

Working at Finnair:

We offer you an exciting opportunity to work in the fast-changing aviation and international travel industry in a culture that drives and enables professional development and continuous improvement. You will be supported by internally highly rated supervisory work with modern leadership practices that we constantly develop.

We are happy to enable our employees to enrich their lives and fulfil their travel dreams by offering a wideleisuretravel benefit. We also support the health and wellbeing of our employees through our own Sickness Fund insurance benefit,Epassi(sport, culture, wellbeing or commuting benefit), gyms around the Finnair campus and activities organized by our hobby clubs.

Before employment, selected candidates will participate in a non-paid training course of 6-9 weeks. 100% on-site attendance at our training facilities in Vantaa is required. Successfully passed cabin crew training is a prerequisite for employment. Training is unpaid and begins gradually in the beginning of 2027.

Please note that the hiring process includes a pre-employment security clearance and a medical examination, including a drug test.

To make sure you have all the details you need about the recruitment process, training, health requirements and more, please take a moment to visit: https://www.barona.fi/tyopaikat/finnair/

title: CSRD Reporting Expert, (Project Manager)
description:
Tokmannin halvat hinnat tuottavat iloa ja hyötyä, sekä helpottavat asiakkaan elämää. Työskentelemme yhdessä tämän tavoitteen puolesta ja tarjoamme asiakkaillemme halvan hinnan lisäksi myös sujuvan ja nopean asioinnin myymälöissämme sekä laajan ja vastuullisesti hankitun ja tuotetun tuotevalikoiman. Tokmanni Group Oyj on yksi Pohjoismaiden johtavista halpakauppakonserneista. Onnistuneen asiakaskokemuksen takaamiseksi työskentelemme yli 6000 työntekijän voimin yhteensä yli 370:ssä Tokmanni-, Dollarstore-, Bigdollar-, Miny-, Click Shoes- ja Shoe House -myymälässämme sekä verkkokaupoissamme. Vuonna 2023 Tokmanni-konsernin liikevaihto oli 1 392,7 miljoonaa euroa ja vertailukelpoinen liikevoitto 98,8 miljoonaa euroa. Tokmanni Group Oyj:n osakkeet on listattu Nasdaq Helsingin pörssilistalle. Meille tokmannilaisille on tärkeää, että toimimme vastuullisesti ja tehokkaasti ympäristöstä ja ihmisistä välittäen. Kannustamme sekä autamme henkilöstöämme kehittämään osaamistaan ja panostamme hyvään yhteishenkeen. Avaamme jatkuvasti uusia myymälöitä ja rekrytoimme uusia osaajia. Etsimme joukkoomme erilaisilla osaamistaustoilla varustettuja henkilöitä monenlaisiin työtehtäviin. www.tokmanni.fi https://tyopaikat.tokmanni.fi/

Would you like to play a key role in shaping and delivering sustainability reporting in a leading Nordic retail group? We are looking for an experienced CSRD Reporting Expert to lead our CSRD reporting and reporting development projects. Position is in Tokmanni Group's Sustainability team and for a one-year parental leave replacement.

In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating and delivering Tokmanni Group's CSRD reporting and supporting the continuous development of reporting processes and practices. The position plays a key role in ensuring high-quality sustainability disclosures and compliance with evolving reporting requirements.

While the title includes project management responsibilities, we are primarily looking for a hands-on sustainability reporting professional. You have personally worked on CSRD reporting, collected and validated sustainability data, interpreted reporting requirements, and written report content. We are primarily looking for candidates who have hands-on experience preparing CSRD reports for listed companies, either in-house or in a consulting role. Success in this role requires both project leadership skills in cross company network and extensive hands-on experience in sustainability reporting, combined with deep practical expertise in the European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS) and their application in corporate reporting.



Your key responsibilities

- Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of Tokmanni Group's CSRD reporting process
- Collect, analyze, validate, and manage sustainability-related data across the organization
- Prepare and develop sustainability report content in line with ESRS requirements
- Interpret sustainability reporting regulations and translate regulatory requirements into practical reporting actions
- Support the update and further development of the Group's Double Materiality Assessment
- Develop reporting processes, data management practices, and reporting tools
- Produce and review reporting materials in both Finnish and English
- Coordinate and review translations between Finnish and English to ensure consistency and quality
- Work closely with stakeholders across sustainability, finance, HR, procurement, legal, marketing, business operations, and external assurance providers.



What we expect from you

- Hands-on experience preparing CSRD reporting in a listed company or as a consultant supporting listed companies
- Proven track record in sustainability data collection, data management and drafting CSRD-compliant sustainability report content
- Deep and comprehensive expertise in the ESRS standards and demonstrated ability to apply them in practice within CSRD reporting
- Strong understanding of the sustainability reporting regulatory landscape and reporting frameworks
- Excellent written communication skills and experience drafting reporting content
- Fluency in both Finnish and English, with the ability to translate and adapt content between the two languages. Proficiency in Swedish is considered an asset.
- Strong analytical skills and exceptional attention to detail
- A structured, self-driven, and solution-oriented way of working
- Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to drive progress without formal authority. - Ability to start working as soon as possible.

We also value experience in double materiality assessments, reporting system development, and knowledge of the retail or consumer goods industry.



What we offer

We offer you a unique opportunity to work at the heart of sustainability reporting in one of Finland's leading retail groups. You will have a visible and impactful role, working with a broad range of stakeholders and contributing to the development of Tokmanni Group's sustainability reporting and reporting capabilities.

You will join a friendly and supportive team where collaboration is valued and success is achieved together. We offer a flexible hybrid working model that combines office and remote working, enabling both effective teamwork and focused individual work.

In addition, we provide a competitive package of employee benefits, including ePassi, staff discounts, and a wide range of partner benefits.



Application instructions and further information

The position is a fixed-term parental leave replacement for one year. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found. The weekly working hours are 37.5 h/week. The primary workplace is Tokmanni Group's Head Office in Mäntsälä, Finland, and the role follows the Group's hybrid working model. Occasional travel within the Group may be required.

Please submit your application, CV, and salary expectation as soon as possible or at the latest on August 28th. We will review applications during the application period and fill the position immediately once the right candidate is found.

Further information will be given by Kaisa Matsson, Group Head of Sustainability tel. 040 6734948 or by email kaisa.mattson@tokmanni.fi. Please call on Wednesday Aug 19th 9-12 and Friday Aug 21st 10-13.

title: Accountant, Espoo
description:
About the role

In this role, you will support our client with general ledger accounting and month-end closing activities. You will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy and clarity of financial data, while actively developing and automating processes in close collaboration with other team members. Our client is best suited for someone with a genuine "hunger for success", a drive to push things forward, and the ability to thrive in a changing environment while seeing change as an opportunity.

You are offered
- The opportunity to work in a global, growing organization
- The opportunity to make an impact and bring the value of your expertise to the organization as it matures around you
- The opportunity to influence day-to-day operations and develop them with your own ideas
- Partial remote work (2 days/week) and an Epassi lunch benefit

Work tasks

The role includes general ledger accounting tasks such as postings, reconciliations, and month-end closing activities. You will work closely with the team to ensure the smoothness and accuracy of financial processes.
- Maintaining the general ledger
- Preparing journal entries
- Month-end closing activities
- Balance sheet reconciliations
- Recording payments from bank statements
- Creating and developing documentation
- Communicating within the organization when investigating accounting transactions

We are looking for

- A relevant higher education degree in finance or accounting, preferably with a focus on accounting
- Strong practical skills and work experience in general ledger activities, including reconciliations, month-end closing, journal entries, balance sheet reconciliations, and a solid understanding of accounting principles
- Demonstrated experience in streamlining tasks or automating workflows, along with a strong interest in leveraging AI tools in daily financial operations
- An ambitious and self-driven mindset with the tenacity to take ownership and push initiatives across the finish line
- Strong communication skills with fluency in written and spoken English
- Ability to navigate a changing organization and adapt to a rapidly evolving environment
- A precise, detail-oriented, and quality-driven working approach

It is meritorious if you have
- Experience with Netsuite ERP system

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
- Change oriented
- Excellent collaborator and communicator
- Organized and detail-oriented

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

title: Uinninvalvoja/uimaopettaja
description:
Vetelin liikuntakeskuksessa ja uimahallilla liikutetaan paljon ihmisiä ja siten siellä tehdään merkityksellistä hyvinvointityötä. Etsimme joukkoomme toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen uinninvalvoja/uimaopettajaa, joka työskentelee asiakaspalveluhenkisellä, innostavalla ja kehittävällä työotteella. Tehtävä täytetään 1.10.2026 tai sopimuksen mukaan. Viikkotyöaika on 38,25 h / vk. Työhön sisältyy päivä- ja iltatyötä sekä mahdollisesti myös viikonlopputyötä.

Työtehtäviin kuuluu uinninvalvonnan ja uimaopetuksen perustehtävien lisäksi vesijumppien ja mahdollisesti myös muiden liikuntaryhmien ohjaaminen, viestintä ja markkinointi, tapahtumien suunnittelu ja toteuttaminen, toiminnan organisointi, tilavarausjärjestelmän käyttö ja laskutus sekä liikuntakeskus- ja uimahallitoiminnan suunnitteluun ja kehittämiseen osallistuminen. Työn menestyksellinen hoitaminen edellyttää hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja, positiivisuutta, aktiivisuutta, organisointitaitoa sekä vastuullisuutta ja huolellisuutta. Myös perustietotekniset taidot ovat tarpeelliset.

Uinninvalvoja/uimaopettajan tehtävän kelpoisuusvaatimuksena on liikunta-alan koulutus tai muu alalle soveltuva koulutus sekä lisäksi katsomme eduksi SUH:n uinninvalvojan ja/tai uimaopettajan koulutuksen. Tehtävä edellyttää hyvää uimataitoa ja uinninvalvojan testiuinti tullaan suorittamaan todennäköisesti keväällä 2027. Eduksi katsomme ensiapukoulutuksen ja kokemuksen uinninvalvonnasta/uimaopetustyöstä/ryhmien ohjaamisesta.

Tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 2315,11 € ja lisäksi tulevat mahdolliset työkokemuslisät. Koeaika on kuusi (6) kuukautta. Valitun tulee esittää lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä annetun lain (504/2002) mukainen rikosrekisteriote 30 vuorokauden sisällä työn aloittamisesta.

Jatkamme hakuaikaa ja aikaisemmin tehtävään hakeneet huomioidaan. Hakuaika päättyy 6.9.2026 ja hakemukset toimitetaan tähän päivämäärään mennessä sähköisesti Kuntarekryn kautta. Hakemukseen tulee liittää CV ja todistus koulutuksesta. Valinnasta tiedotamme kaikkia hakijoita Kuntarekryn kautta sähköisesti.

Olemme arvostettu työnantaja, kehitämme aktiivisesti toimintojamme ja edistämme kuntalaisten hyvinvointia eri tavoin. Tarjoamme työntekijöillemme maksuttoman uimahallin ja kuntosalin käytön sekä 100 euron Epassi-edun. Olemme savuton kunta.

title: Research specialist (Grant writer)

In the coming years, we expect our activities within international cooperation and partnership projects to continue to grow.

Novia's ambition is to promote and strengthen our international RDI activities and to create better conditions for securing competitive funding, primarily through European funding instruments.

As a Research Specialist, your primary responsibility is to actively contribute to the preparation and development of funding applications at the Faculties of Business, Health and Welfare, as well as Arts and Culture. When needed, you also contribute to the development of Novia's RDI activities and strategic initiatives beyond the preparation of funding applications.

We are looking for someone who

- Holds a relevant doctoral degree.
- Has at least three years of experience in research, research support services, or research funding.
- Has a proven track record of developing competitive research proposals, particularly for EU funding instruments.
- Has excellent communication skills in English; good knowledge of Swedish and/or Finnish is considered an asset.
- Has strong organisational skills, including the ability to prioritise tasks, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and meet deadlines.
- Has good knowledge of responsible research practices.
- Has a goal-oriented approach to work and strong collaboration skills.

Employment

Starting from October 12, 2026, or as agreed.

With the applicant's consent, a limited security clearance/check may be conducted.

Salary in accordance with the collective agreement for universities of applied sciences and Novia's internal guidelines. The position includes a sixmonth probationary period.

Location

As agreed: Vaasa, Turku, or Jakobstad.

Further Information

Contact Head of Research Services Otto Långvik, mobile +358 50 527 8167, firstname.lastname@novia.fi

Application

We look forward to receiving your application no later than September 4, 2026. Applications are to be submitted through our electronic system. Please attach a cover letter and a CV to your application. A preassignment may be requested from applicants.

title: Sales Representative – Saariselkä, Lapland
description:
**Kuukkeli & Lapponia Tours are looking for a Travel Sales Representative to strengthen our growing sales team in Saariselkä.**

We are looking for an active, self-driven and customer-oriented sales professional to work with our wide range of tourism services. In this role, you will sell and build travel packages that may include accommodation, activities, transportation, restaurant services and other Lapland travel services.

Our customers include both domestic and international individual travellers, groups, companies, travel agencies and tour operators.

This position is suitable for someone who enjoys sales, working with people and varied working days, and who is able to independently manage customer relationships and sales processes from enquiry to completion.

**Your responsibilities may include, among other things:**

- selling accommodation, activities, transportation and other tourism services

- active customer acquisition and identifying new sales opportunities

- handling individual, group and corporate bookings

- preparing quotations and complete travel packages

- communicating with domestic and international customers

- serving B2B customers, tour operators and travel agencies

- acquiring new customers and developing existing customer relationships

- handling incoming sales enquiries and quotation requests by email and phone

- creating and updating reservations in our booking systems

- working closely with reception, activities, transportation and other operational teams

- sales-related maintenance of products, pricing and availability

- participating in the development of our sales operations and tourism services when needed


The exact responsibilities can also be adjusted based on the selected candidates previous experience and strengths.

**What do we expect from you?**

We are looking for someone with a strong commercial mindset, a results-oriented attitude and previous experience in tourism, sales or another similar commercial role. This position is not intended for someone completely at the beginning of their career. We expect you to be ready to take responsibility for customer relationships, sales and quotation processes with a fairly independent approach.

**We hope you have:**

- a strong customer service and sales mindset

- **fluent English skills**

- good Finnish language skills

- strong written and verbal communication skills

- the ability to work independently and take responsibility for your own tasks

- an organised and detail-oriented way of working

- the ability to manage several customer relationships and sales processes simultaneously

- a proactive and active approach to sales

- good general IT skills


Previous experience in tourism sales, hotel reservations, group sales, B2B sales or working with tour operators is considered an advantage.

Experience with tourism booking and sales systems is beneficial, but the most important thing is the ability to learn new systems quickly. We provide comprehensive training in our products and the systems we use.

Additional language skills are considered an advantage.

**What do we offer?**

We offer a responsible and diverse sales position in a rapidly growing tourism business in Saariselkä.

**You will get:**

- a varied role working with accommodation, activities and other tourism services

- the opportunity to work with both B2C and B2B customers
