title: Architecte Cyber Sécurité Senior (H/F)
description:
Entreprise

Chez Vestrala, nous accompagnons les grandes entreprises dans leurs projets de transformation IT, de cybersécurité et de modernisation des systèmes d'information. Notre approche est pragmatique, orientée résultats et centrée sur la création de valeur.

Dans le cadre du renforcement des équipes cybersécurité de l'un de nos clients grands comptes, nous recherchons un(e) Architecte Cybersécurité Senior capable d'intervenir aussi bien sur les enjeux d'architecture que sur l'accompagnement des équipes de développement et des programmes de transformation.

Poste

Vous intervenez au sein d'une équipe d'experts cybersécurité afin d'accompagner les équipes projets dans la conception et la sécurisation des solutions techniques.

À ce titre, vous serez notamment amené(e) à :

  * Définir et promouvoir les architectures de sécurité des applications, infrastructures et environnements Cloud.
  * Accompagner les équipes Agile dans la mise en œuvre des bonnes pratiques DevSecOps.
  * Élaborer les exigences de sécurité et les référentiels techniques.
  * Valider la conformité cybersécurité des nouveaux socles techniques et applications.
  * Challenger les résultats des audits de sécurité (pentests, Red Team) et accompagner la remédiation.
  * Réaliser une veille technologique permanente sur les nouvelles menaces et les innovations du marché.
  * Participer à l'amélioration continue de la stratégie cybersécurité.
  * Accompagner le déploiement de solutions de sécurité (CNAPP, DLP, SSE, DMARC, Cloud souverain.).
  * Contribuer aux projets liés au chiffrement de nouvelle génération et à la préparation de la transition post-quantique.
  * Accompagner l'intégration de l'IA dans les processus de sécurisation des applications.

Profil

Vous disposez de 10 années d'expérience minimum en cybersécurité, avec une solide expérience en architecture de sécurité et une réelle culture technique.

Vous maîtrisez notamment :

  * Architecture de sécurité applicative et Cloud
  * DevSecOps (SSDLC, SAST, DAST, SCA, CNAPP, CSPM.)
  * Sécurité offensive (Pentest, Red Team)
  * Réseaux, API, Web, Systèmes et Cloud
  * Évaluation des risques (ISO 27001, NIST.)
  * IAM : OIDC, SAML, SCIM
  * AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, VMware
  * Linux, Windows et macOS
  * PKI, certificats, KMS/HSM
  * Méthodologies Agile / Scrum / SAFe
  * Technologies IA (LLM, MCP, Copilot, Mistral, Agents IA)



Une expérience en développement logiciel constitue un véritable atout.

### Certifications appréciées

  * Certification Cloud Provider (AWS, Azure ou GCP)
  * CISSP
  * GIAC
  * Certification SAFe appréciée



## Les qualités que nous recherchons

  * Excellente capacité d'analyse
  * Forte orientation client
  * Esprit d'initiative
  * Autonomie
  * Qualités rédactionnelles
  * Rigueur et sens de l'organisation
  * Capacité à évoluer dans des environnements complexes et exigeants.



## Pourquoi rejoindre Vestrala ?

  * Des missions à forte valeur ajoutée auprès de grands comptes.
  * Des projets innovants autour du Cloud, de l'IA et de la cybersécurité.
  * Une entreprise à taille humaine où expertise, proximité et confiance sont au cœur de notre ADN.
  * De réelles perspectives d'évolution au sein d'un cabinet en pleine croissance.

description:
Start: asap

We are recruiting for a skilled E-Bike Mechanic to join a growing urban mobility team in Paris. You will maintain, diagnose, and repair a fleet of electric bicycles and light electric vehicles, ensuring safe, reliable service for customers. This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on technician who enjoys troubleshooting electrical and mechanical systems in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

Your Role

- Perform routine maintenance, inspections, and servicing on e-bikes and associated components (motors, batteries, controllers, brakes, drivetrains, suspension).
- Diagnose and repair electrical faults, mechanical issues, and software or connectivity problems using diagnostic tools and technical documentation.
- Assemble and prepare new e-bikes for deployment, including final quality checks and test rides.
- Replace and fit parts (tyres, tubes, brake pads, cables, batteries) and manage stock of common spare parts and consumables.
- Log work completed and fault findings accurately in the maintenance system, including recommendations for recurring issues.
- Collaborate with operations and customer support to prioritise repairs and respond to urgent service requests.

- Maintain a clean, safe workshop environment and follow health & safety procedures at all times.

Your Qualifications

- Proven experience as a bicycle mechanic, ideally with specific experience repairing e-bikes or light electric vehicles.
- Good understanding of electric drivetrain components, battery systems, wiring, and basic electronics; able to read wiring diagrams and use multimeters.
- Competence with standard mechanical tools and workshop equipment, and experience with wheel truing, brake adjustment, and gear indexing.
- Fluent in French; good English is an advantage. Communication should be clear and customer-focused.
- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Valid right to work in France and willingness to work occasional early starts or weekends as required by operations.
- Relevant vocational qualifications (e.g., cycle mechanic certificate, electrical or mechanical apprenticeship) are desirable but practical experience will be considered.

The Offer

- Permanent full-time contract based in Paris with competitive salary depending on experience.
- Paid training on company-specific e-bike systems and safety procedures.
- Comprehensive benefits package including health coverage contributions and transport allowances.
- Opportunity to work with a sustainable mobility provider and contribute to greener urban transport.
- Supportive, multicultural team environment and clear progression routes within operations and technical roles.
- Modern workshop facilities in Paris, with supplied tools and PPE.

Le poste :

Au sein de l'équipe Sécurité & Identité (IAM / CIAM), vous serez responsable de la conception, de la personnalisation et de l'intégration de la solution d'authentification et de gestion des accès Keycloak. Vous interviendrez notamment sur l'implémentation de parcours d'authentification sécurisés (MFA) et le développement de modules Java sur mesure.

Missions Principales
- Développement & Personnalisation Keycloak : Développement de SPI (Service Provider Interfaces), d'authentificateurs personnalisés, d'évènements et d'extensions en Java / Jakarta EE.
- Authentification & MFA : Configuration, personnalisation et intégration de flux d'authentification forte (MFA, WebAuthn, TOTP, SMS, OTP) et gestion des politiques de sécurité.
- Intégration IAM / CIAM : Configuration des Realms, des clients (OpenID Connect / OAuth2, SAML v2) et fédération d'identités (LDAP, Active Directory, Identity Providers externes).
- Personnalisation UI/UX : Adaptation des thèmes de connexion et du parcours utilisateur (Freemarker, HTML/CSS, JavaScript).

MCO :
- Maintien en condition opérationnelle
- Montées de version Keycloak
- Écriture de tests et intégration dans les pipelines CI/CD (Docker, Kubernetes/Helm).

Compétences techniques obligatoires :
Java 11+ / Jakarta EE : Développement d'extensions / SPI pour Keycloak.
Keycloak (Core) : Maîtrise des concepts d'Authentication Flows, Execution Steps, SPI (Authenticator, EventListenerProvider, UserStorageProvider).
Sécurité & MFA : Implémentation du MFA (TOTP, WebAuthn, OTP personnalisés).

Les plus appréciés : Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Operator, Quarkus.

Profil Recherché

title: Technik. Kunden. Verantwortung. Und ein Team, auf das du dich verlassen kannst. (IT-System-Elektroniker/in)
description:
Du suchst keinen Job, bei dem du morgens deinen Rechner einschaltest und abends einfach wieder ausmachst?

Du willst Technik nicht nur installieren, sondern verstehen, Probleme lösen und beim Kunden wirklich etwas bewegen?

Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

OrgaMAXX.IT GmbH ist ein wachsendes IT-Systemhaus mit rund 45 Mitarbeitenden. Wir kümmern uns um die IT-, Druck- und Kopiersysteme unserer Kunden in der Region – und sorgen dafür, dass deren Technik einfach funktioniert.

Unser Motto:

„Wir kümmern uns um Ihre IT, damit Sie sich auf Ihr Unternehmen konzentrieren können.“

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab sofort einen

IT-Systemelektroniker (m/w/d)

Arbeitsort: Neuhofen

Was dich bei uns erwartet

Bei uns bist du nicht nur „der Techniker“. Du bist Ansprechpartner, Problemlöser, Tüftler und manchmal auch derjenige, der aus einem scheinbar unlösbaren Technikproblem doch noch eine Lösung zaubert.

Deine Aufgaben sind abwechslungsreich und führen dich sowohl in unsere Werkstatt als auch direkt zu unseren Kunden:

- Installation, Wartung, Fehleranalyse und Instandsetzung von Multifunktions- und Drucksystemen
- Technischer Support bei unseren Kunden – vor Ort und remote
- Installation und Einrichtung von Hardware, Software, Komponenten und Zubehör
- Einweisung unserer Kunden in neue Systeme und Lösungen
- Installation und Betreuung von Druck- und Flottenmanagement-Lösungen
- Analyse und Behebung technischer Störungen
- Unterstützung unseres First-Level-Supports
- Technische Beratung unserer Kunden und Kollegen
- Zusammenarbeit mit nahezu allen Bereichen unseres Unternehmens

Kurz gesagt: Kein Tag ist wie der andere.

Was du mitbringen solltest

Du musst bei uns nicht alles können. Aber du solltest Lust darauf haben, Dinge zu verstehen, Probleme anzupacken und dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Idealerweise bringst du mit:

- Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum IT-Systemelektroniker (m/w/d), Fachinformatiker (m/w/d) oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation
- Berufserfahrung im technischen IT-Umfeld ist wünschenswert
- Technisches Verständnis und Spaß daran, Fehlern auf den Grund zu gehen
- Interesse an IT, Netzwerken, Hardware und modernen Technologien
- Eine selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
- Lösungsorientiertes Denken – du suchst nicht nach Gründen, warum etwas nicht funktioniert, sondern nach Wegen, wie es funktioniert
- Freundliches und sicheres Auftreten im Umgang mit Kunden
- Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Führerschein Klasse B
- Teamgeist und die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen

Was wir dir bieten

Wir wollen, dass du bei uns nicht einfach nur arbeitest, sondern dich langfristig wohlfühlst und weiterentwickeln kannst.

Deshalb bieten wir dir:

- Einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz in einem wachsenden Unternehmen
- Abwechslungsreiche technische Aufgaben statt täglicher Routine
- Viel Eigenverantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege
- Die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen und Arbeitsprozesse mitzugestalten
- Regelmäßige Schulungen und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
- Herstellerschulungen direkt bei unseren Partnern und Lieferanten
- Ein fachlich breit aufgestelltes und hilfsbereites Team
- Einen respektvollen Umgang auf Augenhöhe
- Moderne Technologien und abwechslungsreiche Kundenprojekte
- Einen Arbeitsplatz, an dem du nicht nur eine Nummer bist
- Regelmäßige Team-Events
- Kostenfreie Getränke

Und was uns besonders wichtig ist:

Wir suchen keinen perfekten Lebenslauf. Wir suchen jemanden, der zu uns passt.

Wenn du gerne selbstständig arbeitest, Technik dich wirklich interessiert und du Lust hast, gemeinsam mit einem starken Team etwas zu bewegen, dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

Klingt nach deinem nächsten Job?

Dann schick uns deine Bewerbung an:

jobs@orgamaxx.de

Wir freuen uns darauf, von dir zu hören.

title: ICT Risk Oversight Specialist (f/m/d)
description:
ICT Risk Oversight Specialist (f/m/d)
Location: Luxembourg, LU
Company: Deutsche Börse Group
Your area of work:

Clearstream is a large international financial institution offering post-trade infrastructure and securities services for the international and domestic markets worldwide.

The ICT risk management control function plays a pivotal role in safeguarding our organization against technological and information security risks. We partner closely with product, technology, security, and risk teams to ensure the resilience of our systems and services. We actively manage technology risks, steer ICT risk governance and framework design, perform focused risk assurance, and enable compliance for legal entities, branches, and representative offices in scope with direct reporting line to the corresponding executive boards.
The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of technology and security frameworks, risk management practices, and regulations, also comfortable working cross functionally.

Your responsibilities:

• Monitor technology and security risks, providing independent oversight, and challenging the first line of defense when necessary.
• Assist in developing, implementing and maintaining a DORA-complaint ICT Risk oversight program while working closely with ICT Risk Governance, ICT Risk Assurance, and other relevant teams.
• Support the oversight of digital operational resilience posture and advise on necessary technology risk control requirements. Stay updated with emerging trends and align these with organizational plans.
• Work with relevant functions across the three lines of defense to gather digital resilience requirements, ensure alignment, and meet compliance expectations.
• Offer insights from a technology risk perspective on key digital transformation initiatives, resilience testing, ICT third party supplier risk, and other key areas.
• Assist in aligning digital operational resilience with strategic goals. Provide recommendations based on evolving threats, risk appetite, business strategy, and regulatory changes.
• Define, monitor, and report on risk metrics and key performance indicators. Support the preparation and delivery of ICT risk reports to senior management.
• Lead ICT risk regulatory watch and intelligence activities, continuously monitoring evolving regulatory requirements (e.g., DORA), industry standards, and supervisory expectations
• Translate regulatory developments into actionable insights and impacts for the organization.
• Proactively advise stakeholders on upcoming changes and required adaptations to maintain compliance and resilience.

Your profile:

• 5+ years of experience in technology governance, risk, and compliance.
• University degree in Computer Science, Technology Risk, Cyber Security, or related field.
• Strong understanding of technology and security frameworks, risk management principles, and comfortable working cross functionally.
• Experience and analytical skills understanding, structuring, and explaining complex topics; end-to-end thinking required.
• Can turn incomplete, unstructured, or ambiguous data points into structured outcomes and pragmatic action plans.
• Experience working with technology regulations, international standards, or best practices.
• Stakeholders' management skills and capacity to manage priorities simultaneously.
• High self-responsibility & ownership; result orientation and customer focus.
• Proficiency in written and spoken English (must), as well as in German (nice to have).

Berufserfahrung im Einkauf, in der Beschaffung oder im Groß- und Außenhandel wünschenswert

title: Program Lead Finance (f/m/d) - SAP S/4HANA Energy Large Steam & Syncons (LSS) (Leiter/in - Projekt-/Programmmanagement)
employer: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As Program Lead Finance (f/m/d), you lead the Finance transformation for Large Steam & Syncons (LSS) while serving as co-lead of the overall LSS rollout within Siemens Energy's global S4Energy program.
In this project-driven Engineer-to-Order (ETO) business, you act as the key Finance & Controlling representative, ensuring that business requirements are translated into scalable SAP S/4HANA solutions. Working closely with Finance, Controlling, Manufacturing, and global program teams, you steer critical decisions across project controlling, product costing, manufacturing controlling, and financial closing.
From shaping target processes and driving testing activities to coordinating cutover, go-live, and change management, you combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution to deliver a successful and sustainable business transformation.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Lead the Finance transformation and co-lead the S4Energy rollout for Large Steam & Syncons, ensuring alignment across stakeholders and program objectives
* Drive end-to-end Finance implementation activities, including requirements management, process design, Fit-Gap workshops, testing, data migration, cutover, go-live, and hypercare
* Harmonize Finance & Controlling processes by balancing business requirements with SAP S/4HANA standards and scalable best practices
* Coordinate cross-functional rollout activities and manage dependencies across Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and IT
* Build and leverage a global Siemens Energy transformation network to share best practices and accelerate implementation success
* Lead stakeholder engagement and change management initiatives to ensure organizational readiness and sustainable adoption

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field
* Extensive experience in SAP S/4HANA Finance & Controlling, including leading complex implementation and business transformation programs
* Strong expertise in Record-to-Report, Project Controlling, Product Costing, Manufacturing Controlling, and Financial Closing
* Solid understanding of Engineer-to-Order (ETO) business processes and end-to-end value flows across project execution and manufacturing
* Excellent stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and leadership skills with experience aligning global cross-functional teams
* Fluency in German and English, enabling effective collaboration in an international environment

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof,
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings,
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

title: Software Engineer II, Display Retention - Vendor | (Application-Engineer/-Manager/in)
description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

We are on the lookout for a (Software) Engineer - Golang to join our Adtech Retention team.

Contribute to the creation/improvement of our next-generation services, which provide actionable insights to our advertiser consumers, empowering them to make real, data-driven decisions that contribute to the growth of our adtech business. If you're a creative problem solver who is eager to deliver solutions and hungry for a new adventure, an international workplace is waiting for you in the heart of Berlin!

- You'll contribute to both established and emerging services, constantly seeking opportunities for experimentation and open communication.
- Your role will involve contributing to software architecture and effectively communicating with engineers, product managers, partners, leaders, and diverse stakeholders.
- You are adept at building reliable, scalable systems with high concurrency and are eager to learn new languages and technologies.
- You don't shy away from building reliable, scalable systems with high concurrency and are always eager to learn new languages and technologies. Your decisions will make an impact since your ideas and efforts do matter.
- Eventually, you are not afraid to build global systems that are used by thousands of people and constantly drive for excellence.
- You will work in a goal-driven environment, you're eager to build, test, learn from the results, and then refine your approach.

Qualifications

- Golang & Distributed Systems Expertise – 2+ years of experience in Golang, with a strong foundational understanding of distributed systems and services.
- Backend & Microservices Development – Hands-on experience in implementing RESTful and/or gRPC services, building and maintaining microservices with Kubernetes, and following best practices for inter-service communication.
- Large-Scale Applications & Agile Methodologies – 2+ years of experience working on software applications with experience in agile environments.
- Cloud & Infrastructure – Professional experience or familiarity with AWS or GCP, and infrastructure management using Terraform, CloudFormation, or Helm.
- Software Engineering Excellence – Strong Computer Science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, software design) with a focus on high-quality code, automated testing, and best practices.
- High sense of onus, collaborative and excellent communicator.
Nice to Have:
- Infrastructure & Observability – Familiarity with CI/CD tools (Drone, Spinnaker) and monitoring/logging tools (Grafana, Prometheus, Datadog, distributed tracing).
- Messaging & Caching – Hands-on experience with Kafka for real-time data processing.
- Database & Architecture Expertise – Strong knowledge of relational databases (PostgreSQL, ACID principles, indexing), event-driven architecture, as well as familiarity with BigQuery and data pipelines.

- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses.

title: Data Centre Installer (m/f/x) (Fachkraft - Logistik/Materialwirtschaft)
description:
Job Description

As part of the Arvato Group, we are seeking new team members for ATC Computer Transport & Logistics GmbH**, Hessenring 15L in 64546 Mörfelden-Walldorf. ATC is a global logistics, white-glove, and technical services specialist for data centres. For over 45 years, we've helped deliver Europe's data centres safely, securely, and right the first time. Our work includes specialist IT transport and relocations, as well as full data centre commissioning and decommissioning.

As a company within the Arvato Group, we benefit from the strength, scale, and global expertise of one of the world's leading supply chain and technology partners. What truly sets us apart, however, is our people. We invest in training, development, and continuous improvement, and we take pride in building long-term relationships with our clients and teams across Europe.

Data Centre Installers (DCIs) provide an essential service to our clients across Europe. They work inside our clients’ data centres delivering, positioning, and installing server racks to build their cloud infrastructure. Safety, security and customer service are the priorities for all ATC employees. Are you on it?

Your Responsibilities:

- Hardware Setup: Unloading, unpacking with power tools and positioning customers’ IT hardware (server racks). Cabling server racks by patching and dressing fibre and copper cables.
- Procedure Compliance: Following clients’ procedures and requirements, including health and safety, and security.
- Communication: Communicating with costumers, colleagues, managers, planners, team leaders and supervisors, in a consistent, timely, and efficient manner.
- Daily Reporting: Completing daily checklists and providing reports on daily activities or tasks.

Qualifications

- Strong organisational and problem-solving skills, with high levels of attention to detail
- Basic experience with hand and power tools
- Adaptability and responsiveness to evolving costumer requirements
- Valid class B driving licence with a good driving record
- Experience with Microsoft Word, Excel, Teams and Email
- Professional communications skills with clients, colleagues and vendors
- Language proficiency: C1 level in English and B2 level in German

title: (Senior) Key Account Manager*in für Öffentliche Beschaffung (w/m/d) (Key-Account-Manager/in)
description:
Bei Fairtrade Deutschland gestalten wir Zukunft – fair, partnerschaftlich, nachhaltig. Seit über 30 Jahren setzen wir uns weltweit durch unsere Initiativen für verantwortungsvolle Geschäftspraktiken, existenzsichernde Einkommen für Bauernfamilien und bessere Behandlung von Arbeiter*innen ein. Unsere Arbeit basiert auf sozialer Gerechtigkeit, bei der die Rechte der Menschen und der Schutz der Umwelt respektiert werden. Der Umsatz von Fairtrade-Produkten betrug 2025 rund 3,1 Mrd. Euro – eine Steigerung um fast 9 Prozent. Verbraucher*innen konnten aus über 8.700 Fairtrade-gesiegelten Produkten im Handel wählen.

Die öffentliche Beschaffung ist dabei ein wichtiger Hebel für nachhaltige Entwicklung. Öffentliche Auftraggeber vergeben jedes Jahr Aufträge für Waren und Dienstleistungen. Fairtrade Deutschland unterstützt Kommunen, Behörden und öffentliche Einrichtungen dabei, soziale und ökologische Kriterien in ihre Beschaffungs- und Vergabeprozesse zu integrieren. Gleichzeitig motivieren und beraten wir Unternehmen und weitere Geschäftspartner, sich erfolgreich an öffentlichen Ausschreibungen zu beteiligen und die Chancen nachhaltiger Beschaffung zu nutzen.

Für den Bereich Key Account Management Marken suchen wir eine/einen **(Senior) Key Account Manager für Öffentliche Beschaffung (w/m/d) in Köln**. Diese Stelle ist ab sofort in Teil- oder Vollzeit (80-100%) zu besetzen.

Deine neue Herausforderung:

- Fachpolitische Netzwerk- und Gremienarbeit: Du förderst die Verankerung von Fairtrade-Kriterien in öffentlichen Ausschreibungen und entwickelst zielgruppengerechte Präsentationen, um Geschäftspartner für öffentliche Vergabeverfahren zu gewinnen und zu begleiten.
- Entwicklung rohstoffspezifischer Markt- und Potenzialanalysen: Du identifizierst relevante Produktgruppen und Märkte in der öffentlichen Beschaffung und ermittelst relevante öffentliche Auftraggeber sowie deren Beschaffungsbedarfe. Du vernetzt diese mit bestehenden Fairtrade-Partnern, um konkrete Geschäftsmöglichkeiten einzuleiten.
- Beratung und Begleitung von Fairtrade Geschäftspartnern: Du unterstützt unsere Geschäftspartner bei der Identifikation relevanter Vergabeverfahren, berätst zu Fairtrade-Anforderungen und förderst und unterstützt sie bei deren erfolgreicher Beteiligung an öffentlichen Vergabeverfahren.
- Entwicklung eines Online-Angebots für Akteure: Du entwickelst eine zentrale Online-Plattform (ggfs. auch Weiterentwicklung von Fairtrade Select)  für nachhaltige und faire Beschaffung.

Bringe deinen Stärken ein:

- Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich öffentliche Beschaffung, Vergabewesen, Business Development, Vertrieb, Nachhaltigkeit und/oder Politik- und Netzwerkarbeit mit.
- Du kennst Dich aus mit öffentlichen Vergabeverfahren im Kontext nachhaltiger Beschaffung und hast im besten Fall auch schon ein solches Verfahren begleitet.  
- Ebenso vertraut bist Du mit sozialen und ökologischen Lieferketten und deren Zertifizierung im Rahmen der EU Regulatorik.
- Du verfügst bereits über ein Netzwerk von Entscheidern in relevanten Bereichen wie Bund, Länder, Kommunen, Universitäten, Schulen, Krankenhäuser, Bundeswehr, etc.
- Du selbst bist ein/e starke/r Netzwerker*in und hast Lust, neue Kontakte aufzubauen, und bestehende Strukturen  sinnvoll zu vernetzen.
- Wir erkennen in Dir eine/n seniore/n & überzeugende/n Berater*in, die auch die Bedarfe und Herausforderungen der Anbieterseite – vorwiegen (Marken-) Hersteller - versteht.

Womit wir dich überzeugen:

- Sinnstiftende Arbeit mit Impact: Bei uns kannst du einen Unterschied in der Welt bewirken und einen Mehrwert für die Gesellschaft durch deine Arbeit und deine Expertise schaffen.
- Klare Prozesse und Strukturen: Bei uns kannst du dich auf transparente und effiziente Arbeitsabläufe verlassen, die es dir ermöglichen, dich auf das Wesentliche zu konzentrieren und dein volles Potenzial auszuschöpfen.
- Wertschätzende Arbeitsatmosphäre: Wir legen großen Wert auf Respekt, Offenheit, Fürsorge und Anerkennung. Eine positive Arbeitsatmosphäre und -kultur, klare und offene Kommunikation auf Augenhöhe sowie ein fairer Zusammenhalt unter Kolleg*innen sind für uns selbstverständlich.
- Führung, die inspiriert: Bei uns stehen Coaching und Servant Leadership im Mittelpunkt unserer Kultur. Unsere Führungskräfte sind mehr als nur Vorgesetzte– sie sind Mentor*innen, die nicht nur kompetent, sondern auch empathisch und wertschätzend das Wachstum der Mitarbeiter*innen begleiten und unterstützen.
- Work-Life Balance: Uns liegt beides am Herzen: unsere Arbeit, die wir aus Überzeugung tun, und unser Privatleben. Darum pflegen wir eine Work-Life-Balance-Kultur, in der flexibles Arbeiten zu individuellen Arbeitszeiten und hybride Arbeitsmodelle keine Fremdworte sind. Dazu bieten wir 29 Tage Urlaub im Jahr.
- Inklusion: Wir sind auf dem Weg und noch nicht am Ziel, wenn es um Inklusion geht. Unsere Arbeitsplätze sind (zum Teil) barrierfrei (z.B. barrierefreie Toilette, höhenverstellbare Tische). Wir sehen es als unsere Verantwortung die Arbeitsumgebung inklusiver zu gestalten und unterstützen gerne bei benötigten Anpassungen.

Das ist uns wichtig:

Vielfalt wird bei uns großgeschrieben, daher begrüßen wir alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion und Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung. Für ein faires und vielfältiges Auswahlverfahren benötigen wir kein Bewerbungsfoto.

Wir unterstützen eine inklusive Arbeitsumgebung. Du brauchst Infos zur Barrierefreiheit bei uns oder Hilfe bei der Bewerbung? Dann wende dich gerne an unsere Ansprechperson:

Nele Broll

n.broll@fairtrade-deutschland.de (n.broll@fairtrade-deutschland.de)

+49 221 94 20 40 61

Im Sinne der Entgelttransparenz findest Du hier alle Informationen rund um unser Vergütungssystem: Benefits für Mitarbeitende bei Fairtrade | Fairtrade Deutschland (https://www.fairtrade.net/de-de/meta/Karriere/Benefits.html)

title: Sales Manager / Senior Account Manager – Battery Energy Storage, Germany (m/w/d) (Account-Manager/in)
description:
What to Expect

Tesla is seeking a talented Senior Account Manager to join our growing EMEA Megapack sales team. As a Senior Account Manager, you will lead the customer engagement, sales, and contracting efforts for our cutting-edge Megapack battery energy storage systems and industry-leading services.  By strengthening our energy infrastructure with Megapack, we create a cleaner and more stable grid. From conception to contract execution, you will close complex, multimillion-dollar deals, leading project teams with colleagues from engineering, operations, finance, service, and legal. To be successful in this role, you will bring strong technical knowledge of the utility-scale electricity industry and a proven track record of leading complex contract negotiations.  

What You’ll Do

- Drive negotiation and contracting of equipment supply agreements, EPC agreements, O&M agreements, and related software sales agreements
- Achieve sales goals by managing a project pipeline of opportunities spanning multiple countries, timelines and project types
- Develop sales opportunities by building and maintaining relationships with Independent Power Producers (IPPs), developers, and utilities
- Collaborate with internal stakeholders to define scope, terms, and pricing for battery storage projects meeting customers’ needs while protecting Tesla’s interests
- Contribute to the strategy for and preparation of tender responses, in collaboration with Tesla’s Bid Team
- Ensure accurate pipeline data and provide reporting to management
- Evaluate market dynamics and drivers. Provide key market insights to the broader Tesla team, determining and executing the most effective go-to-market strategies  

What You’ll Bring

- 7+ years of sales/account management experience in the utility-scale electric generation, transmission, or storage industry
- Demonstrated expertise in structuring and leading complex negotiations in energy, construction, project finance, or a related field. Experience in renewable energy industry is a plus
- Ability to identify problems, lead projects, and provide pragmatic solutions
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust with colleagues and customers
- Flexibility to travel (up to 50%)
- Fluency in English and German

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

title: IT-Systembetreuer*in mit Kundenverantwortung (IT-Systemadministrator/in)
description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
IT-Systembetreuer; IT-Kundenbetreuer; IT-Systemtechniker; IT-Support-Engineer

Stellenbeschreibung:
Wer wir sind

Als ibes AG stehen wir unseren Kunden seit über 25 Jahren als verlässlicher Partner rund um Digitalisierung und IT zur Seite. Mehr als 40 Mitarbeitende in 4 Teams betreuen, planen und realisieren IT-Lösungen für Unternehmen unterschiedlichster Branchen.

Wir beantworten alltägliche Anwenderfragen ebenso engagiert wie wir komplexe IT-Infrastrukturen planen und weiterentwickeln. Dabei setzen wir auf persönliche Ansprechpartner, langfristige Kundenbeziehungen und nachhaltige, fair kalkulierte IT-Lösungen.

Über 200 Kunden vertrauen uns seit vielen Jahren, weil wir Verantwortung übernehmen und Qualität liefern.

Wen wir suchen

Wir suchen Dich als engagierten und zuverlässigen IT-Systembetreuer (w/m/d) mit Freude an Kundenkontakt und Eigenverantwortung.

Du betreust feste Kunden ganzheitlich, bist deren erster Ansprechpartner für IT-Themen und verantwortest deren IT-Systeme von der Administration bis zur Weiterentwicklung. Dabei arbeitest Du selbstständig, wirst aber jederzeit von Deinem Team und internen Spezialisten unterstützt.

Willkommen sind alle Menschen, egal welchen Geschlechts, welcher Herkunft, Nationalität, sexuellen Orientierung und Religion.

Deine Aufgaben

- Ganzheitliche Betreuung kundenspezifischer IT-Infrastrukturen
- Administration von Windows-Server- und Client-Umgebungen
- Konfiguration, Wartung, Dokumentation und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Systeme
- Direkter Ansprechpartner für Deine Kunden mit klarer Verantwortung

Dein Profil

- IT-Administration: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der ganzheitlichen Betreuung von IT-Infrastrukturen mit Schwerpunkt auf Microsoft Windows Server- und Client-Betriebssystemen
- System-Engineering: Fundierte Kenntnisse in Installation, Konfiguration, Administration, Systemprüfung und technischer Dokumentation sowie Erfahrung mit Virtualisierung
- Netzwerk & Linux: Grundkenntnisse in Netzwerktechnik sowie in der Linux-Administration.
- Zusatzkenntnisse (von Vorteil): Erfahrung mit Sicherheitslösungen von Sophos (Firewall) und ESET, Datensicherung mit Veeam (Backup & Replication / Microsoft 365) sowie Kenntnisse in Nextcloud.
- Arbeitsweise: strukturiert, eigenständig und ergebnisorientiert
- Persönlichkeit: hohe Einsatzbereitschaft, Teamfähigkeit und eine schnelle Auffassungsgabe bei neuen technischen Anforderungen
- Auftreten: professionelles, kundenorientiertes und freundliches Auftreten im direkten Kontakt mit Anwendern und Kunden
- Sprachen: sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, gute Englischkenntnisse
- Mobilität: Führerschein Klasse B

Das bieten wir Dir

- Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit langfristiger Perspektive
- Flexibel gestaltbare, familienfreundliche Arbeitszeiten, Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice
- Faires, marktgerechtes Gehalt von 48.000 Euro brutto/Jahr im betrieblichen Entgeltsystem
- Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Freiraum für eigene Ideen
- Abwechslungsreiche, ganzheitliche Tätigkeit mit festen Kunden
- Festes Zeitbudget für interne und externe Weiterbildung
- Mitarbeit in einem aufgeschlossenen, motivierten Team
- Flache Hierarchien
- Ergonomische Arbeitsplätze
- Attraktive Benefits (z. B. Jobticket, Tankkarte, Fahrzeugnutzung, Mitarbeiterevents, Kindergartenzuschuss)

Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt?

Dann sende uns noch heute Deine Kurzbewerbung an bewerbung@ibes.ag. Besuche unsere Webseite (https://www.ibes.ag/portal) , LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/ibes-ag/?viewAsMember=true) oder Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/ibes_ag/) . Bei Fragen rufe uns gern an unter 0371/3736418.

title: Graafkraan machinist
description:
Bouwplaatsmachinist

Werven in Duitsland

Wat ga je doen?

Werk mee aan uitdagende energieprojecten in Duitsland en bedien moderne bouwmachines op werven die bijdragen aan de energietransitie.

Je komt terecht bij een sterk groeiend bouwbedrijf dat investeert in mensen, veiligheid en innovatie. Samen met een ervaren team werk je aan grootschalige infrastructuurprojecten die mee vorm geven aan de energievoorziening van morgen.

Als bouwplaatsmachinist voer je graaf- en hijswerkzaamheden uit op werven in Duitsland.

Je bedient verschillende machines, zorgt voor een veilige uitvoering van de werken en draagt bij aan een kwalitatieve oplevering van elk project.

Je bedient graafmachines, hijskranen, bulldozers en andere bouwmachines.
Je voert grondwerken uit, zoals het graven van sleuven en het verplaatsen van grond.
Je helpt mee aan de aanleg van energie-infrastructuur binnen uitdagende projecten.
Je controleert dagelijks je machine en voert het basisonderhoud uit.
Je werkt volgens de geldende veiligheidsvoorschriften en hebt oog voor kwaliteit.
Je stemt je werkzaamheden af met je collega's om de planning vlot te realiseren.
Je werkt volgens een rotatiesysteem van 10 dagen in Duitsland, gevolgd door 4 dagen thuis.

Kan je niet wachten om mee te bouwen aan de energietransitie? Solliciteer vandaag nog – we leren je graag kennen! - Vaardigheden:
Je beschikt over de kennis en ervaring nl. en een vakbekwaamheidscertificaat van de VDAB of een ander erkend opleidingscentrum.
Jij hebt ervaring met : hydraulische banden en of rupsgraafkraan, en een roterende verreiker (Merlo)
Je hebt minimum 4 à 5 jaar ervaring.
Zonder attesten voor de functie bouwplaats machinist is er geen mogelijkheid om op te starten als machinist)
Dus Attesten bouwplaats machinist is een must

Je hebt een certificaat VCA-VOL (of je bent bereid het te behalen).
Je bent betrouwbaar, autonoom en zelfstandig.
Je bent flexibel ingesteld.
Fysieke arbeid schrikt je niet af.

Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands; Frans en/of Engels is een pluspunt.
Rijbewijs B is een noodzaak

Je bent bereid om in het buitenland te werken. (is een vereiste)
10 dagen buitenland/ 4 dagen thuis

- Attesten:
Rijbewijs B is een must
Vakbekwaamheid of opleidingsattest bouwplaats machinist (graafkraan, banden en rupskranen) is een must !
VCA -VOL attest of willen behalen voor opstart

- Opleidingsvereisten:
Opleiding bouwplaatsmachinst

- Vakkennis:
Een aantal jaren ervaring als bouwplaatsmachinist, graafwerken zowel met banden en rupskraan : kabels en leidingen

- Talenkennis:
Nederlands : zeer goede kennis en
Frans : goede kennis en of Engels : goede kennis
P.s. Franstalige of engels-talige kandidaten met een basiskennis Nederlands zijn eveneens zeer welkom om te solliciteren

title: 1:1 ledsager ved Ingrid-Hjemmet
description:
Dansk Skoleforening for Sydslesvig e.V. søger en pædagogmedhjælper/ledsager med 13 ugentlige timer til et enkelt barn i Ingrid-Hjemmet pr. 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest derefter til den 31. juli 2027 med mulighed for forlængelse.

Ingrid-Hjemmet er en af Dansk Skoleforening for Sydslesvigs institutioner, som er en del af det danske mindretal. Vores åbningstid går fra kl. 7.00-16.00. Vi er en institution med børn i alderen 3-6 år. Vi er normeret til 60 børn, som er opdelt i tre basisgrupper, Løverne og Krokodillerne (3-5 år) og Bjørnegruppen (5-6 år) som førskolegruppe. Timerne ligger primært torsdag- og fredag formiddag. 

En af vores vigtigste opgaver er formidlingen af dansk sprog og kultur. Derudover arbejder vi med motorik og sanseintegration. Da Ingrid-Hjemmet ligger tæt på skov og strand, bruger vi gerne den dejlige natur som udviklingsrum. Vi arbejder ud fra et anerkendende børnesyn (jf. Axel Honneth), som lægger vægt på at udvikle selvværd og selvtillid.

I Ingrid-Hjemmet fokuserer vi på, at børn, forældre og personalet skal opleve omsorg – tryghed – nærvær, fællesskab og anerkendelse, glæde og passende udfordringer i et miljø præget af anerkendende relationer, respekt og dialog.

Vores mål er at medvirke til at børnene får en positiv, meningsfuld, aktiv og udviklende hverdag, således at vi medvirker til, at børnene føler sig værdifulde i betydningsfulde fællesskaber og herigennem udvikler sig til »livsduelige« mennesker.

Nærmere oplysninger kan fås ved henvendelse til dagtilbudsleder Kirsten Kaack Johansen, Ingrid-Hjemmet, tlf. 0461-41340.

Ansøgninger med relevante bilag og angivelse af stilling og jobnummer 14434 sendes til job@skoleforeningen.org. De skal være Skoleforeningen i hænde senest den 3. september 2026.

Handicap er ikke en hindring. Ansøgere med handicap, der er lige så kvalificerede som de øvrige ansøgere, har fortrinsadgang til stillingen.

Læs mere om Skoleforeningens behandling af dine personoplysninger i forbindelse med din ansøgning: Ledige stillinger/Oplysningspligt - Dansk Skoleforening (skoleforeningen.org)

title: Engineering Planner, Marine
description:
Join our growing team and help shape the future of ship design! We are now looking for an Engineering Planner to our office in Wismar, Germany!

Your role and the team

As Engineering Planner, youll be responsible for planning, coordinating, monitoring, and reporting all engineering activities throughout the project lifecycle. The role ensures that engineering deliverables are executed in accordance with project schedules, contractual requirements, quality standards, and resource availability.

Additionally, youll develop, maintain, and control engineering schedules based on project milestones, contractual obligations, and the Master Document List (MDL). Acting as the focal point for Engineering Planning and Engineering Progress Reporting, the position provides transparency regarding engineering performance and supports effective decision-making throughout project execution.

Key responsibilities

- Develop and maintain engineering schedules aligned with project milestones, contractual requirements, and overall project objectives.
- Coordinate planning activities across engineering disciplines and key stakeholders, including project management, procurement, production, commissioning, customers, and shipyards.
- Monitor, analyse, and report engineering progress, performance, risks, and schedule deviations using relevant KPIs and reporting tools.
- Support resource planning and forecasting to ensure effective workload and capacity management.
- Manage engineering deliverables and the Master Document List (MDL) throughout the project lifecycle.
- Assess schedule impacts of changes, identify risks and mitigation actions, and support project forecasting activities.
- Drive continuous improvement of engineering planning, reporting, and project control processes.

Working closely with Engineering Managers, Discipline Leads, Project Managers, Document Controllers, Procurement, Production, and the Project Controls Team, your role is to ensure that engineering activities are fully integrated into the overall project schedule and aligned with project objectives. In this role, you will report to the Engineering Manager/Project Manager.

The Engineering Planner is accountable for the coordination of Engineering Progress Measurement, Engineering Progress Reporting, Master Document List management, and forecasting activities, ensuring accurate and timely reporting of engineering performance, risks, and milestones.

What helps you succeed in this role

- Relevant degree in Engineering, Naval Architecture, Industrial Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related field. Additional qualifications in Project Planning, Project Controls, or Project Management are an advantage.
- 3-5+ years of experience in engineering planning, project planning, project controls, or a similar role, preferably in shipbuilding, marine, offshore, energy, EPC, or other complex engineering projects.
- Experience in multidisciplinary engineering environments and document-driven project execution.
- Strong understanding of project planning, scheduling, engineering execution processes, and deliverable management.
- Proficiency in Primavera, Microsoft Project, or similar planning tools, as well as advanced Excel, Power BI, and reporting capabilities.
- Knowledge of project controls, schedule analysis, forecasting, KPI reporting, and engineering progress measurement.
- Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex project data and identify critical issues.
- Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
- Detail-oriented, proactive, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a dynamic project environment, with a focus on delivery and continuous improvement.

What we promise you

Interesting and challenging projects with a supportive team, modern tools and technologies, and a flexible hybrid work model that helps you balance work and free time. We offer training, mentoring, and comprehensive learning and development opportunities to support your growth and help you shape your career. All this is backed by our warm EloWe culture, built on respect, equality, kindness, and support.

Learn more about us: [Visions of Tomorrow, Engineered Today - Elomatic](https://www.elomatic.com/)
Get to know your future colleagues: [Meet Us! videos](https://www.youtube.com/@ElomaticOy/shorts)

Please share your thoughts regarding salary expectations in your application. Our compensation aligns with trade union recommendations and reflects your future role, capabilities and skills, working experience and specialization. Additionally, we offer versatile employee benefits, including comprehensive insurance and support for sports and cultural activities.

We succeed together, we have passion to improve, we are trustworthy

If you share our values and are ready for this exciting opportunity, apply with your CV and cover letter in English by September 20th at the latest. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and working styles, different perspectives make us stronger. We review applications continuously and are ready to start interviews during the application period.

For more information, feel free to contact us

title: ICT Risk Oversight Specialist (f/m/d)
description:
ICT Risk Oversight Specialist (f/m/d)
Location: Luxembourg, LU
Company: Deutsche Börse Group
Your area of work:

Clearstream is a large international financial institution offering post-trade infrastructure and securities services for the international and domestic markets worldwide.

The ICT risk management control function plays a pivotal role in safeguarding our organization against technological and information security risks. We partner closely with product, technology, security, and risk teams to ensure the resilience of our systems and services. We actively manage technology risks, steer ICT risk governance and framework design, perform focused risk assurance, and enable compliance for legal entities, branches, and representative offices in scope with direct reporting line to the corresponding executive boards.
The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of technology and security frameworks, risk management practices, and regulations, also comfortable working cross functionally.

Your responsibilities:

• Monitor technology and security risks, providing independent oversight, and challenging the first line of defense when necessary.
• Assist in developing, implementing and maintaining a DORA-complaint ICT Risk oversight program while working closely with ICT Risk Governance, ICT Risk Assurance, and other relevant teams.
• Support the oversight of digital operational resilience posture and advise on necessary technology risk control requirements. Stay updated with emerging trends and align these with organizational plans.
• Work with relevant functions across the three lines of defense to gather digital resilience requirements, ensure alignment, and meet compliance expectations.
• Offer insights from a technology risk perspective on key digital transformation initiatives, resilience testing, ICT third party supplier risk, and other key areas.
• Assist in aligning digital operational resilience with strategic goals. Provide recommendations based on evolving threats, risk appetite, business strategy, and regulatory changes.
• Define, monitor, and report on risk metrics and key performance indicators. Support the preparation and delivery of ICT risk reports to senior management.
• Lead ICT risk regulatory watch and intelligence activities, continuously monitoring evolving regulatory requirements (e.g., DORA), industry standards, and supervisory expectations
• Translate regulatory developments into actionable insights and impacts for the organization.
• Proactively advise stakeholders on upcoming changes and required adaptations to maintain compliance and resilience.

Your profile:

• 5+ years of experience in technology governance, risk, and compliance.
• University degree in Computer Science, Technology Risk, Cyber Security, or related field.
• Strong understanding of technology and security frameworks, risk management principles, and comfortable working cross functionally.
• Experience and analytical skills understanding, structuring, and explaining complex topics; end-to-end thinking required.
• Can turn incomplete, unstructured, or ambiguous data points into structured outcomes and pragmatic action plans.
• Experience working with technology regulations, international standards, or best practices.
• Stakeholders' management skills and capacity to manage priorities simultaneously.
• High self-responsibility & ownership; result orientation and customer focus.
• Proficiency in written and spoken English (must), as well as in German (nice to have).

title: Myyjiä / tuote-esittelijöitä Saksan joulumarkkinoille
description:
Työnkuvaan kuuluvat laadukkaiden ja monipuolisten hunajatuotteidemme esittely, myynti sekä esillepano Saksan joulumarkkinoilla. Aiempi työ- tai opiskelukokemus ulkomailla katsotaan eduksi, mutta kokemusta vastaavasta työstä ei edellytetä. Työhön koulutetaan Suomessa ja Saksassa ennen myyntipisteen avaamista. Tärkeimmät valintakriteerit ovat oikea asenne ja saksan kielen taito.

Tulevana jouluna meillä on 19 joulumarkkinamökkiä eri kaupungeissa ympäri Saksaa. Markkinat aukeavat 23.11. alkavalla viikolla ja kestävät pääasiallisesti 23.12. asti. Muutama myyntipiste on avoinna joulun jälkeenkin, jolloin myyjän tulee olla valmis jäämään Saksaan jouluksi.

Työpäivät ovat keskimäärin 8–10-tuntisia noin viitenä päivänä viikossa riippuen markkinapaikasta ja sen aukioloajoista. Maksamme takuupalkan, mutta hyviin lisätienesteihin on mahdollisuus provision kautta. Työnantaja kustantaa ja järjestää lisäksi majoituksen Saksassa sekä maksaa matkat Suomesta Saksaan ja takaisin.

title: Engineering Planner, Marine
description:
Join our growing team and help shape the future of ship design! We are now looking for an Engineering Planner to our office in Wismar, Germany!

Your role and the team

As Engineering Planner, youll be responsible for planning, coordinating, monitoring, and reporting all engineering activities throughout the project lifecycle. The role ensures that engineering deliverables are executed in accordance with project schedules, contractual requirements, quality standards, and resource availability.

Additionally, youll develop, maintain, and control engineering schedules based on project milestones, contractual obligations, and the Master Document List (MDL). Acting as the focal point for Engineering Planning and Engineering Progress Reporting, the position provides transparency regarding engineering performance and supports effective decision-making throughout project execution.

Key responsibilities

- Develop and maintain engineering schedules aligned with project milestones, contractual requirements, and overall project objectives.
- Coordinate planning activities across engineering disciplines and key stakeholders, including project management, procurement, production, commissioning, customers, and shipyards.
- Monitor, analyse, and report engineering progress, performance, risks, and schedule deviations using relevant KPIs and reporting tools.
- Support resource planning and forecasting to ensure effective workload and capacity management.
- Manage engineering deliverables and the Master Document List (MDL) throughout the project lifecycle.
- Assess schedule impacts of changes, identify risks and mitigation actions, and support project forecasting activities.
- Drive continuous improvement of engineering planning, reporting, and project control processes.

Working closely with Engineering Managers, Discipline Leads, Project Managers, Document Controllers, Procurement, Production, and the Project Controls Team, your role is to ensure that engineering activities are fully integrated into the overall project schedule and aligned with project objectives. In this role, you will report to the Engineering Manager/Project Manager.

The Engineering Planner is accountable for the coordination of Engineering Progress Measurement, Engineering Progress Reporting, Master Document List management, and forecasting activities, ensuring accurate and timely reporting of engineering performance, risks, and milestones.

What helps you succeed in this role

- Relevant degree in Engineering, Naval Architecture, Industrial Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related field. Additional qualifications in Project Planning, Project Controls, or Project Management are an advantage.
- 3-5+ years of experience in engineering planning, project planning, project controls, or a similar role, preferably in shipbuilding, marine, offshore, energy, EPC, or other complex engineering projects.
- Experience in multidisciplinary engineering environments and document-driven project execution.
- Strong understanding of project planning, scheduling, engineering execution processes, and deliverable management.
- Proficiency in Primavera, Microsoft Project, or similar planning tools, as well as advanced Excel, Power BI, and reporting capabilities.
- Knowledge of project controls, schedule analysis, forecasting, KPI reporting, and engineering progress measurement.
- Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex project data and identify critical issues.
- Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
- Detail-oriented, proactive, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a dynamic project environment, with a focus on delivery and continuous improvement.

What we promise you

Interesting and challenging projects with a supportive team, modern tools and technologies, and a flexible hybrid work model that helps you balance work and free time. We offer training, mentoring, and comprehensive learning and development opportunities to support your growth and help you shape your career. All this is backed by our warm EloWe culture, built on respect, equality, kindness, and support.

Learn more about us: [Visions of Tomorrow, Engineered Today - Elomatic](https://www.elomatic.com/)
Get to know your future colleagues: [Meet Us! videos](https://www.youtube.com/@ElomaticOy/shorts)

Please share your thoughts regarding salary expectations in your application. Our compensation aligns with trade union recommendations and reflects your future role, capabilities and skills, working experience and specialization. Additionally, we offer versatile employee benefits, including comprehensive insurance and support for sports and cultural activities.

We succeed together, we have passion to improve, we are trustworthy

If you share our values and are ready for this exciting opportunity, apply with your CV and cover letter in English by September 20th at the latest. We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and working styles, different perspectives make us stronger. We review applications continuously and are ready to start interviews during the application period.

title: ICT Risk Oversight Specialist (f/m/d)
description:
ICT Risk Oversight Specialist (f/m/d)
Location: Luxembourg, LU
Company: Deutsche Börse Group
Your area of work:

Clearstream is a large international financial institution offering post-trade infrastructure and securities services for the international and domestic markets worldwide.

The ICT risk management control function plays a pivotal role in safeguarding our organization against technological and information security risks. We partner closely with product, technology, security, and risk teams to ensure the resilience of our systems and services. We actively manage technology risks, steer ICT risk governance and framework design, perform focused risk assurance, and enable compliance for legal entities, branches, and representative offices in scope with direct reporting line to the corresponding executive boards.
The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of technology and security frameworks, risk management practices, and regulations, also comfortable working cross functionally.

Your responsibilities:

• Monitor technology and security risks, providing independent oversight, and challenging the first line of defense when necessary.
• Assist in developing, implementing and maintaining a DORA-complaint ICT Risk oversight program while working closely with ICT Risk Governance, ICT Risk Assurance, and other relevant teams.
• Support the oversight of digital operational resilience posture and advise on necessary technology risk control requirements. Stay updated with emerging trends and align these with organizational plans.
• Work with relevant functions across the three lines of defense to gather digital resilience requirements, ensure alignment, and meet compliance expectations.
• Offer insights from a technology risk perspective on key digital transformation initiatives, resilience testing, ICT third party supplier risk, and other key areas.
• Assist in aligning digital operational resilience with strategic goals. Provide recommendations based on evolving threats, risk appetite, business strategy, and regulatory changes.
• Define, monitor, and report on risk metrics and key performance indicators. Support the preparation and delivery of ICT risk reports to senior management.
• Lead ICT risk regulatory watch and intelligence activities, continuously monitoring evolving regulatory requirements (e.g., DORA), industry standards, and supervisory expectations
• Translate regulatory developments into actionable insights and impacts for the organization.
• Proactively advise stakeholders on upcoming changes and required adaptations to maintain compliance and resilience.

Your profile:

• 5+ years of experience in technology governance, risk, and compliance.
• University degree in Computer Science, Technology Risk, Cyber Security, or related field.
• Strong understanding of technology and security frameworks, risk management principles, and comfortable working cross functionally.
• Experience and analytical skills understanding, structuring, and explaining complex topics; end-to-end thinking required.
• Can turn incomplete, unstructured, or ambiguous data points into structured outcomes and pragmatic action plans.
• Experience working with technology regulations, international standards, or best practices.
• Stakeholders' management skills and capacity to manage priorities simultaneously.
• High self-responsibility & ownership; result orientation and customer focus.
• Proficiency in written and spoken English (must), as well as in German (nice to have).

title: Staff Product Analyst, Vendor Growth (Product-Lifecycle-Manager/in)
description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Staff Product Analyst (Vendor Growth) to join our Product Analytics team and drive data strategy for our Vendor Growth business management line. In this role, you will move beyond simple reporting to shape the future of our product through rigorous hypothesis testing and by converting massive datasets into high-impact strategic narratives.

In our Vendor Growth Team, you’ll tackle high-impact challenges that empower restaurant partners to operate independently and at scale. Your work will directly improve experiences for vendors and their customers across the globe. Each enhancement you contribute will help Delivery Hero optimize partner operations, support partner autonomy, and strengthen vendor relationships.

As a Staff Analyst, you will champion a core strategic initiative focused on improving partner autonomy and operational efficiency. You will lead analysis and initiatives that help us better understand partner behavior, optimize vendor-facing experiences, and identify opportunities to reduce dependency on support channels. Your work will contribute to improved partner satisfaction, lower operational costs, and more scalable business processes.

You will operate across the product line, partnering with leaders in Product, Tech, Operations and Data to define the strategic direction of analytics for the entire Vendor Growth business. This is your opportunity to leverage deep technical expertise to champion innovation and influence how Delivery Hero empowers vendors at scale.

Strategic Leadership & Product Influence:

- Define the North Star: Develop and refine product metrics and leading indicators that accurately reflect vendor health, partner satisfaction, and business viability. Establish VSSR and related self-service metrics as key performance indicators.
- Influence Roadmap: Use quantitative analysis to look beyond the numbers, providing insights that empower Product Managers and Engineers to decide what to build and why. Provide data-driven recommendations on partner behavior and feature adoption.
- Drive Experimentation: Guide the team on methodology, design, interpretation, and decision-making of A/B tests. Champion vendor-facing experiments to validate self-service feature improvements and operational optimizations.

Technical Excellence & Scalability:

- Build for Scale: Drive the development of scalable analytics infrastructure and self-service capabilities, ensuring data quality and accessibility across the organization.
- Advanced Modeling: Collaborate on vendor behavior analysis and predictive models to understand adoption barriers and optimize feature rollout strategies.

Mentorship & Culture:

- Elevate the Team: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to other analysts, fostering a culture of knowledge-sharing, rigorous peer review, and technical excellence.
- Evangelize Data: Act as a quality gatekeeper and champion a data-driven mindset across the Product and Tech teams.

Qualifications

** Qualifications**

- 6+ years of experience as a Product Analyst, Data Scientist, or similar role, preferably within fast-paced tech environments or marketplaces.
- Deep understanding of A/B test design and edge cases, causal inference, and statistical analysis.
- High level experience in SQL skills with practical experience on large-scale data platforms (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake), solid Python skills for complex analytics, automation, and data visualisation.
- Proven ability to design, build, and optimize data pipelines. You take ownership of data curation to ensure that all business decisions are based on a foundation of reliable, high-quality data, and proven track record of building actionable data-stories and dashboards (Tableau, Looker, or similar) that drive business decisions.
- Demonstrated experience mentoring junior analysts and leading high-impact projects with autonomy. You can influence stakeholders without formal authority.

Nice to have:

- Experience with vendor/partner-centric products.

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation, Gym & Bicycle Subsidy
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers, Food Vouchers, Corporate Discounts. Courses.

We believe diversity and inclusion are key to creating not only an exciting product, but also an amazing customer and employee experience. Fostering this starts with hiring - therefore we do not discriminate on the basis of racial identities, religious beliefs, color, national origin, gender identities or expressions, sexual orientations, age, marital or disability statuses, or any other aspect that makes you, you.

We encourage you to let us know if you need any accommodations or specific accessibility support to ensure a smooth interview experience—just let us know with an email to our Inclusion Officer at inclusion@deliveryhero.com.

Severely disabled applicants with equal qualifications will be given preferential consideration.

You're welcome to share your pronouns (he/she/they) right from the start so we can address you respectfully from our first contact.

description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As Program Lead Finance (f/m/d), you lead the Finance transformation for Large Steam & Syncons (LSS) while serving as co-lead of the overall LSS rollout within Siemens Energy's global S4Energy program.
In this project-driven Engineer-to-Order (ETO) business, you act as the key Finance & Controlling representative, ensuring that business requirements are translated into scalable SAP S/4HANA solutions. Working closely with Finance, Controlling, Manufacturing, and global program teams, you steer critical decisions across project controlling, product costing, manufacturing controlling, and financial closing.
From shaping target processes and driving testing activities to coordinating cutover, go-live, and change management, you combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution to deliver a successful and sustainable business transformation.

How You’ll Make an Impact

* Lead the Finance transformation and co-lead the S4Energy rollout for Large Steam & Syncons, ensuring alignment across stakeholders and program objectives
* Drive end-to-end Finance implementation activities, including requirements management, process design, Fit-Gap workshops, testing, data migration, cutover, go-live, and hypercare
* Harmonize Finance & Controlling processes by balancing business requirements with SAP S/4HANA standards and scalable best practices
* Coordinate cross-functional rollout activities and manage dependencies across Finance, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and IT
* Build and leverage a global Siemens Energy transformation network to share best practices and accelerate implementation success
* Lead stakeholder engagement and change management initiatives to ensure organizational readiness and sustainable adoption

What You Bring

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or a related field
* Extensive experience in SAP S/4HANA Finance & Controlling, including leading complex implementation and business transformation programs
* Strong expertise in Record-to-Report, Project Controlling, Product Costing, Manufacturing Controlling, and Financial Closing
* Solid understanding of Engineer-to-Order (ETO) business processes and end-to-end value flows across project execution and manufacturing
* Excellent stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and leadership skills with experience aligning global cross-functional teams
* Fluency in German and English, enabling effective collaboration in an international environment

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof,
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings,
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

title: Erzieher oder Sozialpädagogen (gn) als Profi-Eltern gesucht! (Erzieher/in - Jugend- und Heimerziehung)
employer: imBlick Kinder-u.Jugendhilfe imblick Kinder- und Jugendhilf imblick Kinder- und Jugendhilf
description:
Sie sind pädagogische Fachkraft und Jugendhilfe-Experte, haben keine Lust mehr auf klassischen Schichtdienst und suchen eine Aufgabe mit Wumms und Wirkung?
Sie wollen 100% zu Hause arbeiten ?
Prima - Dann gründen Sie eine Erziehungsstelle (SPLG) im eigenen Zuhause!

Bereit?

Darum geht's: Sie nehmen ein Kind oder einen Jugendlichen langfristig in Ihren eigenen Familienrahmen auf. Sie teilen Ihr Zuhause, leben den Alltag 24/7 gemeinsam und bieten jungen Menschen ein verlässliches, familiäres Ankommen. Diese anspruchsvolle Lebens- und Arbeitsform ist ein Angebot nach § 34 und § 35 SGB VIII und bedeutet, dass Sie völlig selbstorganisiert in den eigenen vier Wänden auf Honorarbasis arbeiten, eine attraktive Vergütung  - vergleichbar mit einer Vollzeitstelle -  erhalten und zusätzlich durch einen Mietzuschuss für den bereitgestellten Wohnraum unterstützt werden.

Unser Rückhalt für Sie und Ihre Familie

Als Träger wollen wir mit Ihnen auf Augenhöhe zusammenarbeiten. Wir sind langjährige Pädagogik-Profis und halten Ihnen und Ihrer Familie organisatorisch sowie fachlich den Rücken frei: von der Unterstützung bei der Betriebserlaubnis über regelmäßiges Mentoring bis hin zur verlässlichen Fachberatung. title: Sozialpädagogische:r Mitarbeiter:in (m/w/d) im Projekt „Streetwork Neumünster“ (Sozialarbeiter/in / Sozialpädagoge/-pädagogin)
employer: Kieler Antigewalt- und Sozial Training (KAST) e.V.
description:
Für das Projekt „Streetwork in Neumünster“ suchen wir eine:n engagierte:n pädagogische:n Mitarbeiter:in, die/der uns auf Teilzeitbasis unterstützt.

Das Streetwork- Verständnis von KAST e.V. ist darauf ausgelegt, in kürzester Zeit dauerhaft tragfähige Perspektiven für Kinder, Jugendliche und junge Volljährige (bis 21 Jahre gemäß SGB VIII), die sich im Straßenmilieu von Neumünster aufhalten oder in verdeckter Obdachlosigkeit leben (Disconnected Youth, Sofahopper), zu recherchieren und die dafür notwendigen Schritte unbürokratisch und zügig umzusetzen. Diese Methodik soll einer Verfestigung junger Menschen in den Straßenszenen und einer wahrscheinlichen Kriminalität der Zielgruppe entgegenwirken und ihnen stattdessen die schulische, berufliche und gesellschaftliche (Re-)Integration ermöglichen.

Das Ziel des Projektes ist es, die Entscheidungs- und Handlungskompetenz der jugendlichen oder heranwachsenden Adressat:innen zu stärken, damit diese im besten Fall ihre Lebenslagen verändern und zunächst stabilisieren können. Die Arbeit von KAST e.V. basiert grundsätzlich auf einer sozialraumorientierten Haltung. Es geht darum, junge Menschen vor allgemeinen gesellschaftlichen und gesundheitlichen Gefahren zu bewahren und sie zu einem kompetenten Umgang mit Medien, Genussmitteln und anderen Gefährdungspotentialen zu befähigen. Streetwork kann auch diejenigen erreichen, die nicht von selbst ein Hilfesystem in Anspruch nehmen (können). Gleichzeitig erfüllt Streetwork die Schutzaufgaben von Jugendhilfe gem. SGB VIII.

Die Tätigkeit umfasst mitunter auch Dienstzeiten am Abend oder gelegentlich auch am Wochenende.

Unser Angebot:

- Ein Teilzeit-Job mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten in einem multiprofessionellen Gesamtteam, der es Ihnen erlaubt, auch andere Verpflichtungen zu berücksichtigen.
- Die Möglichkeit, teilweise im Homeoffice zu arbeiten und so eine gesunde Work-Life-Balance zu wahren.
- Gehalt angelehnt an TVL plus Zulage und Jahressonderzahlung
- 30 Tage Urlaub
- Arbeitsort: Neumünster
- Regelmäßige Supervisionen, kollegiale Fallberatungen, Fortbildungen und gemeinsame Teambesprechungen

Ihre Aufgaben:

- Die Jugendlichen/ Heranwachsenden /junge Volljährigen, die zu den genannten Zielgruppen zählen, werden an den Standorten und in den ggf. umgebenden Wohngebieten aufgesucht.
- Bei Bedarf: Durchführung von Sprechzeiten in den einzelnen Stadtteilen.
- Netzwerke bilden mit den Einrichtungen der Kinder- und Jugendarbeit, den Stadteilbeiräten, den Ordnungsdiensten, Schulen, dem Amt für Familie und Soziales etc.
- Begleitungen zu Elterngesprächen und Jugendamtsterminen (TIP Neumünster).
- Die Streetworker:innen tauschen sich in regelmäßigen Abständen mit dem TIP-Team der Stadt Neumünster aus und stimmen ggfs. Vorgehensweisen in Einzelfällen miteinander ab.
- Organisation und (Mit-) Durchführung von gemeinsamen Veranstaltungen zu unterschiedlichen Themen.
- Psychosoziale Beratung der Klient:innen, ggfs. Vermittlung in andere Organisationen
- Teilnahme an Teamsitzungen und Supervisionen.
- Dokumentation der Arbeit.
