title: Chargé de supervision, d'audit et d'inspection des entités critiques (m/f) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? Le Haut-Commissariat à la protection nationale a pour mission de mettre en œuvre le Concept de protection nationale. Au sein du Département de la protection des infrastructures critiques et en appui du Chef de département, le Chargé de supervision, d'audit et d'inspection des entités critiques réalise l'ensemble des typologies de supervision des entités critiques. Administrativement, ce poste relève de la fonction du Chargé d'études en protection des infrastructures critiques. Missions Missions principales: Réaliser de manier/ière autonome ou participer à la réalisation d'audits, d'inspections et de processus en vue d'évaluer de manier/ière systématique et méthodique le respect des obligations des entités critiques. Missions secondaires: Contribuer à la mise en oeuvre de la Stratégie nationale pour renforcer la résilience des entités critiques; Contribuer à l'évaluation des risques, au recensement des entités critiques, aux dispositifs de soutien des entités critiques et aux activités liées aux incidents notifiés; Produire des documents d'orientation, des méthodologies et des outils de supervision. Compétences comportementales Gestion de l'information: innover; Gestion des tâches: mettre en oeuvre des solutions; Gestion des collaborateurs: partager son savoir-faire; Gestion des relations: servir le client-usager; Gérer le stress; Faire preuve d'ouverture; S'autodévelopper; S'impliquer. Atouts Certification en tant qu'auditeur (p. ex. ISO  Lead Auditeur); Certification en continuité d'activité ou en résilience organisationnelle (p. ex. ISO ); Familiarité avec les procédures administratives de sanction; Expérience dans un des secteurs visés par l'annexe de la loi du 5 mai  sur la résilience des entités critiques. Conditions d'admission Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut du fonctionnaire de l'État. Il est ouvert au changement d'administration des fonctionnaires. Langues Applicable au fonctionnaire (hors changement d'administration) : Vous répondez aux exigences de connaissances des 3 langues administratives pour le groupe de traitement A1.  Vous avez la  luxembourgeoise. title: Gestionnaire Contrôle & Analyse de dossiers (m/f) (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? title: Juriste expert en protection des données - DPO (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? Commissariat du Gouvernement à la souveraineté des données Missions Le Commissariat du gouvernement à la souveraineté des données (« CGSD ») est une administration dont les missions sont prévues par la loi du  décembre ; Le CGSD peut être désigné par les administrations et les communes comme délégué à la protection des données (DPO) ou assister les DPO internes que les administrations étatiques ont désignés; Il est l'organisme compétent, conformément à l'article 7, paragraphe 1er du règlement (UE) / (règlement sur la gouvernance des données), habilité à octroyer ou à refuser l'accès à certaines données protégées du secteur public et leur réutilisation; Il a également pour mission de contribuer au développement de la protection des données et de dispenser des conseils en matier/ière de gouvernance des données et de l'intelligence artificielle au sein des administrations étatiques. Il conseille, sur demande, les membres du Gouvernement pour une mise en œuvre cohérente des politiques en ces matier/ières; Enfin dans le cadre de ses missions de conseil et guidance, le CGSD sensibilise les agents publics et développe des documents et des outils adaptés visant à assister les entités en matier/ière de conformité au RGPD. Dans ce cadre, et pour renforcer le Département Délégué à la protection des données du secteur public, le CGSD recherche un(e) juriste expérimenté(e) en matier/ière de protection des données, notamment à travers une expérience avérée en qualité de délégué à la protection de données (DPD ou DPO). En ce sens, il faudra pour la personne qui candidate être en capacité de satisfaire aux missions ci-après exposées: Conseils et informations aux administrations et aux communes sur toutes les questions qui concernent l'application de la législation sur la protection des données; Vérification du respect du RGPD dans le même périmètre; Rédaction et/ou revue des politiques internes y afférentes; Réalisation et/ou revue d'analyses d'impact relatives à la protection des données (AIPD); Analyses juridiques approfondies et élaboration de notes et d'avis juridiques; Rédaction de notes d'information internes, de supports de sensibilisation ainsi que de fiches et de guides pratiques en matier/ière de protection des données à caractère personnel; Veille juridique du cadre normatif et jurisprudentiel. Profil Compétences techniques Vous disposez d'excellentes compétences rédactionnelles; Vous disposez d'une bonne maîtrise des outils informatiques courants; Vous avez d'excellentes capacités analytiques, savez anticiper les défis ainsi que développer vos idées dans une approche panoramique et vous disposez d'un esprit de synthèse; Vous disposez d'une bonne aptitude à collaborer au sein d'équipes pluridisciplinaires et à travailler en réseau avec des partenaires internes et externes; Vous savez conceptualiser et modéliser des notions et situations abstraites. Compétences comportementales Rigoureux et structuré, vous travaillez de façon autonome et organisée; Vous avez le sens de l'initiative et êtes capable de coordonner des projets transversaux; Vous faites preuve d'originalité et de créativité dans l'élaboration de pistes de solutions; Vous avez le sens de la responsabilité et contribuez à un bon esprit d'équipe; Vous avez la confiance de vous orienter dans des domaines nouveaux et défiants et savez vous familiariser avec des sujets complexes. Atouts Vous avez une véritable expérience de Délégué à la protection des données au Luxembourg; Vous êtes titulaire du CCDL. Conditions d'admission Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut du fonctionnaire de l'État ou de l'employé de l'État. Il est ouvert au changement d'administration des fonctionnaires. Obtenez plus de détails sur les conditions d'admission : Pour devenir fonctionnaire de l'État Pour changer d'administration en tant que fonctionnaire Pour devenir employé de l'État. Diplômes Vous êtes titulaire d'un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d'enseignement supérieur reconnu par l'État du siège de l'établissement et sanctionnant l'accomplissement avec succès d'un master en droit ou de son équivalent. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 7 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. Expérience Vous avez une expérience d'au moins 3 ans dans le domaine. Langues Applicable à l'employé et au fonctionnaire (hors changement d'administration) : Vous répondez aux exigences de connaissances des 3 langues administratives pour le groupe A1.  Vous êtes ressortissant d'un État membre de l'Union européenne.

title: Data Scientist (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? Commissariat du Gouvernement à la souveraineté des données Missions Le Commissariat du gouvernement à la souveraineté des données (« CGSD ») est une administration dont les missions sont prévues par la loi du décembre . Le CGSD peut être désigné par les administrations et les communes comme délégué à la protection des données (DPO) ou assister les DPO internes que les administrations étatiques ont désignés. Il est l'organisme compétent, conformément à l'article 7, paragraphe 1er du règlement (UE) / (règlement sur la gouvernance des données), habilité à octroyer ou à refuser l'accès à certaines données protégées du secteur public et leur réutilisation. Il a également pour mission de contribuer au développement de la protection des données et de dispenser des conseils en matier/ière de gouvernance des données et de l'intelligence artificielle au sein des administrations étatiques. Il conseille, sur demande, les membres du Gouvernement pour une mise en œuvre cohérente des politiques en ces matier/ières. Enfin dans le cadre de ses missions de conseil et guidance, le CGSD sensibilise les agents publics et développe des documents et des outils adaptés visant à assister les entités en matier/ière de conformité au RGPD. Dans ce cadre, et pour renforcer le Département Autorité luxermbourgeoise des données, le CGSD recherche deux (2) Data Scientists expérimenté(e)s en matier/ière de Privacy et PETs (Privacy-Enhancing Technologies). En ce sens, il faudra pour les personnes qui candidatent être en capacité de satisfaire aux missions ci-après exposées : Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions avancées en science des données, avec un focus particulier sur la protection de la vie privée et les technologies d'amélioration de la confidentialité (PETs); Analyser et modéliser des données complexes, développer des algorithmes de machine learning et évaluer leur performance; Identifier et mitiger les risques liés à la confidentialité et à la réidentification dans les projets data et IA, Contribuer à la définition de standards et bonnes pratiques en matier/ière d'anonymisation, pseudonymisation et gestion des données sensibles; Collaborer avec les équipes métier et techniques pour intégrer les contraintes de privacy dans les pipelines de données et les modèles IA; Réaliser des analyses approfondies de qualité des données, de lignée et de conformité privacy; Assurer une veille scientifique et technique sur les avancées en privacy engineering et en techniques d'anonymisation. Profil Compétences techniques Les candidat(e)s devront faire preuve d'un véritable niveau d'expertise, à savoir: Expertise Data: Expertise poussée en modélisation de données, data lineage, data quality et data governance; Maîtrise des environnements Big Data, bases relationnelles et NoSQL, ainsi que des outils de traitement de données massives; Solides compétences en SQL avancé et en raisonnement sur les structures de données complexes; Expérience dans la gestion et la transformation de données sensibles dans des environnements réglementés; Expertise solide sur les standards et modèles de données de (OMOP CDM, OpenEHR, FHIR, HL7). Expertise IA: Maîtrise des techniques de Machine Learning et d'Advanced Analytics (clustering, Random Forest, Boosting, réseaux de neurones, NLP, etc.); Expertise approfondie en Privacy Enhancing Technologies (k-anonymity, l-diversity, t-closeness, differential privacy, agrégation, suppression, généralisation, etc.); Expérience dans l'évaluation de modèles, la conception de suites de tests et l'analyse des limites des algorithmes; Connaissance des modèles de langage et des outils d'IA générative appliqués à des cas d'usage privacy et confidentialité. Compétences comportementales Analyser : Vous évaluez les informations, données et contenus de manier/ière critique, le cas échéant dans un environnement digital, vous identifiez les liens logiques et restituez l'information dans une synthèse complète et cohérente; Gérer les activités : Vous gérez les activités courant/antes au travers d'objectifs opérationnels clairs, vous gérez les ressources et suivez la mise en oeuvre des activités; Soutenir : Vous agissez comme référence, vous accompagnez les collègues, vous les guidez et les soutenez en stimulant la coopération autour de l'objectif commun; Conseiller : Vous fournissez des conseils et développez une relation de confiance basée sur votre crédibilité, vous faites des recommandations dans l'intérêt de l'organisation et du client-usager; Faire preuve d'ouverture : Vous êtes ouvert au changement et à l'innovation, vous vous ouvrez à la diversité et vous vous intéressez à d'autres disciplines que les vôtres; Gérer le stress : Vous gardez votre calme face à la pression, vous restez...

description:
Analyst, Same Day Topology, LTP
Job ID: 10486914 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Have you ever ordered a product on the Amazon website and wondered how it got delivered to you via Same Day, and what kinds of topology, demand and capacity processes are running behind the scenes to power the whole operation? If so, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for steering our LTP topology to deliver end-to-end benefits across Customer Experience, Speed, and Cost. This is a role for an exceptionally talented person, with high energy and courage, passionate about ambiguity and delivering concrete improvements for our customers, and who wants to achieve that using data. The role is split 70% analytics and 30% project management.
The key job responsibilities can be split in two buckets:

(1) Data Analytics/Science

- Deep dive complex data to uncover actionable insights for known and unknown problems
- Good expertise with SQL techniques
- Build strong analytics tools to highlight defects and extract actionable insights from our end-to-end supply chain

(2) Project management:

- Lead regular business reviews with partner teams to monitor progress of projects in the roadmap, and help remove bottlenecks
- Use and share your insights with partner teams to influence and build a roadmap of projects that accelerate speed of deliveries in your country
- For the most complex and ambitious opportunities, quickly launch new pilots and build scale-up business cases with benefits, bottlenecks, risks, and resources required
- Consolidate progress into crisp, concise, data-driven status updates. You will own reporting to Amazon senior leadership.

A day in the life

You'll work across First Mile and Last Mile topology teams to shape the physical network that powers Same Day: classifying and sizing node types (Nexus, dedicated Same Day sites, standard fulfillment sites), evaluating RE candidates against coverage and capacity needs, and reconciling demand against what the network can realistically serve at a regional and site level. You'll turn that analysis into a prioritized roadmap and drive it through recurring workshops with Real Estate, Topology, Finance, and Science partners, tracking action items to closure and reporting progress up to senior leadership.

About the team

Long Term Planning Analytics Team

- Same Day Topology LTP is one of those analytical teams. We are obsessed by rethinking our advanced end-to-end supply chain to make our deliveries even faster. Our overall mission is simple: we want Amazon to be the place where our products can be delivered the same-day.
- Long Term Planning analytical teams are transversal centers of expertise, composed of engineers, analysts, and scientists. We are focused on Amazon most complex problems, processes and decisions. We work with fulfillment centers, transportation, finance and retail teams across the world, to improve our logistic infrastructure.

- Operations is at the heart of the Amazon customer experience. Each action we undertake is on behalf of our customers, as surpassing their expectations is our passion. We improve customer experience through continuously optimizing the complex movements of goods from vendors to customers throughout Europe.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Math, Engineering, Science or Business
- Experience in analyzing data to drive decisions
- Experience engaging, verbally and in writing, with internal and external stakeholders to convey complex ideas in a clear, concise manner
- Ability to lead and structure projects, in particular liaising and collaborating with internal partners to influence direction and roadmaps, despite competing priorities

Description

The same-day network is the largest single investment in EU speed at multiple $B (2027-29) and a core driver of customer growth, reported weekly to the SVP for WW Stores. Between now and 2029 the network expands to over 200 dedicated fulfillment nodes to reach 60%+ Prime demand coverage. Delivering that requires solving hard problems across product selection, inventory buying and placement, inbound network design, and promise and fulfillment logic.

- Define speed-sensitivity and de-assortment methods that redirect scarce budget and peak capacity to the most speed-critical selection, backed by econometric experimentation, and drive the owning tech teams to implement them

title: Program Manager, ICON Global Logistics Operations,ICON Global Logistics Operation (m/f)
description:
Program Manager, ICON Global Logistics Operations, ICON Global Logistics Operations
Job ID: 10474586 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

Amazon Global Logistics is a team of logistics professionals, carrier specialists, and program managers focused on improving the speed, reliability, and cost of Amazon's cross-border supply chain. The team executes the movement of freight from global manufacturing hubs into Amazon's international marketplaces - serving Retail, Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) sellers, and new transportation products. Beyond operating today's network, the team builds new logistics capabilities, drives cost-to-serve reduction, and deploys AI and automation to transform how cross-border freight moves at scale.

We are hiring a Program Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of ocean freight across Retail, FBA, and new transportation lanes - from roadmap definition through execution. You will build and manage a portfolio of initiatives spanning cost optimization, network expansion, and new product launches. You will drive planning across Product, Ocean, Customs, and Destination Ops teams to meet SLA and cost-per-unit targets - and regularly lead business reviews with senior leaders to align priorities and unblock execution. The role operates at the intersection of strategy and operations: defining how we scale reliable, cost-efficient ocean logistics while managing carrier relationships, cross-team dependencies, and network constraints in real time.

You will need a strong analytical background, the ability to make data-driven decisions across multiple programs, and the discipline to lead through influence rather than authority. You should be comfortable thinking strategically about supply chain initiatives - including identifying opportunities for AI-driven process improvement and automation - while executing at the operational level. You should be able to build consensus with senior leaders on objectives and trade-offs.

This role requires up to 15% travel to Amazon network facilities and on-site visits with carriers and logistics service providers.

Key job responsibilities

• Build and manage a portfolio of initiatives spanning cost-to-serve optimization, network expansion, and new product launches - from roadmap through execution.
• Drive cost reduction through LSP efficiency improvements, mode optimization (benchmarking lead time, cost, and emissions), and operational charge elimination.
• Partner with Product and Tech teams to evaluate, develop, and launch new transportation programs that improve seller experience and reduce cost-to-serve.
• Identify and deploy AI and automation opportunities to transform operational processes - from forecasting and capacity planning to carrier management and reporting.
• Design and maintain capacity risk frameworks across operating units and sites - defining triggers, escalation paths, and forecast accuracy standards.
• Coordinate across internal functions (Controllership, Finance, Operations Center, Global Trade Services) to ensure aligned execution with carriers and customers.
• Lead business and planning reviews with senior leaders to align priorities, surface trade-offs, and unblock execution.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Experience in defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
- Knowledge of Excel at an intermediate level (e.g., pivot tables & charts, multiple criteria lookups, nested logical/IF formulas, data cleansing, array formulas, etc.)

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience leading process improvements
- Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
- Experience building processes, project management, and schedules
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL

Within Clearstream, Global Markets – Network Management is responsible for managing Clearstream's worldwide network of financial market infrastructures and service providers, including central securities depositories, custodian banks, cash correspondent banks, and trading venues.
The main responsibilities of Network Management are to select, develop and monitor the global network of third-party service providers for settlement, custody and cash correspondent banking services. The work includes notably the continuous assessment of the levels of service, competitiveness and the associated risks of those markets where Clearstream operates a link. Network Management also ensures at all times compliance with Clearstream|Deutsche Boerse's policies and procedures and their regulatory requirements applicable to the management of its market links and agent bank network.

The Network Management Office (NMO) is a transversal control, coordination and governance function that supports and oversees the Network Management teams globally. Its mandate is not market ownership, but process integrity, consistency, regulatory compliance, and operational resilience across the entire Network Management function. This is a cross functional role combining governance, process management, regulatory awareness, audit coordination, and stakeholder interaction.

Your responsibilities:

• Establishing and monitoring the contractual relationships with Clearstream's third party providers, from leading the RFIs/RFPs to concluding contracts
• Reviewing and negotiating fee schedules, taking into account the market specifics and competition
• Monitoring compliance with all applicable market and regulatory requirements
• Monitoring adherence to operational service levels, from a contractual and competitive standpoint
• Sourcing and communicating all information about allocated markets in a timely and relevant fashion, for all stakeholders
• Performing on-site due diligence visits (a few business trips per year may be necessary)
• Maintaining the evaluation of the market requirements and their risk assessments
• Representing and advocating for Clearstream|Deutsche Boerse in forums and in the interactions with all layers of the markets: participants, regulators, infrastructures, etc.
• Business analysis of Settlement and Custody related products
• Cross-departmental coordination of market developments/projects
• Governance & Oversight: providing a centralised governance and control over the above-mentioned Network Management activities to ensure execution of the Network Management Procedure, acting as a control and coordination layer between regional Network Management teams and other internal stakeholders (audit, compliance, etc)
• Procedures & Regulatory Alignment: responsible for the administration, maintenance and consistency of Network Management procedures that are filed with Clearstream's regulators, coordinating annual and adhoc updates and ensuring the audit and regulatory requirements are correctly documented.
• Audit & Assurance Support: act as the central audit interface for Network Management, coordinating external and internal audit requests and ensuring evidence, documentation and controls are consistently available.
• Process Coordinationg & Steering: organise and coordinate Network Management Steering Committees in order to facilitate internal alignment on processes, controls and priorities, supporting the escalation and alignment of transversal issues affecting the Network Management team as a whole
• Systems & Data Governance: supporting the consistent usage of the Network Management system (DigiNet) plus other systems and tools available to the team, to ensure quality data standards and disciplined documentation storage practices.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's degree, post-graduate degree or MBA, in economics / finance or equivalent
• 3-5 years of securities services experience or any equivalent financial enviornment
• Background in governance, operational risk, compliance, audit coordination, or process management
• Experience working with cross border or distributed teams is an advantage
• Strong organisational and coordination skills
• High attention to detail and structured working style
• Ability to understand complex processes and translate them into clear frameworks
• Strong written and verbal communication skills
• Confidence interacting with senior stakeholders and control functions
• Strong negotiation, presentation and analytical skills, enabling the interactions with all levels of management, internally and with clients and service providers.
• Ability to represent Clearstream|Deutsche Boerse's agenda and interests with industry participants and bodies, including the relevant regulators.
• Ability to set and prioritize objectives, to contribute to the wider departmental and organisational objectives, to proactively source, interact or develop talent, collaborate with the team and across the company. Able to work independently, be a team player, and offer up effective recommendations to management or counterparts.

title: Product Manager (m/f)
description:
Description de tâches:


Since 1922, Rotarex has been the world leader in cylinder valves, pressure regulators and equipment for all gas applications. With nearly 2,000 employees worldwide, we support a wide range of industries including semiconductor, medical, automotive, food & beverage, energy, research and many others.

Innovation, quality and customer satisfaction are at the heart of everything we do, making Rotarex a trusted partner for customers around the globe.



Location: Lintgen, Luxembourg

We are currently moving to our brand-new Industry 4.0 manufacturing site in Bissen, a state-of-the-art facility designed to provide an outstanding working environment for our employees while supporting operational excellence and innovation.



Your mission:

As a Product Manager, the role involves supporting business growth and sales of Rotarex fire suppression solutions for selected accounts and territories.



Your responsibilities will include:

Product Management & Development:

Manage the Firetec products and systems throughout the entire Product Lifecycle: ideation, development, introduction, growth, maturity, and end-of-life.
Gather and prioritize product and customer requirements, defining development scope and creating project initiation documentation.
Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, production, marketing, purchasing, and sales for successful product development. Manage small scale projects.
Drive cross-functional product launches and business planning processes.
Develop, implement, and maintain production timelines across multiple departments.


Training & Communication:

Provide technical and commercial training for internal and external customers. Collaborate on training materials creation and updates.


Product Positioning & Strategy:

Develop positioning and messaging for Rotarex Firetec products.
Maintain and enhance costing and pricing tools. Identify and define cost reduction strategies.
Assess competitor offerings and identify opportunities for product differentiation.
Analyze consumer needs, market trends, and potential partnerships for strategic decision-making.



Your profile:

Qualifications:

Leadership and teamwork: Assign tasks, negotiate, and engage in cross-functional teams.
Adaptability: Quickly shift focus to changing priorities with minimal stress.
Communication: Effectively transmit information, adapt to different audiences, and comfortable speaking in public.
Problem Solving: Identify problems promptly and actively seek solutions.
Commercial awareness and customer focus: Understand business success factors and prioritize customer needs.


Required Skills:

Bachelor's degree in product design, engineering, or business administration.
5-year experience in fire suppression or correlated industry.
Involved in dynamic product management, in manufacturing industry.
Experience overseeing multiple elements of the product development lifecycle.
Exceptional writing, editing, presentation, and public speaking skills.
Fluent in English; proficiency in French and/or German.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and 365 packages.


What makes this role unique:

Responsibility for the full Product Lifecycle of Rotarex Firetec products and systems
Cross-functional collaboration with R&D, Production, Marketing, Purchasing and Sales
Involvement in product development, product launches and business planning
A role combining product management, technical and commercial activities
Opportunities to contribute to product positioning, differentiation, costing, pricing and cost reduction strategies
Direct involvement in understanding customer needs, market trends and competitor offerings



What you will find at Rotarex:

The strength of a global industrial group combined with a family-oriented culture
Real opportunities for training, development and career growth
Flexible working hours (depending on the position) promoting a healthy work-life balance
An attractive benefits package including additional holidays, bonuses and social benefits
Soon, a new Industry 4.0 manufacturing site in Bissen, offering an ultra-modern working environment (canteens, fitness center, free parking, electric vehicle charging stations, air-conditioned facilities...)
Easy access to the site
Additional benefits including Sympass, preferential partnerships (banking, health insurance, mobile plans...)
Company events that foster team spirit and collaboration


Recruitment process:

1st interview: Teams interview with HR and the Hiring Manager
2nd interview: On-site interview


Only applications submitted through our official application process will be considered.
All applications will be treated with the strictest confidentiality.


A small tip: AI-generated applications often sound alike… let your personality and experience make the difference

Ready to take the next step in your product management career with Rotarex? Join us and contribute to the development of innovative Firetec products and systems.

description:

Your future team

Our team of valuation experts are specialized in quantitative analysis and the valuation of financial derivatives instruments along with other complex products and structures for banks and investment funds. The team works closely with our Audit & Assurance department. It provides, in the context of the audit of investments funds and credit institutions, derivatives valuations in respect of client's portfolios.
Our team also provides quantitative expertise to the finance, banking and insurance industry sectors. This includes the review of valuation frameworks, policies and processes as well as gap analysis versus regulatory requirements, market practices and regulatory expectations.
Your advantages of joining us

1. Career Growth, Your Way
Access top-notch training and career development, with a clear progression path to help you level up at your own pace.
2. Global Impact, Local Connections
Work on international projects and collaborate with diverse teams, all while making an impact locally.
3. Innovative Work That Matters
Tackle cutting-edge projects and utilize the latest tech, with all the tools you need to stay ahead.
4. Inclusive, Flexible Culture
Embrace a culture where your voice matters, with flexible hours to balance work and life seamlessly.
5. Purpose-Driven Work
Get involved in sustainability initiatives and community service, making a real difference while growing your career.

How you'll contribute to our success

• Calculate and report fair value of derivatives, reconciling with accounting records
• Work with a broad range of OTC derivatives (rates, FX, credit, equity, structured products, illiquid instruments, etc)
• Develop and apply quantitative models and IT solutions for derivative valuation and process improvement
• Design, implement, test, document and maintain valuation models, systems, policies and frameworks
• Conduct reviews, gap analyses and provide support on valuation topics, including regulatory requirements and internal reviews

Your skills

Must have

• Master's degree in Finance, Engineering or Applied Mathematics with a strong willingness to develop expertise in the financial sector
• Experience in the financial sector and knowledge of related regulations, plus knowledge of financial instruments (bonds, shares, derivatives, funds, …)
• Strong basics in derivatives pricing or mathematics and solid programming skills in Matlab, Python, R or another language
• Good team player able to work autonomously, agile, enthusiastic, results oriented, able to work within deadlines, and fluent in English

Nice to have

• Passion for problem solving with excellent analytical skills
• French or German language skills
• Knowledge of the main Financial Information Providers (Bloomberg, Refinitiv, …)

Interested? Please submit your resume in English

Do you want to get away from the dark winter in Sweden or cold part of europe? Here is your chance!!

Are you service-minded and want to work abroad?

Are you passionate about being on camera?

Do you want to become the star of your own Game Show?

We are looking for Game Presenters who want to work in a fast-paced and international work environment for our studio in Malta. As a Game Presenter, you will spend most of your working day in front of the camera leading the game and interacting with the players. The job will help you grow your presentation techniques and your ability to multitask. As a Game Presenter / Host, you will take presenting to an entirely different level. You will be engaging in bubbly, robust, and interactive conversations with your players on the table, taking player experience to new heights, not just through your energy and personality but also your ability to entertain.

We do not require any specific previous work experience, but we want you to have worked at least part-time for a year or two, preferably with service-related tasks. We also require that you are fluent in the Swedish (or dutch, norwegian, danish, finnish) language and that you have a conversational level of English. You will spend the first three weeks of your employment with us in our Academy where you will be taught how to lead a game of Blackjack and Roulette as well as how to act in front of the camera.

Apart from a work experience that can give you valuable professional skills for a future career, moving to Malta to work for us provides you with an opportunity for personal growth. For many of our team members in Malta, this is their first experience of living abroad on their own. In addition, we broadcast in 18 languages from our Malta studio and there are more than 40 different nationalities in our teams, so the work environment we offer in Malta is truly dynamic and international.

title: Senior Product Compliance Coordinator - Malta
description:
Come and join our journey!

At Immense Group, we are guided by our core values of passion, boldness, and integrity. We strive to create an environment where our people thrive, driven by a love for innovation and a commitment to delivering exceptional player experiences. If you’re passionate about compliance and Product Operations, bold in your approach, and act with integrity, we’d love for you to join our team as a Senior Product Compliance Coordinator.

A taste of what you’ll do

The Senior Product Compliance Coordinator is responsible for leading the operational compliance function within Product Operations, ensuring all games and operational activities comply with regulatory requirements across all brands and jurisdictions.

The role combines regulatory compliance with process governance, documentation, audit readiness, and continuous improvement while working closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, Projects, Partnership Management, and external providers.

A key responsibility of the role is ensuring compliance processes, certifications, regulatory documentation, and operational controls remain accurate, audit-ready, and continuously improved to support operational consistency, regulatory compliance, and business growth.

Regulatory Compliance & Operational Governance

    Maintain certification repositories, compliance trackers, regulatory evidence, and audit documentation.
    Monitor regulatory changes and coordinate operational implementation across Product Operations.

    Create, maintain, and continuously improve compliance procedures, SOPs, checklists, and regulatory documentation.
    Ensure compliance documentation remains accurate, current, and aligned with regulatory requirements and operational workflows.
    Support the development of compliance-related Knowledge Base articles and onboarding material.
    Promote standardisation of compliance processes across Product Operations.
    Prepare compliance reports, certification trackers, regulatory dashboards, and market-specific reporting.
    Identify compliance risks, operational gaps, and opportunities to strengthen operational controls.
    Support implementation of automation initiatives and AI-assisted tools that improve compliance processes, documentation, and reporting.
    Work closely with Product Operations, Legal & Compliance, DEVS, CRM, Customer Operations, Projects, and external providers to maintain regulatory alignment.
    Participate in operational, regulatory, and cross-functional projects as required.
    Support new market launches and regulatory initiatives.
    Maintain sufficient operational knowledge to provide support across Product Operations where required and contribute to business continuity.
    Perform any other task or responsibility related or connected to the role.

Additional Responsibilities

Who and what we are after?

    Demonstrated experience managing regulatory documentation, certifications, audits, or compliance-related processes.

    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify compliance risks and recommend practical solutions.

title: Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B) - Malta
description:
Come and join our journey!

A taste of what you’ll do

As a Legal & Compliance Manager (B2B), you will serve as a primary legal and compliance contact for business-to-business affairs, supporting a broad range of contractual, regulatory, and gambling compliance responsibilities across multiple jurisdictions.

Accountabilities:

    Act as a primary legal partner for B2B affairs, leading day-to-day contractual reviews, negotiations, and drafting of a broad range of commercial agreements and related documentation.
    Lead the preparation, review, and negotiation of commercial contracts using and refining standard templates, including platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Provide clear, commercially focused legal advice to management, presenting legal risks, practical options, and strategic recommendations to support informed decision-making.
    Collaborate cross-functionally with the broader Group legal and compliance function to support business objectives.
    Manage the preparation, submission, and ongoing maintenance of gaming licence applications across multiple jurisdictions, taking ownership of assigned portfolios.
    Verify that prospective and existing B2B clients hold valid gambling licences or authorisations in each market in which products or services will be deployed, and monitor counterparty licence status, regulatory standing, and market exits throughout the relationship lifecycle.
    Maintain the approved-markets framework, advising on market permissibility and regulated versus unregulated market positioning, and ensuring territory and geo-restriction requirements are reflected in commercial agreements.
    Support proactive and collaborative relationships with regulatory authorities, as needed.
    Manage ongoing licence maintenance obligations across the B2B licence portfolio, including key event reporting, regulatory notifications, periodic returns, and compliance and system audits.
    Act as holder of key functions and/or personal management licences, as applicable, across relevant jurisdictions, subject to regulatory approval and applicable vetting requirements.
    Monitor regulatory developments affecting B2B supply, assessing the impact of new and emerging supplier licensing regimes and feeding outcomes into market entry, certification, and licensing strategies.
    Create, update, implement, monitor, and enforce policies, procedures, guidelines, and manuals.
    Oversee technical compliance requirements, including managing relationships with accredited test laboratories, owning the certification and homologation roadmap for each jurisdiction, and coordinating security audits and product certification.
    Manage regulatory change-management processes for game and platform releases, coordinating with product and technical teams on certification, notification, and remediation requirements.
    Ensure content and brand protection by registration, maintenance, and renewal of intellectual property rights by assisting in any IP disputes that may arise from time to time, and developing and implementing a domain name strategy.
    Own the B2B counterparty onboarding and due diligence framework, including Know Your Business (KYB) and Customer Due Diligence (CDD) on prospective clients and suppliers, sanctions and adverse media screening, and anti-bribery and corruption due diligence on commercial partners and intermediaries.
    Advise on data protection matters arising in B2B arrangements, including controller–processor analysis, negotiation of data processing agreements, and international data transfer requirements, in coordination with the Group’s data protection function.
    Perform other job-related functions as assigned.

Qualifications

    Qualified lawyer with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Law (LLB or equivalent).

Required Skills

    1–3 years’ post-qualification experience in regulatory, legal, or advisory roles, within B2B iGaming.
    Demonstrated experience in multi-jurisdictional gambling regulation and licensing, including the preparation and management of licence applications and regulatory submissions.
    Demonstrated experience drafting and negotiating B2B commercial agreements, such as platform and content supply, software licensing, distribution, and reseller arrangements.
    Familiarity with B2B/supplier licensing and authorisation regimes, as distinct from operator licensing, and with technical compliance and certification frameworks, including working with accredited test laboratories.
    Eligibility and willingness to undergo regulatory vetting and to hold key function or personal management licence appointments, as required; prior experience holding such appointments is advantageous.
    Experience providing independent regulatory advice to internal business stakeholders.
    Working knowledge of data protection requirements in a B2B contracting context, including data processing agreements and international transfers.
    Exposure to intellectual property portfolio management, brand protection, or counterparty due diligence (KYB/CDD, sanctions screening) is advantageous.

Preferred Skills

    Strong legal research, analysis, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address regulatory issues independently.
    Sound commercial drafting and negotiation skills across a broad range of B2B agreement types.
    Ability to interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into clear, practical, and commercially sound advice.
    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present regulatory analysis to non-legal audiences.
    Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a varied and demanding workload, prioritise effectively, and meet deadlines.
    High level of professionalism, integrity, and attention to detail.
    Fluency in English is required; proficiency in an additional language is advantageous.

Employee benefits

    Private health insurance – because your wellbeing matters
    Wellness allowance – up to €300 per year
    Fresh and healthy breakfast & lunch prepared daily in our penthouse kitchen
    Birthday leave – celebrate your day your way
    Company and team-building events – and yes, they’re legendary
    Relocation package to Malta (if applicable)
    Many onsite activities - weekly yoga class, occasional massage sessions, happy hours each month etc.
    And much more – come see for yourself

description:
Failure Analysis Engineer (Test) Wij zijn op zoek naar een Failure Analysis Engineer die enthousiast is over het achterhalen van de kernoorzaak van technische problemen en het continu verbeteren van processen in een dynamische, internationale werkomgeving. Heb jij een technische achtergrond, maar steek je ook graag zelf de handen uit de mouwen aan machines? Dan is dit de perfecte kans voor jou! title: Toezichthouder kwaliteit en rechtmatigheid Wmo
description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor de gemeente Sittard-Geleen een Toezichthouder kwaliteit en rechtmatigheid Wmo

Werk jij vanuit vertrouwen én durf je door te vragen? Goede ondersteuning begint bij vertrouwen. Vertrouwen in inwoners, vertrouwen in zorgaanbieders en vertrouwen in de professionals die dagelijks het verschil maken. Maar vertrouwen vraagt ook om toezicht. Toezicht dat onafhankelijk, zorgvuldig en professioneel wordt uitgevoerd.

De gemeenten Sittard-Geleen, Beek en Stein zoeken een Toezichthouder Kwaliteit en Rechtmatigheid Wmo die toezicht ziet als meer dan controleren alleen. Een professional die onderzoekt, verbindt, adviseert en bijdraagt aan een lerende omgeving waarin kwaliteit en rechtmatigheid hand in hand gaan.

Ben jij analytisch sterk, bestuurlijk sensitief en in staat om complexe vraagstukken terug te brengen tot de kern? Dan maken wij graag kennis met jou.

Wat jou veerkrachtig maakt:

Als Toezichthouder ben je verantwoordelijk voor het toezicht op de kwaliteit en rechtmatigheid van ondersteuning die wordt geleverd vanuit de Wet maatschappelijke ondersteuning (Wmo 2015). Je houdt toezicht bij aanbieders van Zorg in Natura (ZIN) en persoonsgebonden budgetten (pgb). Je onderzoekt of inwoners de ondersteuning ontvangen waarop zij recht hebben, of deze ondersteuning voldoet aan de wettelijke kwaliteitseisen en of publieke middelen rechtmatig worden besteed. Je werkt samen met twee collega-Toezichthouders en beweegt je gemakkelijk tussen zorgaanbieders, beleidsmedewerkers, consulenten, bestuurders en ketenpartners. Op grond van artikel 5:11 van de Algemene wet bestuursrecht ben je aangewezen als toezichthouder en beschik je over de daarbij behorende bevoegdheden.

Wat ga je doen?

Toezicht op kwaliteit

Je onderzoekt of aanbieders voldoen aan de kwaliteitseisen van de Wmo 2015. Daarbij beoordeel je onder andere of ondersteuning:
• veilig wordt geleverd.
• doelmatig, doeltreffend en cliëntgericht is.
• aansluit bij de behoeften van de cliënt.
• wordt uitgevoerd volgens professionele standaarden.
• de rechten, autonomie en waardigheid van cliënten respecteert.

Je voert aangekondigde en onaangekondigde onderzoeken uit, analyseert dossiers, beoordeelt kwaliteitsdocumenten en voert gesprekken met bestuurders, medewerkers en cliënten.

Je stelt onderzoeksrapportages op en formuleert onderbouwde bevindingen en aanbevelingen.

Toezicht op rechtmatigheid

Daarnaast houd je toezicht op de rechtmatige besteding van Wmo-gelden. Je:
• beoordeelt signalen van mogelijke fraude of onrechtmatigheden.
• voert zelfstandig bestuursrechtelijke onderzoeken uit.
• past toezichthoudende bevoegdheden toe conform de Awb.
• analyseert risico's en patronen.
• adviseert over passende handhavingsmaatregelen.
• ondersteunt collega's bij complexe rechtmatigheidsvraagstukken.
• draagt bij aan preventie en bewustwording rondom fraude en misbruik.
• waar nodig werk je samen met gemeenten, toezichthouders, het RIEC, zorgkantoren, zorgverzekeraars en andere ketenpartners.

Daarnaast:
• neem je deel aan regionale samenwerkingsverbanden.
• adviseer je bestuur, management en collega's op strategisch, tactisch en operationeel niveau.
• rapporteer je periodiek aan de Teammanager Zorg en het college van Burgemeester en Wethouders.
• draag je bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling van toezicht, kwaliteit en handhaving binnen de gemeenten.

Je bent een onafhankelijke professional die stevig in zijn of haar schoenen staat. Je durft kritische vragen te stellen, maar weet ook relaties op te bouwen. Je bent nieuwsgierig, zorgvuldig en laat je leiden door feiten.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • HBO-niveau.
  • kennis van de Wmo 2015, Algemene wet bestuursrecht (Awb) en bij voorkeur de Wet langdurige zorg.
  • ervaring met toezicht, handhaving, kwaliteitsonderzoeken of fraudeonderzoeken is een pre.
  • sterke onderzoeks- en analysevaardigheden.
  • uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke communicatieve vaardigheden.
  • politiek-bestuurlijke sensitiviteit.
  • het vermogen om zelfstandig te werken én verbinding te zoeken.

title: Contractmanager WMO
description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor de gemeente Sittard-Geleen een Contractmanager WMO.

Als Contractmanager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling en uitvoering van contractmanagement in de Wmo voor de gemeente Sittard-Geleen, Beek en Stein. Je functioneert als Projectleider bij de aanbesteding van maatwerkvoorzieningen en je bent actief betrokken bij de keuze van de juiste indicatoren. Je onderhoudt en verbetert de relaties met de dienstverleners op basis van partnership en ondersteunt en adviseert in alle fasen van het inkoopproces. Tegelijkertijd ben je je bewust van het feit dat het publieke middelen betreft waarbij een zakelijke aanpak ook noodzakelijk kan zijn. Binnen je categorie ben je verantwoordelijk voor het meten en bewaken van de met de zorgaanbieders en leverancier(s) gemaakte service afspraken en contractcondities en het nemen van corrigerende acties, indien noodzakelijk, richting de uitvoering van het contract. Je bent de spin in het web tussen zorgaanbieders/leveranciers en de gemeenten. Je werkt nauw samen met de Inkoopadviseurs en de Leveranciersmanager. Binnen de uitvoerende teams werk je samen met de Consulenten Wmo, Kwaliteitsmedewerkers, Coördinatoren, Beleidsmedewerkers en de Toezichthouders Wmo.

Relatie- en contractmanagement

  • Je beheert contracten en onderhoudt de relatie met de contractpartijen.
  • Je bevordert het maximale resultaat en uitnutting van de contracten en bewaakt de kwaliteit daarvan.
  • Je bewaakt de naleving van de contractafspraken over normen, condities, termijnen e.d. en rapporteert daarover.
  • Je begeleidt aanbieders naar het gewenste resultaat.
  • Je voert overleg met contractpartijen en handelt klachten af indien deze een structureel karakter hebben. Indien nodig voer je escalatiegesprekken.
  • Je onderhoudt in- en externe netwerken.
  • Als Contractmanager neem je mede het voortouw in de samenwerking tussen gemeenten en zorgaanbieders.
  • Periodiek voer jij contractgesprekken en rapporteer je over trends in klachten en knelpunten die je signaleert. Ook adviseer je over stimulerende en indien nodig over corrigerende maatregelen.
  • Je beschikt over financieel inzicht (jaarrekening, verzilvering).

Advies en Informatie

  • Je bent aanspreekpunt voor alle contractpartijen in de Wmo en voor leerlingenvervoer van team Jeugd.
  • Je adviseert over vraagstukken en problemen op het gebied van contractmanagement.
  • Je signaleert trends en ontwikkelingen op het vakgebied en adviseert daarover.
  • Je levert een bijdrage aan de verdere ontwikkeling en professionalisering van het contractmanagement.
  • Je draagt bij aan de interne afstemming tussen de inkoopfunctie, leveranciersmanagement en het contractmanagement en andere betrokken disciplines.
  • Je analyseert informatie voor het management en beleid en doet aanbevelingen.
  • Je monitort of de leverancier de prestaties levert in overeenstemming met contractuele bepalingen.
  • Je zorgt ervoor dat de interne organisaties op de hoogte zijn van het contract.
  • Je zorgt ervoor dat de interne organisaties haar deel van de verplichtingen in het contract accuraat nakomen, inclusief tijdig voorzien in de randvoorwaarden.
  • Je zorgt ervoor dat het contract up to date blijft door regelmatig kosten en kwaliteit te monitoren.
  • Je zorgt ervoor dat de relatie tussen de eigen organisaties en de zorgaanbieders en leveranciers een open en positief karakter heeft en houdt.
  • Je bent betrokken bij alle fases van contracteren; van contract-initiatie tot evaluatie.
  • Je ziet erop toe dat beleidsdoelstellingen worden geconcretiseerd en vastgelegd in inkoopcontracten en bewaakt de naleving van de gemaakte afspraken door zorgaanbieders.

Jouw talenten

  • Je bent omgevingsbewust en neemt initiatieven.
  • Je bent goed in het onderhouden van contacten, maar kunt daarnaast ook zakelijk en overtuigend zijn.
  • Je bent resultaat- en kwaliteit gericht. Daarnaast ben je collegiaal en flexibel.
  • Je bent enthousiast om bij te dragen aan de doorontwikkeling van contractmanagement.

Verder neem je mee:

  • HBO - opleiding.
  • Aantoonbare werkervaring als Contractmanager.

title: Begeleider Specialistische zorg (16u-36u)
description:
Als begeleider Specialistische zorg ben jij degene die écht ziet wat een cliënt nodig heeft. Je voelt aan hoe iemand zich voelt en past jouw begeleiding hierop aan. Of dat nu begint met een warme glimlach bij het ontbijt of een rustige wandeling in de avond. Samen met je collega's zorg je voor een veilige, vertrouwde en gezellige sfeer waarin cliënten zich gezien en gehoord voelen.

Functie:

Als begeleider specialistische zorg ben je er vooral voor de cliënten. Samen met je collega's werk je aan de doelen van het zorgplan en zorg je ervoor dat de cliënten een goede dag hebben. Daarnaast draag je ook bij aan de algemene teamtaken, zoals bijvoorbeeld het netjes houden van de woning.
Je komt te werken op een woning waar cliënten specialistische zorg nodig hebben. Deze cliënten hebben vaak een ernstige-, en of meervoudige beperking, die specifiek aandacht vragen voor gedragsmatige en/of intensieve (lichamelijke) zorg.

Intensieve zorg:
Je begeleidt de cliënt in zijn of haar ritme van de dag. Op sommige woningen ondersteun je en stimuleer je de cliënt zoveel mogelijk zelf te doen en op andere woningen neem je de zorg over.

Gedragsmatige zorg:
Bij gedragsmatige zorg begeleid je cliënten die gedrag vertonen die moeilijk te begrijpen is, zoals agressie. Door zorgvuldig te observeren en klein te kunnen kijken, bied je hen de structuur en veiligheid die ze nodig hebben. Met een rustige houding en veel geduld weet jij passende ondersteuning te bieden, afgestemd op de individuele behoeften van de cliënt.

Daarnaast:

  • Ondersteun je bewoners bij hun dagelijkse ritme: van opstaan tot naar bed gaan. Bij de ene cliënt is dit meer gericht op ondersteuning, bij de ander meer op Algemene Dagelijkse Levensverrichtingen (ADL);

  • Zorg je voor een echt thuis voor de cliënten waar ze zich veilig voelen.

Wij vinden het belangrijk dat je een goed beeld krijgt en nemen je graag mee in de mogelijkheden bij Lunet. Tijdens een kennismakingsgesprek met een van onze recruiters gaan we dan ook samen bekijken welke woning het beste aansluit bij jouw wensen en jouw talenten.

Wij vragen:

Relevante opleiding Zorg en Welzijn, niveau 3. We gaan graag met je in gesprek om te ontdekken welke vaardigheden en eigenschappen jij kunt inzetten in deze functie.

Wij vragen al onze nieuwe medewerkers om een “Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag” (VOG) te overhandigen voor hun functie binnen Lunet.

We vinden het belangrijk dat je een goed beeld krijgt en nemen jou graag mee in de mogelijkheden bij Lunet. Tijdens een kennismakingsgesprek met een van onze recruiters gaan we dan ook samen kijken welke woning het beste aansluiten bij jouw talenten en wensen.

Het park biedt diverse faciliteiten voor zowel cliënten als medewerkers, zoals een boerderij, een moestuin en de mogelijkheid om met de huifkar over het terrein te rijden. title: Experienced Junior Graphic Designer - Scale-up company
description:
Monday Merch produces physical branded merchandise and custom apparel for international enterprise clients. Due to the high technical complexity of physical manufacturing, this role requires at least 1 year of hands-on experience specifically in merchandise, apparel, or packaging design.

A standard graphic design background is insufficient. The candidate must possess proven experience with pre-press production processes, including vectorizing artwork, Pantone (PMS) color matching, print separations for embroidery and Screen Printing/DTG, and mapping 2D artwork onto complex 3D product surfaces. Furthermore, the candidate must have experience executing designs within strict corporate B2B brand guidelines and working directly with technical specifications from global manufacturers.

About Monday Merch
Monday Merch is a fast-growing B2B merch platform based in Rotterdam. We design, produce, and deliver high-quality, sustainable custom merchandise and corporate gifts for leading global brands and scale-ups.

The Role: Graphic & Visual Designer
We are looking for a talented Graphic & Visual Designer to join our creative team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between creative visual design and physical product execution. You will be responsible for creating compelling visual assets, developing brand identities, and translating complex design concepts into production-ready physical merchandise.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop full visual identity packages, brand guidelines, and high-impact design assets.
Create production-ready vector files and technical specs (tech packs, CMYK/Pantone prepress) for apparel, accessories, and custom packaging.
Lead design projects from initial concept and artwork creation through final supplier handoff.
Collaborate with account managers, production teams, and external suppliers to maintain visual quality across physical products.

What We Offer:
A dynamic, international work environment in Rotterdam.
Full-time position (40h/week) with market-competitive remuneration.
Catered team lunches, travel reimbursement, and high-end merch benefits.

title: Fagleder Sykefraværsoppfølging
description:
I NAV jobber vi daglig med å gi mennesker mulighet til arbeid og aktivitet og sikre deres rettigheter til hjelp fra både stat og kommune. 
 
NAV Lier er en spennende arbeidsplass med ca 65 engasjerte medarbeidere fordelt på to avdelinger. Hos oss finner du rause og inkluderende kollegaer med kompetanse på områder som arbeidsinkludering, integrering, sosialfaglig oppfølging og rekruttering. Vi er opptatt av å samarbeide på tvers av fag og løse oppgaver i samarbeid med de som har behov for vår hjelp, med arbeidsgivere, med ulike tjenesteleverandører, med helsepersonell, tiltaksleverandører og andre samarbeidspartnere. Hele tiden med ønske om å bidra til innbyggernes beste. 

Er du faglig sterk, engasjert og opptatt av å utvikle både mennesker og fagmiljøer? Vi søker en fagleder for Sykefraværsoppfølging (SYFO) som vil være en viktig drivkraft i arbeidet med kvalitet, kompetanseutvikling og god praksis ved kontoret vårt. 

Som fagleder får du en sentral rolle i å styrke fagmiljøet og bidra til at flere mennesker kommer i arbeid eller aktivitet. Du motiveres av å omsette regelverk og fagkunnskap til praktisk veiledning, skape læring og støtte kollegaer i en kompleks og meningsfull arbeidshverdag. 

Dette er en nyopprettet rolle med tiltredelse tidligst 1. november 2026. Du vil arbeide i et tverrfaglig miljø preget av samarbeid, brukermedvirkning og et viktig samfunnsoppdrag. I stillingen vil oppgavene være fordelt tilsvarende 50/50 mellom oppfølging av egen portefølje og fagansvar på kontoret. Fagleder vil være en del av utvidet ledergruppe, delta i assistansevarslingsgruppen som jobber med sikkerhet på kontoret og vil kunne fungere for avdelingsleder ved fravær. 
Arbeidsoppgaver

-Ha fagansvar for SYFO ved kontoret i om lag 50 % av stillingen, herunder opplæring, kompetanseutvikling og resultatoppfølging. 
-Bidra til forsvarlig saksbehandling, god kvalitet og lik praksis innen fagområdet. 
-Ivareta koordinerende oppgaver ved behov, som oppgavefordeling ved fravær, porteføljegjennomganger, kvalitetsoppfølging og møteledelse. 
-Være en pådriver i utviklings- og forbedringsarbeid i samarbeid med ledelse og kollegaer. 
-Veilede og støtte medarbeidere i faglige spørsmål og bidra til kunnskapsdeling på tvers av team og fagområder. 
-Være bindeledd og deltager inn mot fagnettverk. 
-Være en viktig støtte for ledergruppen og bistå med øvrige oppgaver ved behov. 
-Ha ansvar for en egen brukerportefølje (redusert til ca. 50 %). Dette innebærer kartlegging, avklaring av muligheter, planlegging av videre prosess og samarbeid med interne og eksterne aktører, særlig arbeidsgivere og behandlere. Oppfølgingen er i tråd NAV Vest-Vikens metodikk for sykefraværsoppfølging. 
-Utføre forvaltnings- og saksbehandlingsoppgaver i tråd med gjeldende regelverk, herunder folketrygdloven og NAV-loven. 

Da Nav er i kontinuerlig omstilling, vil ikke beskrivelsen være uttømmende og endringer i stillingsbeskrivelsen og ansvar må påregnes. 

Stillingen rapporterer til avdelingsleder og har ikke personalansvar. 

Kvalifikasjoner-Fullført relevant høyere utdanning på minimum bachelornivå, eksempelvis innen sosialt arbeid, velferdsfag eller jus gjerne i kombinasjon med ledelse og/eller pedagogikk.
-Omfattende erfaring fra sykefraværsoppfølging i NAV og det er også ønskelig med kompetanse på saksbehandling av AAP (11-5.) 
-Erfaring med veilednings-, motivasjons- og endringsarbeid. 
-Erfaring med forvaltningspraksis og anvendelse av lovverk. 
-Erfaring med analyse, resultatoppfølging eller kvalitetsarbeid. 
-Erfaring med koordinering, fag- eller teamledelse er en fordel. 
-God muntlig og skriftlig framstillingsevne på norsk. 

Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt. Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter deg som: 

-er trygg på regelverket og er opptatt av kvalitet og rettssikkerhet. 
-er trygg i rollen som faglig pådriver og veileder.                                                                                                                                                                                                                             -er tydelig og trygg i møte med utviklingsarbeid
-er tydelig og trygg på hva som forventes i kollegaers faglige utvikling
-er trygg i å jobbe med motstand                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             -har gode samarbeids og relasjonsferdigheter med de rundt deg og på på tvers av fagområder 
-har evne til å skape tillit, motivasjon og engasjement hos andre.  
-deler kunnskap og evner å formidle komplekse problemstillinger på en forståelig måte. 
-tar initiativ, samtidig som du involverer og legger til rette for eierskap for kollegaer.  
-arbeider strukturert, målrettet og effektivt, evner å prioritere i en hektisk hverdag. 
-har god gjennomføringsevne og klarer å omsette mål og planer ut i praksis. 
-tar ansvar, er handlekraftig og robust i møte med utfordringer 
-gir tydelige tilbakemeldinger og evner å støtte kollegaer i å nå utviklingsmål. 
-bidrar til et positivt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø 

Vi tilbyrHos oss vil du få spennende utfordringer og stor faglig utvikling. Vi lover deg stor variasjon i arbeidsdagens innhold og ett arbeidsmiljø preget av høyt tempo, høy fagkompetanse, godt kollegialt samhold, mye omsorg og latter. 

Stillingen lønnes som rådgiver/seniorrådgiver i kode 1434/1364, i lønnsspennet 661 000- 700 000/694 000- 724 000.

title: Vi søker tilkalling kveld og helg til REMA 1000 Guldbergaunet
description:
Ønsker du en aktiv ekstrajobb hvor du får skape gode handleopplevelser? 🤩

Nå søker vi en ekstrahjelp/tilkallingsvikar og ser etter deg som liker å ta i et tak og er opptatt av gode kundeopplevelser. Du møter kundene med et smil, hjelper når de trenger det, og sørger for at butikken vår alltid føles som et hyggelig sted å handle.

Hva får du jobbe med? ✨

Hos oss får du en aktiv arbeidsdag der du bidrar med alt fra å fylle på varer og sitte i kassa til å ta imot leveranser og sørge for at butikken ser innbydende ut. Men det stopper ikke der. Du er også den som hilser kunden velkommen, gir dem en god avskjed, og tar initiativ til å hjelpe – enten det er å finne en vare, bytte noe de ikke var fornøyd med, eller gi anbefalinger med et smil.

Hvem ser vi etter? 🔍

Vi ser etter deg som brenner for god service og trives i møte med mennesker. Du er den som får ting gjort, som liker et hektisk tempo, og som alltid har kunden i fokus. I tillegg:

  • Er du positiv og offensiv, og bidrar til engasjement og trivsel på jobb
  • Trives du med å jobbe både selvstendig og som en del av et team
  • Liker systemdrift og å følge rutiner, og har et øye for detaljer
  • Tar ansvar, er ærlig og til å stole på
  • Er god til å kommunisere i møte med kundene våre på en hyggelig og profesjonell måte
  • Har fylt 18 år

Hvorfor velge REMA 1000? 💙

I REMA 1000 er mulighetene mange for mennesker som tør å gi av seg selv, er positive og selvstendige. Hos oss er det plass til alle – mangfold gjør oss sterkere. Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg og gleder oss til å ønske deg velkommen som en del av teamet vårt.

Hos oss får du:

  • En trivelig arbeidsplass med hyggelige kollegaer
  • Muligheter for utvikling
  • Et miljø hvor du får støtten du trenger til å lykkes i rollen din
  • Variasjon og energi i hverdagen – ingen dager er helt like!

Les mer på oss på vår karriereside: https://www.rema.no/karriere/

Høres dette ut som jobben for deg? Da gleder vi oss til å høre fra deg 👋

 

Om rekrutteringsprosessen: 

I våre rekrutteringsprosesser benytter vi oss av testverktøy for å kunne bli bedre kjent med deg. Aktuelle kandidater vil motta e-post med link til testene kort tid etter innsendt søknad. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

REMA 1000 er blant Norges største dagligvareaktør og en av landets sterkeste merkevarer. Siden 1979 har REMA 1000 jobbet for å kunne tilby kunder over hele landet et godt utvalg av dagligvarer til laveste pris, av høy kvalitet, produsert og solgt på en ansvarlig måte. Ved å ha hyggelige og dyktige mennesker med riktige holdninger og fokus på å jobbe med de rette tingene, har REMA 1000 lykkes med å skape en solid virksomhet som er lønnsom ikke bare for sine kjøpmenn og for bedriften - men også for kundene.
Ønsker du å lese mer om vårt arbeid med miljø og samfunnsansvar; https://www.rema.no/ansvar-i-rema-1000/

title: Stortinget søker formidlere med engasjement for demokrati, historie og politikk
description:
Vil du være med på å formidle om demokratiet på en måte som engasjerer, inspirerer og skaper forståelse?  

Vi har fem ledige deltidsstillinger (28 %) som formidler: 

  • tre stillinger med oppstart 1. oktober 2026 
  • to stillinger med oppstart 1. januar 2027  

Arbeidsoppgaver

Hos Stortinget får du en unik mulighet til å skape opplevelser som knytter publikum tettere til Norges demokratiske hjerte. Vi søker formidlere som brenner for formidling – og som ønsker å være en del av et miljø der kvalitet og faglighet står i sentrum. 

Om stillingene

Som formidler blir du en viktig del av arbeidet med å gjøre Stortinget tilgjengelig, relevant og forståelig for et bredt publikum. Du vil først og fremst arbeide med omvisninger, og bidra til opplevelser som skaper læring og engasjement. Du vil også arbeide med publikumsrettede aktiviteter og andre oppgaver etter avtale med leder. 

Rollen egner seg for deg som trives med varierte oppgaver innen formidling, service og operativt arbeid, og som ønsker å bidra i et profesjonelt og meningsfylt miljø. 

Den som ansettes, vil ha en arbeidstid som gjennomsnittsberegnes. Det betyr at arbeidstiden vil kunne variere fra uke til uke innenfor arbeidsmiljølovens grenser. Arbeidet innebærer omvisninger i sommersesongen, i tillegg til omvisninger på lørdager resten av året. Etter hvert som vi sammen videreutvikler formidlingen, vil arbeidsfeltet være i endring. Vi tar forbehold om justeringer i ansvar og arbeidsoppgaver som følge av dette. 

Om seksjonen

Seksjon for besøk og formidling består av 17 medarbeidere og har ansvaret for omvisninger og læringsspill for besøkende grupper, både for allmennheten og Stortingets øvrige pedagogiske tilbud til skolen. I tillegg driver seksjonen utvikling og forvaltning av digitale lærings- og formidlingsressurser, og formidler om Stortingets virksomhet og historie gjennom arrangementer, kurs, utstillinger og trykket materiell. Til seksjonen ligger også den administrative forvaltningen av formidlingstilbudet.  

Stortingets administrasjon har som ambisjon å stadig videreutvikle våre formidlingsaktiviteter for å nå et bredere allment publikum. Aktiv formidling om Stortingets rolle og virksomhet er løftet frem som eget satsingsområde i ny virksomhetsstrategi for Stortingets administrasjon. 

Kvalifikasjoner

Vi ser etter deg som har: 

  • relevant fullført eller pågående utdanning innen samfunnsfag, pedagogikk, formidling, kommunikasjon eller lignende
  • erfaring med publikumskontakt, formidling eller arrangementsarbeid 
  • god formidlingsevne på norsk og engelsk, skriftlig og muntlig  
  • trygghet i møte med ulike mennesker og situasjoner 
  • evne til å ta initiativ og jobbe strukturert i et miljø med høye kvalitetskrav 
  • tredjespråk er ønskelig, men ikke et krav 

Erfaring fra arbeid i offentlige institusjoner, kulturvirksomhet eller organisasjonsliv er en fordel.

Personlige egenskaper

For å trives og lykkes hos oss, må du også være:   

  • glad i å samarbeide, men også selvstendig når det kreves
  • interessert i samfunn, demokrati og formidling
  • ha integritet, høy etisk bevissthet og god rolleforståelse   

 Personlig egnethet vektlegges.

Hvorfor skal du velge oss?

Vi tilbyr:

  • varierte oppgaver og et meningsfullt samfunnsoppdrag
  • et engasjert, kompetent og hyggelig arbeidsmiljø i egen seksjon og avdeling
  • kollegastøtte og veiledning, faglig påfyll gjennom samlinger i egen seksjon og avdeling
  • kompetansehevende arbeidsoppgaver, tiltak og kurs
  • et arbeidssted med historisk sus, tett på aktuelle begivenheter med betydning for landets innbyggere  

Stillingene lønnes som førstekonsulent/rådgiver i lønnsspenn kroner 588 600 – 656 700 (i 100 % stilling), avhengig av kvalifikasjoner og erfaring. Fra lønnen trekkes 2 % til innskudd i Statens pensjonskasse. For stillingene gjelder seks måneders prøvetid. 

Stortinget er opptatt av mangfold, og ønsker å være en arbeidsplass som gjenspeiler befolkningen. Vi oppfordrer derfor alle kvalifiserte til å søke jobb uten hensyn til alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne eller etnisk bakgrunn. Stortinget legger arbeidsforholdene til rette for personer med nedsatt funksjonsevne. 

Når du søker jobb hos oss, vil navnet ditt stå på en offentlig søkerliste. Det er mulig å be om å bli unntatt denne søkerlisten. Da må du i så fall begrunne hvorfor du ønsker det, og vi tar deretter stilling til om vi kan innvilgeønsket ditt. Kan vi ikke det, hører du fra oss. 

Spørsmål om stillingen kan rettes til seksjonsleder Kjersti Lillebø, telefon 997 12 673.   

Søknad, CV og attester/vitnemål skal sendes elektronisk via denne siden «Søk stillingen» innen 7. september 2026. Du vil bli bedt om å fremvise dine vitnemål/karakterutskrifter gjennom å gi oss tilgang til Vitnemålsportalen. Attester og vitnemål returneres ikke. 

Her er lenke til vår personvernerklæring. 
Personvernerklæringen gir deg informasjon om hvordan Stortinget behandler dine personopplysninger når du søker jobb hos oss.

Stortingets administrasjon har som formål å støtte den parlamentariske virksomheten og sørge for gode rammebetingelser for representantenes arbeid. Vi arbeider med å formidle kunnskap om folkestyret og Stortingets virksomhet, forvalte og sikre Stortingets verdier, og ivareta og fornye Stortinget som institusjon.

title: Mål- og metodeutvikler, datanettverk og etterretningsanalyse
description:
Etterretningstjenesten – Viten om verden for vern av Norge

Etterretningstjenestens visjon er å bidra til norske myndigheters beslutningsgrunnlag med rettidig, pålitelig og relevant kunnskap om verden rundt oss. Vår evne til å utføre oppdraget er i stor grad avhengig av at vi finner relevant informasjon i stadig mer komplekse datastrømmer og kilder.

Er du nysgjerrig og analytisk, har en datateknisk utdanning, og er interessert i datanettverk eller kommunikasjonsteknologi? Da kan du være den rette kandidaten for oss.

Som mål- og metodeutvikler i det digitale rom vil dine hovedoppgaver være å bearbeide store mengder informasjon fra en rekke ulike tekniske kilder, med spesielt fokus på nettverksdata, og foredle disse. Du vil utvikle nye metoder for maskinell dataanalyse, og bidra til opplæring og erfaringsoverføring i enheten og organisasjonen. Du vil også planlegge og følge opp utviklingsinitiativer i samarbeid med andre enheter i organisasjonen. Stillingen byr på spennende og varierte oppgaver i et dynamisk miljø preget av samarbeid og analytisk sparring. Du vil bli skolert innenfor etterretningsprofesjonen og vil på sikt bli kvalifisert som etterretningsspesialist.

Som medarbeider i Etterretningstjenesten vil du bidra i vårt viktige samfunnsoppdrag, samt være en del av et miljø kjennetegnet av høy kompetanse og sterkt engasjement for fagfeltet.

Vi er avhengige av mangfold i perspektiver og erfaringer for å løse våre oppdrag. Derfor ønsker vi å rekruttere medarbeidere fra ulike bakgrunner, med ulike livserfaringer til å jobbe hos oss.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Utvikle metoder og verktøy for sammenstilling og bearbeiding av data og informasjon for å sikre optimal utnyttelse av innhenting.
  • Skape analytisk verdi av data for andre i etterretningstjenesten.
  • Utvikling av nye metoder og verktøy for maskinell bearbeiding og analyse. Gi opplæring og erfaringsoverføring internt.
  • Følge opp utviklingsinitiativer, sørge for fremdrift, og koordinere relevante ressurser på tvers av organisasjonen.
Kvalifikasjoner

Stillingen har følgende krav som må innfris for å bli vurdert som aktuell søker:

  • Bachelorgrad eller utdanning på tilsvarende nivå (cand.-grader, tidl. Ingeniørutdanninger o.l.) eller omfang innen relevant fagområde. Relevant høyere utdanning og flerårig erfaring med god resultatoppnåelse vil kunne kompensere for utdanningskravet.
  • Relevant erfaring (ferdighetene kan være tilegnet gjennom utdanning, arbeid, eller gjennom aktiviteter knyttet til egeninteresse).
  • Meget gode muntlige og skriftlige norsk- og engelskkunnskaper.

Senioringeniør:

  • Mastergrad eller utdanning på tilsvarende nivå (hovedfag, profesjonsstudier o.l.) eller omfang innen relevant fagområde. Flerårig relevant erfaring med god resultatoppnåelse vil kunne kompensere for utdanningskravet.
  • Relevant arbeidserfaring (for eksempel innen informasjonsteknologi  og/eller kommunikasjonsteknologi.

I tillegg er det ønskelig om du har:

  • God kunnskap om datanettverk, protokoller, trafikkanalyse
  • Erfaring med maskinlæring
  • Erfaring med dataanalyse og/eller – visualisering
  • Erfaring med datainnsamling,-rensing,-modellering og kvalitetssikring
  • Utviklererfaring
  • Etterretningsfaglig operativ erfaring
  • Erfaring med bi- og multilaterale etterretningssamarbeid

    Særskilte krav for stilling i Etterretningstjenesten: 

    Søkere må tilfredsstille kravene til høyeste sikkerhetsklarering.

    For ansettelse i Etterretningstjenesten kan man ikke ha annet enn norsk statsborgerskap ved ansettelsestidspunktet.

    Stillingen er underlagt beordringsplikt, jf. forsvarsloven og forsvarstilsatteforskriften, som innebærer at du kan beordres til internasjonale operasjoner. Dette skjer normalt på grunnlag av villighet. Beordringsplikt medfører krav til medisinsk og fysisk skikkethet og grunnleggende engelskkunnskaper. Dersom du ikke oppfyller kravene har du mulighet til å søke dispensasjon.

    Personlige egenskaper

      Personlig egnethet for en stilling i Etterretningstjenesten vil bli ilagt stor vekt.

      • Holdninger og pålitelighet: Etterretningstjenesten krever høy faglig- og personlig integritet, pålitelighet og lojalitet av sine medarbeidere.
      • Lærelyst og planmessighet: Vi søker personer som ivrer for sitt fagfelt, og som møter arbeidsdagen med lærelyst og et ønske om å levere.
      • Samspill og samarbeid: I Etterretningstjenesten er vi opptatt av å ha et godt arbeidsmiljø. God lagånd, respekt og toleranse i møte med andre er av stor betydning.
      • Stressmestring: Det er en forutsetning at våre medarbeidere har evnen til å stå i periodevis stor arbeidsbelastning.

      Personlig egnethet tillegges stor vekt. Vi ser etter en person som er kreativ og initiativrik, som evner å se gode løsninger og som har gode samarbeids- og kommunikasjonsevner. 

      Vi tilbyr

      Hos oss får du en spennende og samfunnsviktig jobb hvor du vil kunne utgjøre en forskjell.

      Etterretningstjenesten er opptatt av å øke kompetansen hos de ansatte, og det vil satses både på deg som person og din faginteresse.

      Våre ansatte har fleksitid, mulighet for trening i arbeidstiden, samt gunstige lån- og pensjonsordninger gjennom Statens pensjonskasse.

      Du vil få en årslønn innenfor spennet kr 690 000 – 830 000 i stilling som Overingeniør (kode: 1087) eller kr 785 000 – 980 000 i stilling som Senioringeniør (kode 1181) iht. gjeldende Hovedtariffavtale. For spesielt kvalifiserte søkere kan høyere lønn vurderes. Endelig lønnsplassering og stillingskode avhenger av kvalifikasjoner.

      Om arbeidsgiveren:

      Hva er det egentlig som skjer i verden?

      Etterretningstjenesten henter inn, bearbeider og analyserer informasjon på vegne av Norge. Dette gjør vi for å gi norske myndigheter et best mulig grunnlag for å ta gode beslutninger. Vi er en del av Forsvaret, men løser også oppdrag for resten av myndighetsapparatet. Tjenesten arbeider etter overordnede politiske prioriteringer og føringer. Mer informasjon om oss finner du på etj.no. Her finner du også Fokus - Etterretningstjenestens åpne vurdering av aktuelle sikkerhetsutfordringer.

      Vi er avhengige av mangfold i perspektiver og erfaringer for å løse våre oppdrag. Derfor ønsker vi å rekruttere medarbeidere fra ulike bakgrunner, med ulike livserfaringer til å jobbe hos oss. title: Kopier - Verkstedmedarbeider
description:

Dekk Sjekk AS ønsker nå og styrke teamet, og ser derfor etter en pliktoppfyllende, pålitelig og selvgående verkstedmedarbeider, til å ta del i selskapets videre vekst. Erfaring er ønskelig, men har du interesse for å jobbe med bil, hører vi gjerne fra deg.
