title: CLEANING SUPERVISOR  HOSTEL
description:
CLEANING SUPERVISOR – HOSTEL

Stockholm, Sweden

We are looking for a hands-on Cleaning Supervisor to join our growing hostel group in central Stockholm. This role is ideal for someone with strong cleaning experience who is organized, responsible and enjoys working with people in an international environment.

Who we are looking for

    Previous experience in professional cleaning and preferably as a cleaning supervisor or team leader.
    

    Strong cleaning skills and a good understanding of cleanliness and hygiene standards.
    

    Able to communicate confidently in English, both spoken and written.
    

    Responsible, organized and attentive to detail.
    

    Comfortable supervising and coordinating a small team.
    

    Positive, practical and willing to take initiative.
    

    EU citizenship or permanent residency/work authorization in an EU country.
    

    Experience in hospitality, hostels or hotels is a plus, as is education within hospitality or service.

You do not need extensive hospitality or management experience to be considered. If you have strong cleaning experience, the right attitude and are willing to learn, we are happy to train you in the other parts of the role.

The role

As Cleaning Supervisor, you will both work hands-on with cleaning and supervise a small team. Your responsibilities include:

    Cleaning guest rooms, bathrooms and common areas.
    

    Supervising and coordinating the cleaning team.
    

    Checking rooms and common areas to ensure our cleanliness standards are maintained.
    

    Planning and distributing daily cleaning tasks.
    

    Keeping track of cleaning supplies, linen and other necessities.
    

    Helping with hostel reception and guest-related tasks when needed.
    

    Reporting maintenance issues and helping solve practical day-to-day problems.
    

    Communicating with the hostel management, online reception and remote team.

The position is approximately 40–50 hours per week, working in shifts during the hostel’s operating hours, with 1–2 days off per week. You will have flexibility to organize your schedule according to the needs of the property.

About us

We are a growing hospitality company currently operating three hostels in central Stockholm. Our goal is to build an international hostel group based around our Scandinavian Nomad design concept.

Our organization combines on-site teams with an online team and online reception. For the right person, there are opportunities to grow within the company and take on more responsibility over time.

What we offer

Salary: 27,000 SEK/month gross

Relocation: Flight to Stockholm included

Accommodation: Affordable staff accommodation available at the hostel

Vacation: One month paid vacation per year

You will work in a friendly, international environment, meet people from around the world and have the opportunity to develop your English, hospitality and leadership skills while experiencing life in Stockholm.

title: Hostel / Hotel Manager
description:
HOSTEL / HOTEL MANAGER

Stockholm, Sweden

We are looking for a hands-on Hostel / Hotel Manager to join our growing hospitality company in central Stockholm. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining team management with the practical, day-to-day operation of a hostel.

Who we are looking for

    Fluent and confident in English, both spoken and written.
    

    Preferably 3+ years of experience in hospitality, including experience in a managerial or supervisory role.

    Comfortable using computers, basic Excel and different online systems and tools.

    Handling minor maintenance and practical issues.

The position is approximately 40–50 hours per week, working in shifts during the hostel's operating hours, with 1–2 days off per week. As manager, you have flexibility to organize your own schedule according to the needs of the property.

About us

We are a growing hospitality company operating hostels in central Stockholm, with the ambition to build an international hostel group characterized by Scandinavian design and the Nomad concept.

Our organization combines an on-site team with an online team and online reception. For the right person, there are excellent opportunities to grow with the company and take on greater responsibility as we expand.

What we offer

Salary: 30,000 SEK/month gross

Relocation: Flight to Stockholm included

Vacation: One month paid vacation per year

You will work in an international environment, meet people from all over the world and have the opportunity to develop your management, hospitality and communication skills while experiencing life in Stockholm.

title: Bar Manager
description:
MAP Petite Maison is on the search for a talented and well-presented Bar Manager to join the team. MAP Petite Maison is a dedicated cocktail and whisky bar situated on Vasagatan in Stockholm specialising in Japanese whisky, cocktails and small plates.

The right candidate is expected to have a genuine passion and enthusiasm to provide five-star service to all our guests. This position will suit a social person whose main drive is to provide an excellent and memorable experience for all guests.

Your duties will include:

    Working closely with the team to learn the correct ways of service and how to improve the guest experience continuously
    Learn how to make all in house cocktails and an extensive number of classic cocktails in order to help the customer to make an excellent choice based on their described preferences
    Study Japanese and other world whiskies in order to confidently be able to recommend and describe whiskies on the whisky menu
    Preparing food and develop the food concept

    Ensuring the correct set-up of the venue and that it is checked and maintained throughout the day and night

    Assisting with other tasks in the venue as required

title: Group FP&A Manager
description:

Instabee has come a long way in a short time. We've built one of Europe's leading delivery companies through strong growth, acquisitions and continuous innovation. But we're still early in our journey, and the next chapter will require even better planning, sharper execution and smarter decision-making.

That's where you come in.

We're looking for an ambitious, analytical and hands-on person to shape the next chapter of FP&A at Instabee. You'll work closely with our Director of Group FP&A & Treasury, the CFO and the Group Management Team and take ownership of some of Instabee's most important planning, performance management and strategic finance priorities.

Success in this role isn't measured by the analyses you produce, but by the decisions you help make.

What you'll do

You will:

    

Drive strategic planning, including our long-term plan, OKRs and initiatives.

    

Partner with the CFO on analyses, Board material, presentations and other high-impact projects.

    

Set direction and raise standards for how the Group approaches planning, forecasting, performance management and business steering.

    

Develop our FP&A capabilities, processes and tools - leveraging AI to fundamentally rethink how FP&A operates and creates value.

    

Build the models, analyses and management reporting that turn financial information into better decisions.

This isn't a role where everything is already in place. Some days you'll work on long-term strategy. Other days you'll improve forecasting, prepare management material or solve a business problem. We think the best finance leaders enjoy both.

Who you are

You likely have experience from a top-tier strategy consulting firm (McKinsey, BCG, Bain or similar), or another highly analytical environment, with a track record of independently owning complex problems and influencing senior stakeholders.

You probably thrive if you:

    

Have a genuine interest in finance, strategy and value creation.

    

Enjoy solving difficult problems and creating structure from ambiguity.

    

Like building and improving things - not just recommending them.

    

Take ownership and are comfortable rolling up your sleeves.

    

Communicate clearly and work well with senior stakeholders.

Previous FP&A experience isn't required. Analytical ability, curiosity and drive matter more.

Why join?

You'll help shape both a company and a Finance function during an exciting stage of our journey.

You'll work directly with senior leadership, take ownership and help shape how Instabee plans, prioritises and creates value.

For the right person, this role offers an excellent opportunity to broaden their impact across Finance and grow into broader finance leadership.

What you’ll get

We can promise you that you will be challenged, develop your skills and have the opportunity to work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like changes and want to set new processes and ways of working - this is the place for you!

Of course, we have all the necessary and standard benefits in place, but in addition to this, we can also offer:

    

🌇 Sky-High Office: Modern and newly renovated with a 360-degree view around Stockholm.

    

🐶 Puppy Friendly: Bring your dog to work - we've got a whole floor for our furry friends!

    

🏓 Fun & Games: Ping pong, Shuffleboard, Foosball, and even a Karaoke Room for your leisure time.

    

👶 Parental Pay for Six Months: Step away from work and provide the best care and love to your little one.

    

🎂 A Day Off on Your Birthday: We love to celebrate, so enjoy your birthday to the fullest with a day off each year!

    

⏰ Hybrid setup and flexible working hours

Get to know us

In 2022, Instabee was founded after combining Budbee and Instabox - two leading last-mile delivery companies with three consumer-facing brands: Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy. Instabee serves millions of consumers across Europe with convenient deliveries and is on track to become the leading European e-commerce enabler. Always with the consumer at heart.

We’re fast, both in terms of parcel delivery and when it comes to growing our business. So far our journey has taken us from Sweden to the rest of Scandinavia and parts of continental Europe, but we have no plans on stopping anytime soon. As we continue to expand, the complexity of Instabee grows in parallel. With that in mind, we’re now looking for you to help us on the journey ahead.

title: Expression of Interest  Freelance International Recruiter

About Jobs By Nordics

You will have the freedom to develop your own ways of finding candidates while working with the vacancies and recruitment opportunities available through Jobs By Nordics.

Who are we looking for?

First and foremost, we are looking for people who are proactive, independent and good with people.

You should enjoy communicating with new people and be comfortable taking initiative rather than waiting for candidates to come to you.

Fluent English is required.

At the moment, we are particularly interested in people who also speak:

    Danish
    

    German
    

    Dutch

Previous experience within recruitment or sales is an advantage, but it is not necessarily a requirement. The right personality, motivation and ability to connect with people are equally important.

    Are comfortable approaching and communicating with new people

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
Why Doktor.se

Doktor.se is Sweden's largest digital healthcare provider. We combine physical clinics with a digital platform serving millions of consultations per year across Sweden, Germany, and Norway. What you'll do

Our infrastructure works, but it was built to solve yesterday's problems. We need someone who can help us get to where we want to be — not maintain what we have, but reshape it. If you want a place where everything is already figured out, this isn't it. If you want to build something better, here's what you'd own:

    

Build a deployment platform where teams ship their own services without asking you for permission.

    

Design infrastructure that is secure by default, so teams don't have to think about encryption, network isolation, or data residency. It just works.

    

Create deployment pipelines where security scanning, policy checks, and compliance happen automatically, invisible when everything is fine, loud when something needs attention.

    

Support and scale infrastructure for AI workloads, we run models in production across our platform, and that footprint is growing.

    

Set up observability that gives teams real insight into their own services, useful dashboards, alerts that mean something, not noise that everyone ignores.

    

Work closely with developers to understand what slows them down, and then fix it. Not by doing it for them, but by making it easy for them to do it themselves.

    

Maintain and evolve our cloud account structure, networking, and identity management across multiple regions and products.

Some weeks you'll write infrastructure code. Some weeks you'll pair with a developer to debug a slow service. Some weeks you'll design how a new product gets its own isolated infrastructure. The common thread: you make the teams around you better.

Make developers faster, not more dependent on you.

What we're looking for

    

You've built and operated Kubernetes in production. Not just deployed a Helm chart once, you've debugged networking issues, designed RBAC policies, and thought about how multiple teams share a cluster without stepping on each other.

    

You know AWS well. Accounts, networking, IAM, KMS. You have opinions about what should live in Kubernetes and what genuinely needs to be an AWS managed service, and you lean toward keeping things in Kubernetes where possible.

    

You've worked with GitOps and infrastructure as code. Flux, ArgoCD, Terrafor, specific tools matter less than the principle: infrastructure changes go through pull requests, are reviewed, and are auditable.

    

You understand developers because you are one. You can read their code, understand their pipelines, and have meaningful conversations about architecture.

    

You think about security as something you design into systems, not something you review at the end.

    

You have opinions, and you can change them when someone makes a better argument.

    

University degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent experience.

Tech stack

Cloud - AWS (multi-account, multi-region)

Orchestration - Kubernetes / EKS

IaC - Terraform

CI/CD - GitHub Actions

Languages - Python, TypeScript

AI - OpenAI, Anthropic (in production and tooling)

Observability - Datadog / Grafana (you'll shape this)

What we offer

    

Real influence. You'll shape how our platform works, not just operate what someone else designed.

    

Healthcare context. Patient data, regulatory compliance, and real consequences for getting it wrong. What you build actually matters.

    

Small team, direct impact. 25 engineers, your work is visible, not lost in a machine.

    

Autonomy. No micromanagement, no endless approval chains.

    

AI in production. We're running LLMs in patient and clinician workflows today, the infrastructure needs to grow with that.

    

Collective agreement, 30 days vacation, wellness allowance, personal development budget.

Practical details

Employment: Permanent, full-time. Six month probation period.

    

Location: On-site, Monday–Thursday at Sveavägen 63, Stockholm. Fridays are flexible.

title: Master Thesis Project  Material Characterization
description:
Seco in Fagersta is offering a master thesis project within the R&D Materials and Technology Department, focusing on material characterization of cemented carbide cutting tools for high-performance machining applications.

Background  

Composite materials composed of a hard ceramic phase-traditionally tungsten carbide-and a ductile binder phase, typically cobalt, are commonly referred to as hard materials or cemented carbides. These materials are produced using a powder metallurgy process that includes wet milling, spray drying, compaction, and sintering.

Cemented carbides offer an attractive combination of high hardness and toughness. By adjusting grain size and binder content, their properties can be tailored to meet specific application needs.

With a strong focus on sustainability and circularity, the production and use of recycled cemented carbides contribute to reducing environmental impact and improving resource efficiency.

Work description  

In this project, you investigate plastic deformation in cemented carbide cutting inserts, with a particular focus on how deformation varies across the cutting edge region. Previous studies show that plastic deformation is highly heterogeneous and strongly dependent on the specific location analyzed. This variability highlights the need for large-area characterization to obtain representative and reliable results.

The project involves advanced microstructural characterization using Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) over large, stitched areas. A central focus is to systematically map and analyse deformation across extended regions beneath the cutting edge, rather than relying on small, localized observations.

You apply Electron Backscatter Diffraction (EBSD) to quantify local plastic deformation through Kernel Average Misorientation (KAM) analysis, providing insights into local strain and dislocation density. In addition, SEM image analysis is used to identify and evaluate deformation-related features such as binder redistribution, shear band formation, and microstructural heterogeneity.

Overall, the project aims to enhance the understanding of how plastic deformation develops in cutting tools and how it can be reliably quantified using large-area SEM and EBSD-based techniques. The work is also closely connected to the ongoing European project AIM-NEXT, which focuses on the design and implementation of non-CRM hard materials for next-generation extreme applications. (https://www.aimnext.eu/)

Your background  

We’re looking for a highly motivated student in Materials Science or a related field. A curious mindset, a structured approach to work, and the ability to independently carry out laboratory tasks after initial training are essential. Prior laboratory experience is considered an advantage, as is familiarity with SEM.

title: Master Thesis Project  Material Science
description:
Seco in Fagersta is offering a master’s thesis project within the R&D Materials Development group, focusing on the sintering kinetics of recycled cemented carbide. The project combines materials science, sintering behavior, and material properties related to the sintering process.

We offer a great workplace with access to state-of-the-art R&D facilities and collaboration with a top-tier research team. You gain valuable experience in materials science, including Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) and Electron Backscatter Detector (EBSD) and various materials characterization techniques.

Background and scope of the project

Circularity in the carbide industry is essential for reducing CO₂ emissions and lowering costs due to the limited resources of tungsten and cobalt. This project explores how increasing the proportion of recycled cemented carbide powder impacts the sintering process. Today, recycling worn-out carbide tools is well established, with cemented carbide powders containing up to 50–100% recycled material depending on grade and availability.

Work description:

    Conduct sintering experiments in lab scale furnace
    Measuring:
    Magnetic properties (related WC grain size and carbon balance)
    Dimension (shrinkage control quality related)
    Hardness of the sintered cemented carbide (Standard Vickers method)
    Toughness of the cemented carbide (crack resistance by Palmqvist method)
    SEM analysis of structure (WC grain size EBSD)
    Analysis of results
    Thesis writing

The experimental factors are set up with the statistical method Design of Experiments (DOE) in collaboration with the supervisor at Seco. Conducted at the Fagersta production site, the study is experimental including analysis and supported by both the R&D team and production technicians. 

Your profile  

We’re looking for a curious and technology driven MSc student with a focus on material science or material chemistry. Knowledge in metallurgy, physics, mechanical engineering, and similar skills are valuable. Previous experience with SEM and EBSD is advantageous, along with analytical and mathematical skills. Acting in an international environment, good English skills are essential.

Duration of the project

This thesis project lasts for 22 weeks with a flexible start date, preferably around January 19th, 2027. We offer you accommodation in Fagersta and you receive payment when finalizing the thesis. You’ll also present your findings both written and verbally.

You have:

    Vocational training in IT or a related field.
    ITIL Foundation certification.
    Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken.
    1–3 years of experience in an IT Service Desk, Helpdesk, or Technical
    Support role.
    Experience working with IT Service Management (ITSM) tools such as Jira
    Service Management, ServiceNow, or similar platforms.
    Good understanding of ITIL-based incident and request management processes.
    Experience troubleshooting hardware, software, and basic networking issues.
    A valid Category B driving licence.
    The ability to understand and communicate in Norwegian, Danish, or Finnish is considered an advantage.
    Experience administering Microsoft 365 services, including Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, and Exchange Online, is considered an advantage.

Personal Qualities

We’re looking for someone who:

    Delivers professional and customer-focused support.
    Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical users.
    Takes initiative and approaches problems in a structured way.
    Is organised and pays attention to detail.
    Works well with colleagues and external partners.

Why Join Us?

You’ll become part of a collaborative IT team where your work has a direct impact on employees’ daily experience. We offer a supportive environment that values continuous learning, teamwork, and professional development, giving you opportunities to grow your technical skills while helping shape and improve our IT services.

If you’re passionate about technology, enjoy helping people, and want to be part of a dynamic IT support team, we’ll love to hear from you.

About Avincis

Avincis is one of the world’s leading operators in emergency aviation services and the largest in Europe. We operate more than 180 bases across Spain, Portugal, Italy, Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, Greece, Mozambique, and Chile.

Our fleet consists of approximately 205 aircraft — 165 helicopters and 40 fixed-wing aircraft — used in critical missions every day. We save lives, protect communities, and support essential services, from air ambulance and search & rescue to wildfire suppression and government operations.

With over 3,000 employees across Europe, we combine the precision and speed of aviation with a strong sense of purpose: making a difference when it truly matters.

Come and join Avincis and help keep air ambulance services safe and efficient across the Nordic region!

title: Au Pair Wanted – Arabic-Speaking
description:
Au Pair Wanted – Arabic-Speaking, Part-Time Position in Sweden

We are looking for a warm, responsible and caring Arabic-speaking au pair to become part of our family in Sweden.

We are especially interested in someone who comes from an Arabic-speaking country, would like to study in Sweden and is interested in learning more about Swedish culture and everyday life. Ideally, you are already living in Sweden, but we are open to the right person who is planning to move here.

About the role

The position is part-time, as the children stay with us every other week. The main responsibilities would include:

    

Helping with school drop-offs and pick-ups

    

Spending time with the children and being a caring, positive adult presence

    

Helping with simple everyday tasks around the home

    

Supporting the children with homework and everyday routines when needed

    

Speaking Arabic with the children and helping them develop and maintain their Arabic language skills

    

Introducing the children to Arabic language, culture and traditions

Because helping the children learn and maintain Arabic is an important part of the role, fluent Arabic is a requirement.

Who we are looking for

We are looking for someone who is:

    

Fluent in Arabic

    

Caring, responsible and reliable

    

Good with children

    

Comfortable helping with everyday household tasks

    

Interested in studying and/or building a life in Sweden

    

Curious about Swedish culture and willing to become part of our family life

    

Ideally already living in Sweden

    

Previous experience with children is a plus

The position is not full-time. You would work every other week, which makes this a good opportunity for someone who is studying or has other commitments during the weeks when the children are not with us.

Accommodation

If you need accommodation, we may be able to arrange housing, depending on the circumstances.

We hope to find someone who is looking for more than just a job — someone who would enjoy becoming part of our family, sharing their language and culture with our children, while also experiencing Swedish culture and everyday life.

If you are interested, please send us a little information about yourself, your background, your experience with children, your plans for studying in Sweden, and your current living situation.

title: Site Construction Manager
description:
Aquatech is a global leader in water purification systems technology for both industrial and infrastructure markets located in the United States and internationally. We support our clients with sustainable water purification systems and technologies that are solving the world's water scarcity challenges.

Aquatech has an immediate need for a full-time Construction Manager in Boden, Sweden. The Construction Manager will report to the Site Manager and will perform the duties described in the job description below.

    Oversee, manage, and direct construction from beginning to end.
    Work very closely and coordinate with the Project Manager.
    Create and manage the overall Site Construction Schedule.
    The Site Construction Manager shall be experienced in the same or substantially similar responsibilities on projects similar in size, type, and complexity to the Work and the Facility.
    Extensive industry experience as a construction manager within their area, where we see that the candidate has extensive hands-on project leadership experience in a demanding industrial environment.
    Engaging and effective leadership capability that creates forward momentum and influence across multiple disciplines and functions.
    Highly execution oriented and biased towards decision-making. Knocks down barriers and gets it done.
    Focused on problem solving and first principles orientation - challenge all stakeholders on both requirements and outputs. Proven effective technical competence.
    Ability to work under high pressure and tight deadlines, excellent time management skills.
    Strong stakeholder management and communication skills. Ability to work well with others in a team environment, as well as strong coordination.
    Create and issue 3-week lookahead schedules every week
    Manage, plan, organize, implement, and control all construction activities of the project per the Project Schedule
    Track inventory regularly
    Be the primary contact on site for construction & liaison with head office on issues relating to the project progress
    Create contractual documents for the execution of claims-free sub-contracts for site works
    Ensure the project is constructed according to design, budget, and schedule
    Plan to prevent problems and mitigate emerging ones.
    Establish risk profile for project(s) and proactively manage mitigation plans, dealing dynamically with unexpected outcomes to ensure project(s) success
    Ensure that company policies, procedures, standards, etc., are followed
    Site subcontractor management & implementation of HSE (Healthy, Safety & Environmental)
    Ensure site progress as per schedule. If there are delays, initiate the necessary actions like allocating extra resources or alternative work processes to ensure the schedule is back on track
    Report progress to the project manager
    Provide a daily & monthly progress report & update the schedule for submission to the customer
    Discuss with the project team and propose/resolve customer and site-related issues
    Work with the site sub-contractor to the standards at the site and maintain alignment with the customer
    Attend customer meetings, contractor meetings, and provide direction
    Ensure timely disposition of the site contractor queries
    Identify and mitigate risks that may have an impact on the project
    Inform the project manager of issues that may affect project profit, costs, schedules, and client relations
    Ensure maintenance of daily records of all site activities, including information on labor and plant, and any non-compliant materials or workmanship
    Monitor project cost and provide the Project Manager with timely identification of deviations from the budget
    Evaluate the change orders/scope change requests of the subcontractor & provide inputs to the project manager
    In case of any accidents, damages, or emergencies at the site, ensure that the proper protocol & procedure

    Proficient in reading the Engineering drawings and documents
    Proficient with computer programs, including MS Office suite (Word, Excel, and Outlook), Blue Beam, Navisworks, and navigating 3D models
    Knowledge of project control software such as Microsoft Project & Primavera P6 is preferred
    Experience in water/wastewater treatment preferred
    OSHA standards and other site safety practices
    Organization and priority-defining skills
    Ability to listen, communicate (written and oral), and willingness to collaborate
    Communicate effectively in English and Swedish.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above and below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Lifting/carrying/moving 50 lbs, may need to climb ladders, cannot be afraid of heights, and will need to wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) while on site. Involves sitting at a desk for extended periods. Needs a high degree of concentration in a busy area.



Qualifications

    Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or Construction Management is preferred
    Ten (10) or more years of construction-related experience

title: Director, Business Development Data Centers
description:
Company description:

At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. Here, you will be part of an international engineering centre with advanced high voltage test halls, modern cable production and the cable laying vessel NKT Victoria. As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and operates in more than 30 countries.NKT - We connect a greener world. www.NKT.com.

Job description:

Build early commercial partnerships across the data centre marketWould you like to shape how NKT engages with customers across the growing data centre segment? As Director, Business Development Data Centers, you will establish early commercial relationships, develop qualified opportunities and coordinate a OneNKT approach across business lines. This international role offers the opportunity to support NKT’s growth journey while contributing to the infrastructure needed for the green transition.



Develop strategic data centre opportunities across selected marketsYou will manage front-end business development across the data centre ecosystem, engaging customers and partners before formal tendering begins. By understanding customer priorities and coordinating internal stakeholders, you will help shape commercial positioning and prepare qualified opportunities for handover to the relevant business line. You will also contribute to NKT’s data centre go-to-market strategy and provide structured insights into market dynamics, customer needs, competitors and portfolio gaps.Your responsibility will be to:




    Map and prioritise target customers, projects and decision-makers
    Build relationships with developers, operators, EPC contractors, integrators and OEMs
    Develop and manage qualified opportunities through early customer engagement
    Coordinate customer activities across NKT business lines and functions
    Support partnership discussions, market analysis and management updates



The position may be based in London, Runcorn, Teesside, Cologne, Berlin, Malmö, Karlskrona or Copenhagen. Planned travel of more than 50 days per year is expected, including customer meetings, industry forums and partner discussions.

Profile description:

Commercial relationship builder with a collaborative working styleYou communicate clearly with people at different organisational levels and create trust through a consistent and considered approach. You are comfortable working across functions, balancing several stakeholder perspectives and maintaining structure as opportunities develop. Curiosity, sound judgement and an ability to translate discussions into practical next steps will help you work effectively in an international and matrix-based organisation.You also have:




    A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics or a related field
    Experience in business development, strategic sales, key account management or go-to-market roles within electrical infrastructure, electrical components or power solutions
    Experience with complex solution selling
    Established network and experience within the data centre ecosystem, including developers, operators, EPC contractors, integrators or OEMs
    A record of developing senior external and internal relationships and early-stage commercial opportunities
    Fluent English



Connect data centre growth with the green transitionWe aim to create a workplace where people of all backgrounds are valued, supported, and able to do their best work. We are dedicated to increasing gender diversity at NKT and welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. We welcome varied backgrounds and career paths, even if you don’t meet every single requirement. We believe inclusive teams contribute to positive results and create a better everyday work environment.



This role offers opportunities for professional development in a collaborative, international setting. You will expand your knowledge of the data centre value chain, work with colleagues across several business lines and develop your commercial and strategic capabilities. You will also contribute to NKT’s market approach within a growing infrastructure segment connected to the green transition.“As a leader, I believe in giving you the freedom to manage tasks while being available to support you when needed. I appreciate work-life balance and aim to build an environment that supports it", says Hiring Manager, Simone Pagliuca







Read more about our offer and listen to some voices of NKT Connectors here!







We will review applications continuously, but we recommend you apply no later than 9th of September. Please submit your application in English. Be aware that personality and cognitive tests will be included in the recruitment process. employer: Personal Spezial Personalservice & Vermittlung Hansjürgen Mathiak
description:
Bereit für das nächste große Kapitel? Erfülle Deine Berufung in der Schweiz!
Du liebst Deinen Beruf als MTR / MTRA, aber spürst, dass es Zeit für eine echte Veränderung ist? Für mehr Wertschätzung, modernste Technik und Lebensqualität, die diesen Namen auch verdient?
Wir verstehen Dich. Seit 25 Jahren begleiten wir als erfolgreiche Vermittlungsagentur Menschen wie Dich dabei, den Arbeitsplatz zu finden, der nicht nur zum Lebenslauf, sondern perfekt zum Leben passt. Für eine renommierte Klinikgruppe in der malerischen Nordschweiz suchen wir genau jetzt Deine Expertise.
Schließe kurz die Augen und stell Dir vor, wie es sich anfühlt, in einem Umfeld zu arbeiten, in dem Deine Leistung täglich gesehen und honoriert wird. Wir haben aktuell 3 exklusive Vakanzen zu besetzen – eine davon wartet vermutlich genau auf Dich.
Deine zukünftigen Highlights: MRT & Angiologie auf Top-Niveau
Du bist der Experte, der Bilder sprechend macht. In Deiner neuen Rolle verbindest Du technologische Präzision mit menschlicher Empathie:
High-End-Diagnostik im MRT: Du steuerst modernste MRT-Systeme und meisterst komplexe Fragestellungen mit Leichtigkeit.
Dynamik in der Angiologie: Bei interventionellen Eingriffen und Gefäßdarstellungen bist Du die unverzichtbare rechte Hand des Teams – ruhig, fokussiert und kompetent.
Patienten-Empathie: Du schenkst Menschen in Ausnahmesituationen Sicherheit und das Gefühl, in den besten Händen zu sein.
Warum dieser Schritt Dein Leben verändern wird
Vielleicht hast Du schon länger über die Schweiz nachgedacht. Lass uns gemeinsam hinschauen, was Dich hier wirklich erwartet:
Spürbare Wertschätzung & Spitzen-Gehalt: Schweizer Saläre und hervorragende Sozialleistungen bieten Dir eine finanzielle Freiheit und Sicherheit, die Du so wahrscheinlich noch nicht kennst.
Zeit für das Wesentliche: Ein exzellenter Personalschlüssel sorgt dafür, dass Du Dich wieder voll und ganz auf Deine Patienten und die Bildqualität konzentrieren kannst – ohne permanenten Stress.
Lebensqualität pur: Die Nordschweiz bietet Dir die perfekte Balance. Atemberaubende Natur, die Alpen vor der Haustür und gleichzeitig die unmittelbare Nähe zur deutschen Heimat.
Dein Rundum-Sorglos-Paket: Wir sind an Deiner Seite. Von der SRK-Anerkennung Deines Diploms über die Wohnungssuche bis hin zu allen bürokratischen Schritten – wir halten Dir den Rücken frei.
Das bringst Du mit auf diese Reise:
Eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als MTR / MTRA.
Fundierte, professionelle Erfahrung in den Bereichen MRT und Angiologie/DSA.
Die Bereitschaft, Dich auf ein neues, wertschätzendes System einzulassen und Dich weiterzuentwickeln.
Du musst diesen Weg nicht alleine gehen. Vertraue auf 25 Jahre Erfahrung und ein Netzwerk, das Türen öffnet. Lass uns in einem ganz unverbindlichen, vertraulichen Telefongespräch herausfinden, ob diese Chance Dein Herz höherschlagen lässt.
Mach jetzt den ersten Schritt in Deine neue Freiheit.

Grabs liegt im Rheintal des Kantons St. Gallen und bietet Sie mit einer ausgezeichneten Verkehrsanbindung an. Die Region ist durch die Bahnlinie und das Autobahnnetz gut erreichbar. Als Arbeitsort überzeugt Grabs Sie mit einer starken Industrie- und Gewerbebase, günstigen Bodenpreisen und einer hohen Lebensqualität in unmittelbarer Nähe zum Bodensee und Liechtenstein.

### Das erwartet Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Profil – darauf kommt es an

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Langzeitpflege

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachpersonen in der Langzeitpflege rund um Grabs ist derzeit sehr hoch, da Altersheime und Betreuungseinrichtungen konstant unter Fachkräftemangel leiden. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Karrierechancen und können zwischen verschiedenen attraktiven Positionen im 80–100%-Pensum wählen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit persönlicher Beratung, passgenauen Stellenvorschlägen und dem Netzwerk zu etablierten Arbeitgebern in der Region, was Ihnen einen reibungslosen Einstieg garantiert.

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Kaiseraugst: das Wichtigste in Kürze

Kaiseraugst liegt strategisch günstig im Kanton Aargau nahe Basel und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung mit direktem Zugang zur Autobahn sowie zu Bahnverbindungen. Die Nähe zu Basel und das Dreiländereck machen die Region für Arbeitnehmende äußerst attraktiv, da Sie von einer stabilen Wirtschaft und vielfältigen Jobmöglichkeiten profitieren. Zugleich bietet Kaiseraugst Ihnen Wohnqualität mit ländlichem Charme und guter Infrastruktur.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Entzugsstation in Kaiseraugst aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Entzugsstation

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Entzugsstation in Kaiseraugst verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für Diplompflegefachfrauen und -fachleute HF/FH in der Entzugsbehandlung rund um Kaiseraugst im Aargau ist geprägt von anhaltender hoher Nachfrage, da spezialisierte Fachkräfte in diesem anspruchsvollen Bereich knapp sind. Sie haben als qualifizierte Fachperson ausgezeichnete Chancen auf eine schnelle Anstellung in etablierten Fachkliniken und Rehabilitationszentren der Region. iPersonal erleichtert Ihnen den Einstieg erheblich, indem wir Sie gezielt mit passenden Arbeitgebern verbinden, umfassend bei der Bewerbung unterstützen und Ihre Fachkompetenz optimal positionieren.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Kaiseraugst

- Gratis-Weiterbildungen dank [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Eine feste Beraterin begleitet Sie persönlich, von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Tag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Entzugsstation in Kaiseraugst

The Senior Supervisor, Complaint Quality Approver Team is accountable for leading a team of Complaint Quality Approvers responsible for independent, objective review and approval of complaint records. The role provides people leadership, operational oversight, and quality decision support to ensure complaint investigations are complete, scientifically justified, risk\-based, and compliant with applicable procedures and regulations. The Senior Supervisor ensures consistent approval practices, timely record progression, appropriate escalation of quality risks, and continuous capability development across the team.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
The Senior Supervisor leads the Complaint Quality Approver team and is responsible for assigning, prioritizing, and monitoring work to ensure compliant and timely approval of complaint records. The role provides guidance to approvers on investigation strategy, risk assessment, escalation, evidence requirements, Root Cause Analysis, NC considerations, and alignment of investigation conclusions across products or affiliates when applicable. The Senior Supervisor ensures that approval decisions are made consistently and are supported by objective evidence, applicable procedures, and current regulatory expectations. In addition, the role reviews complex or high\-risk complaint records, supports escalation to Quality leadership, and drives alignment with cross\-functional partners when investigation direction, closure readiness, or quality risk requires leadership input.  
The Senior Supervisor is accountable for developing team capability through coaching, feedback, training, and performance management. The role establishes clear expectations for documentation quality, approval rationale, system usage, and stakeholder communication, and ensures the team applies best practices consistently. The Senior Supervisor monitors workload, cycle time, quality metrics, backlog, and recurring investigation trends to identify improvement opportunities, remove barriers, and support sustainable business continuity. The role also contributes to process improvement initiatives, inspection readiness, audit support, and the implementation of global or site quality system changes impacting complaint record approval.  
KEY INTERFACES  
Complaint Quality Approvers to provide leadership, coaching, work prioritization, and performance feedback.  
Complaint investigation owners and cross\-functional contributors, including Manufacturing, QC, Engineering, Supply Chain, Packaging, MSAT, Regulatory, and Medical Safety as applicable.  
Quality leadership for escalation, risk communication, resource planning, operational performance, and decision alignment.  
Other sites and affiliates to align investigation strategy, closure expectations, evidence requirements, and consistent complaint outcomes for site\-manufactured products.  
Audit, inspection readiness, quality systems, and process improvement stakeholders to support compliant execution and continuous improvement.  
REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS  
Strong knowledge of quality investigations, complaint handling, CAPA and nonconformance concepts in a regulated pharmaceutical or medical product environment.  
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team in a quality organization, including setting priorities and managing performance.  
Strong understanding of cGMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity expectations, and applicable U.S. and international regulatory requirements.  
Proven ability to assess complex technical data, investigation conclusions, risk assessments, and escalation needs.  
Ability to make sound quality decisions, communicate clear rationale, and ensure consistency in approval standards.  
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional, and global environment.  
Ability to drive sustainable process improvements.  
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide actionable feedback and represent the team in leadership discussions.  
Strong organization, prioritization, and decision\-making skills to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and escalations.  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS  
Master’s degree or PhD in Life Science or related discipline, or equivalent experience, is required.  
Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in quality investigations, complaint handling, quality systems, or a related regulated quality environment is required.  
Prior people leadership, team lead, supervisory, or demonstrated coaching experience is strongly preferred.  
Experience performing, reviewing, approving, or providing oversight for complex quality investigations, complaints, deviations, nonconformances, or similar quality events.  
Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders and quality leadership to manage risk, escalation, and decision alignment.  
Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement, inspection readiness, and consistent execution of quality system requirements.  
Proven critical thinking, problem\-solving, communication, and people leadership skills.

title: Natural Hazards Mission Lead
description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. The Natural Hazards Mission focuses initially on mass movements, including landslides and rockfalls, with the aim of improving early detection, monitoring, preparedness and decision support for Swiss practitioners, authorities and infrastructure stakeholders. It builds on stakeholder engagement, solution scoping and community-building activities already underway within GeoLab, including contributions from senior domain experts and partners in the Swiss natural hazards community.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, natural hazard organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Natural Hazards Mission Lead, you will lead the research and development portfolio, integration and delivery of GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Mission. Initially focused on landslides and rockfalls, and later expanding to other natural hazards, you will help define the mission vision, translate user needs into research and product requirements, and ensure that GeoLab activities create measurable value for Swiss practice and public decision-making. You will build on ongoing interchange with key stakeholders and solution-scoping activities already underway within GeoLab, and work closely with senior domain-relevant partners, technical teams and experts.

You will report to the Managing Director of ETH Swiss GeoLab and work closely with GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Community & Solutions Lead, other GeoLab mission teams, the Research Program Support team, and the Geo-Intelligence team and external partners. You will define priorities, milestones and decision points, lead mission delivery and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within your research and development portfolio, the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define an ambitious and coherent research and development portfolio for the Natural Hazards Mission, initially centred on landslides and rockfalls
Translate identified critical operational gaps into measurable outcomes that create value for practitioners, authorities and decision-makers
Engage with local, cantonal and federal authorities, infrastructure operators, practitioners, industry and expert communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Translate operational challenges into research, data, product and technical requirements
Establish measurable mission outcomes, roadmaps, assumptions and success criteria aligned with Swiss natural hazard needs and the overall GeoLab strategy; you will also track progress actively against these outcomes
Manage the delegated mission budget and define priorities, milestones, decision points and success criteria and track finances and successes in that framework, through regular reporting activities to GeoLab leadership and other stakeholders
Work with the Geo-Lab’s Intelligence team – the team deeply focused on AI and Earth  observation foundational models - and external performers to drive pilots, field validation, operational testing and integration into user workflows
Assess evidence and performance, and recommend continuation, redirection, scaling, pausing or termination of activities
Identify and mobilise strong ETH groups, research institutions, engineering and geology offices, remote-sensing companies, public agencies and implementation partners
Represent ETH Swiss GeoLab in Swiss natural hazard, scientific, policy and industry communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Communicate mission goals, progress, evidence and lessons learned to internal and external stakeholders
Guide and train students, researchers and external contributors where required and support the transfer of resulting capabilities into operational practice
In summary, you understand the needs of practitioners and decision-makers in the field of natural hazards and their relation to Earth observations from space and are motivated by the opportunity to translate research and technology into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree (preferred) in natural hazards, geosciences, engineering, risk management or related fields
Several years of experience in natural hazard practice, applied research, public administration, consulting, engineering or industry, preferably but not necessarily in Switzerland
Strong expertise and understanding of natural hazards with demonstrated examples of dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Proven ability to identify important operational problems and translate them into actionable initiatives
With a track-record of successful collaborations in diverse teams and have demonstrated your excitement to not only do research but apply that research to the benefit of others.
Experience in mission, programme or applied R&D portfolio design
Strong project, portfolio and budget management skills with demonstrated examples of transparent reporting, dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse public authorities, academia, industry and expert communities
The ability to work across disciplinary and organisational boundaries and to lead through influence
Strong judgement skills under uncertainty and the willingness to challenge established approaches constructively
Excellent communication and listening skills, and great presentation skills in various modalities
Excellent written and spoken English and German; French is an asset
You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organisation. You have a track-record of successful team participation and leadership and an excitement for hard and impactful work. You combine scientific credibility with pragmatic decision-making, economic awareness and a clear focus on adoption, operational relevance and measurable value. In doing so, you want to work on the best idea, not necessarily your best idea.

A rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national initiative for Earth observation
A mission-driven role with high visibility and strong societal relevance
The opportunity to develop solutions for pressing natural hazard challenges in Switzerland, and with broad international impact through transferable methods and lessons learned
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Natural Hazards Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

We look forward to receiving your application!

description:
At Syngenta Group, we're a global community of 56,000 innovators across 90 countries, united by a 250-year legacy of agricultural excellence. As the world's most local agricultural technology partner, we create tailor-made solutions that transform farming while protecting our planet, driven by our commitment to innovation, ethics, and integrity. Through our inclusive environment and diverse perspectives, we pioneer breakthrough solutions for farmers, society, and future generations. Join our worldwide teams of agricultural pioneers in creating a more resilient and equitable food system for all.

Job Description

Purpose
•    Provide technical leadership for a particular product or capability within the Process Technology (PT) environment, holding the chemistry and process know-how for assigned chemical steps.
•    Lead the local technical team in the development, introduction, and support of chemical processes for new and mature intermediates and/or active substances, in close collaboration with WMU and Global Process Technology.
•    Drive improvement plans for chemical processes to increase capacity, improve quality, and reduce costs, while troubleshooting process issues (leading cost and process learning curves).
•    Support process relocation projects to external suppliers or other manufacturing sites, and coach junior chemists.

Accountabilities

General & HSE:
•    Ensure that the manufacturing process is safe and compliant with legal and internal HSE rules at all times.
•    Ensure process design meets the requirements of company and national HSEQ and regulatory standards (e.g., Chemical Reaction Hazards, PRA, Management of Change).
•    Define, plan, and control laboratory work, semi-technical, and full-scale plant trials to develop and test new or improved manufacturing processes.
•    Lead programs of scientific work, defining individual tasks and technical designs within complex, challenging projects.
•    Store project data electronically and compile technical reports to record and share experimental results.
•    Actively participate in local and global technical networks to share knowledge and stay connected with other Syngenta sites (CHMU, GBJH, etc.).
Production Support:
•    Define key process parameters and design control strategies to ensure they remain within safe and optimal limits.
•    Provide proactive technical support and troubleshooting to manufacturing plants to restore or improve production performance.
•    Deliver technological recommendations to improve plant capacity, production costs, waste reduction, and energy consumption.
Supply Chain & Project Support:
•    Understand supply chain requirements and take a leading role in delivering objectives (acting as the Technology Lead for specific Active Ingredients (AIs) when required).
•    Lead the technical transfer of manufacturing processes to third parties (outsourcing) or other Syngenta facilities in coordination with the Technology & Sourcing Manager.
•    Provide process chemistry expertise to supply chain and project teams, collaborating closely with Process Engineers.
•    Participate in the commissioning of new or modified plants as part of technical start-up teams.

Qualifications

•    Education: MSc or ideally a PhD in Chemistry, typically with post-doctoral experience.
•    Experience: Minimum of 3 years of industrial experience, ideally with NAIS and AIP knowledge.
•    Technical Expertise: Strong background in synthetic organic chemistry and good knowledge of industrial-scale manufacturing processes.
•    Process Safety: Solid understanding of process safety, reaction hazards, electrostatics, and environmental issues.
•    Change Management: Detailed knowledge of systems for process change and their potential implications on product quality (formulation, regulatory, etc.).
•    Business Acumen: Awareness of costing systems and the financial impact of PT development work on Supply Chain performance.
•    Leadership & Collaboration: Proven ability to work autonomously, lead complex technical projects, and coach/train junior colleagues.

What We Offer

•    A competitive salary
•    Career opportunities as well as possibilities for individual development and continuous training
•    Special attention to your work-life balance with flexible working conditions and flexible hours
•    A work environment that promotes agility, diversity, and teamwork
•    Responsible and varied work in a forward-thinking company
•    On-site company restaurant

Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

title: Growth Marketer – E-Commerce
description:
Growth Marketer – E\-Commerce  
Location: Sonnentalstrasse 21, 8600 Dübendorf  
Work model: Hybrid – 4 days in the office  
Who we are  
Pflegewegweiser, part of the Entyre Group, is one of the fastest\-growing health\-tech scale\-ups in Switzerland and the US — 500\+ employees, locations from Zurich to Boston, and a mission that truly matters: helping people live independently at home. We make sure families are compensated for caring for their loved ones, and supply them with the homecare products they rely on every day.  
Pflegewegweiser Shop is a startup within this scale\-up. We're building an e\-commerce business from the ground up. That means: no legacy accounts to inherit, no 40\-page media plans, and no waiting three quarters for your test to go live. You launch it, you own it, you read and interpret the numbers, and you act accordingly.  
What you'll own  
The paid engine. You own Google Search, Shopping, and PMax end\-to\-end — from campaigns to assets to budget. You run the Merchant Center and the shopping feed like they're yours — because they are: clean data, healthy diagnostics, well\-maintained feeds.  
Meta \& creatives. You plan, launch, and optimize our Meta campaigns. You drive the creatives that feed them — static and video — from in\-house production to briefing and directing agencies. You know a winning ad isn't luck, it's a testing pipeline.  
Funnels. You build marketing funnels across the entire customer journey and continuously optimize them — from first click to repeat purchase.  
Growth sprints. You design experiments that open up new growth opportunities beyond day\-to\-day optimization. You find the growth opportunities we haven't identified or tapped yet.  
New bets. You develop new business models together with the Head of E\-Commerce, stress\-test them, and make them better — expanding what the shop can be.  
The setup. You question existing setups and processes, iterate on them, and make them better. If something is slow, manual, or "just grew that way," you challenge it.  
The shop. You help improve the shop experience, drive e\-commerce sales, and elevate the customer experience — your insights and improvement suggestions can be implemented quickly and directly to give our customers a better experience.  
The numbers. You analyze marketing and sales KPIs to find growth opportunities and efficiencies. Your analysis doesn't just go into a report — it directly influences our spending and budget allocations.  
What you bring  
2–5 years of marketing experience, preferably at a startup, scale\-up, or agency  
Hands\-on experience with paid campaigns on Google Ads and Meta — you've set up and optimized campaigns yourself, not just watched a dashboard  
A data\-driven understanding of marketing and e\-commerce KPIs — comfortable with reporting and able to move quickly from raw data to an actionable recommendation  
Ownership from day one — you'd rather build the process than wait for one  
Comfort with ambiguity and a healthy balance between speed and quality  
German and English \- both C1\+  
Nice to have  
Experience with Google Merchant Center and shopping feeds  
Familiarity with Shopify or a comparable e\-commerce platform  
Basic creative skills (Canva, CapCut, Figma, video production) and experience briefing creative agencies  
Knowledge of A/B testing, CRO, and funnel analytics  
An affinity for healthcare/homecare — or the curiosity to dive deep  
Why this role  
0 to 1, for real. You build the growth engine instead of waiting for someone else to.  
Direct line to leadership. You report to the Senior Growth Manager and work closely with the Chief Business Development Officer. Short paths, fast decisions, no bureaucracy. You learn fast, get direct feedback, and quickly gain ownership of your own topics and areas of responsibility.  
Impact you can see. Small, independent team; your tests land in the business immediately.  
Scale at your back. The pace and autonomy of a startup, backed by the resources of an international group — in one of the biggest growth markets there is: homecare and digital health.  
How we operate — non\-negotiable:  
"Insanely great" for families — delivered now  
Forget mere "satisfaction." We deliver support that makes caregivers feel seen, understood, and valued. Anticipate their needs and solve problems quickly. The standard is "insanely great," period. Anything less slows us down and fails our families.  
Speed is king — ruthless focus is key  
Velocity comes from focus. Eliminate distractions. Concentrate all effort on the \#1 critical objective until it's done, then move to the next. Decide what not to do and cut it ruthlessly. Being a mile wide and an inch deep is failure — move the needle now.  
Raise the bar — crush mediocrity  
Mediocrity kills speed, morale, and companies. Hunt it down and eliminate it. Good enough is never good enough. Demand top performance from yourself and everyone around you. Own your work, deliver excellence fast, and accept no excuses.  
The speed algorithm — question, delete, simplify, accelerate  
Build momentum by questioning every requirement: who asked, and why? Delete ruthlessly — parts, processes, bureaucracy. Simplify what remains. Accelerate cycle times relentlessly. "It can't be done" means "you haven't figured it out yet — go do it." Break bottlenecks, find shortcuts, remove friction.  
Act like owners — bold bets, fast action  
This is your company. Own the mission and the results. Take initiative, make bold bets that leapfrog progress, and act decisively. If you stumble, learn faster and go again. Bias for action is everything.  
The bottom line:  
We are building something vital at lightning speed. This requires intensity, focus, and a relentless drive to execute. If reading this makes you want to jump in and build faster, welcome to Pflegewegweiser!  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
Deutsch:  
Wer wir sind  
Pflegewegweiser, Teil der Entyre Group, ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Health\-Tech\-Scale\-ups in der Schweiz und den USA – 500\+ Mitarbeitende, Standorte von Zürich bis Boston und eine Mission, die wirklich zählt: Menschen zu helfen, selbstbestimmt zu Hause zu leben. Wir sorgen dafür, dass Familien für die Pflege ihrer Angehörigen entschädigt werden, und beliefern sie mit den Homecare\-Produkten, auf die sie sich täglich verlassen.  
Der Pflegewegweiser Shop ist ein Startup innerhalb dieses Scale\-ups. Wir bauen ein E\-Commerce\-Business von null auf. Das heisst: keine Alt\-Accounts, die du erbst, keine 40\-seitigen Mediapläne und kein Warten über drei Quartale, bis dein Test live geht. Du launchst es, du ownst es, du liest und interpretierst die Zahlen, und handelst entsprechend.  
Was du ownst  
Die Paid\-Engine. Du ownst Google Search, Shopping und PMax end\-to\-end – von Kampagnen über Assets bis Budget. Du führst das Merchant Center und den Shopping\-Feed, als wären sie deine – denn das sind sie: saubere Daten, gesunde Diagnostics, top gepflegte Feeds.  
Meta \& Creatives. Du planst, launchst und optimierst unsere Meta\-Kampagnen. Du treibst die Creatives, die sie füttern – Static und Video – von Inhouse\-Produktion bis zum Briefen und Steuern von Agenturen. Du weisst: Eine Gewinner\-Ad ist kein Glückstreffer, sondern eine Testing\-Pipeline.  
Funnels. Du baust Marketing\-Funnels entlang der gesamten Customer Journey und optimierst sie konsequent – vom ersten Klick bis zum Wiederkauf.  
Growth Sprints. Du designst Experimente, die neue Wachstumschancen jenseits der täglichen Optimierungen ermöglichen. Du findest die Wachstumsmöglichkeiten, die wir noch nicht kennen und erschlossen haben.  
Neue Bets. Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Head of E\-Commerce neue Geschäftsmodelle, prüfst sie auf Herz und Nieren und machst sie besser – und erweiterst so, was der Shop sein kann.  
Das Setup. Du hinterfragst bestehende Setups und Prozesse, iterierst sie und machst sie besser. Ist etwas langsam, manuell oder «einfach so gewachsen», stellst du es infrage.  
Der Shop. Du hilfst mit, die Shop\-Experience zu verbessern, E\-Commerce\-Sales zu treiben und die Customer Experience auf ein neues Level zu heben – deine Insights und Verbesserungsvorschläge können und direkt umgesetzt werden, um unseren Kunden eine bessere Customer Experience zu ermöglichen.  
Die Zahlen. Du analysierst Marketing\- und Sales\-KPIs, um Wachstumschancen und Effizienzen zu finden. Deine Analyse geht nicht nur in einen Report – sie hat einen direkten Einfluss auf unser Spending und Budget Allocations.  
Was du mitbringst  
1–2 Jahre Marketing\-Erfahrung, bevorzugt in Start\-ups, Scale\-ups oder Agentur  
Hands\-on\-Erfahrung mit Paid\-Kampagnen auf Google Ads und Meta – du hast selbst Kampagnen aufgesetzt und optimiert, nicht nur ein Dashboard beobachtet  
Ein datengetriebenes Verständnis von Marketing\- und E\-Commerce\-KPIs – fit in Reportings und in der Lage, von Rohdaten zu einer belastbaren Empfehlung zu kommen  
Ownership ab Tag eins – du baust lieber den Prozess, als auf einen zu warten  
Einen Umgang mit Ambiguität und eine gesunde Balance zwischen Speed und Qualität  
C1\+ Deutsch und Englisch  
Pluspunkte  
Erfahrung mit Google Merchant Center und Shopping\-Feeds  
Vertrautheit mit Shopify oder einer vergleichbaren E\-Commerce\-Plattform  
Basic Creative\-Skills (Canva, CapCut, Figma, Video Production) und Erfahrung im Briefen von Kreativagenturen  
Kenntnisse in A/B\-Testing, CRO und Funnel\-Analytik  
Eine Affinität zu Healthcare/Homecare – oder die Neugier, tief einzutauchen  
Warum dieser Platz  
0\-to\-1, wirklich. Du baust die Growth\-Engine, anstatt auf andere zu warten.  
Direkte Leitung zur Führung. Du berichtest an den Senior Growth Manager und arbeitest eng mit der Chief Business Development Officer zusammen. Kurze W

title: Auxiliaire de santé
description:
Auxiliaire de santé (H/F)

Sur le terrain, vous intervenez sur le lieu de vie ou d’activité des bénéficiaires. Vous définissez avec les clients les solutions les plus adaptées à leurs situations et développez ainsi une connaissance fine et une relation de confiance privilégiée avec eux. Taux d'activité entre 50% et 80%

Votre profil et vos compétences

Intérêt marqué pour l'âge avancé et le maintien à domicile  
Capacité à s'organiser de ère autonome tout en sachant collaborer en réseau et en pluridisciplinarité  
Expérience dans le domaine médico\-social et intérêt marqué pour la santé communautaire  
Sens des responsabilités et éthique professionnelle  
Maîtrise du français à l'oral et à l'écrit  
Bonne aisance avec les outils informatiques et la téléphonie mobile  
Nous offrons  
Un cadre de travail stimulant et chaleureux où l'autonomie du soignant est mise en avant  
Un environnement de travail qui privilègie le contact humain et l'échange  
Un travail passionnant dans un cadre agréable pour le bien\-être des clients

Des conditions de prévoyance professionnelle qui s’étendent au\-delà des prestations minimales prévues par la loi

Plan d’intégration par métier, offres de formations continues riches et variées, possibilités d’évolution professionnelle

Die DB Cargo AG ist die Güterverkehrstochter der Deutschen Bahn AG. Als europäischer Marktführer im Schienengüterverkehr verfolgen wir konsequent den internationalen Ausbau unseres Netzwerkes.
